chapters.title: Chapter 14 I’ll Never Take This Off in My Entire Life
paragraphs: As the two exited Yueyang Tower, Lin Yinyin asked, "Senior Brother Zhang, what are you planning to buy for your sister this time?"
"I haven’t decided yet, but her cultivation level is similar to yours. Whatever you like, she’ll surely love it too."
Hmph! Lin Yinyin secretly rejoiced. This "Senior" might genuinely be interested in her—she needed to reel him in quickly!

"Then let’s head to the Yunshang Pavilion. They have a wide array of magical artifacts, and if your sister is close to breaking through to Foundation Establishment, there should be something suitable there."

Lin Yinyin herself had already reached the peak of the ninth level of Qi Refining and was currently preparing for her breakthrough. When cultivators advanced to a new stage, Heavenly Tribulations would descend. Typically, a Qi Refining cultivator advancing to Foundation Establishment would face one to three layers of tribulation lightning, making defensive magical artifacts especially crucial.
"Lead the way, Fellow Cultivator."

The two strolled through the bustling streets of Shuiyun City. Today, Lin Yinyin wore a flowing white gown, its hem cascading like drifting clouds. Her long hair was elegantly tied into a ponytail with a silver hairpin, a few loose strands framing her ears with casual charm. A white silk ribbon cinched her waist, accentuating her slender figure.

She walked half a step ahead of the "Senior," maintaining a respectful distance as both a junior and a guide—neither overly distant nor overly familiar. Walking slightly ahead also allowed him to better appreciate her graceful form. These were the subtle details she was determined to master!

They arrived at the Yunshang Pavilion. Originally founded as a workshop specializing in clothing-related magical artifacts, it had grown over time into a renowned, massive trading guild in the Southern Region, ranking among the top-tier sects in terms of overall strength, with branches in numerous cities.

Zhang Xian followed Lin Yinyin into the store. The interior was a world unto itself, occupying an area comparable to a small plaza. Hundreds of display cases lined the space, shimmering with a dazzling array of goods.
Lin Yinyin led Zhang Xian straight to one particular display case. "Senior Brother Zhang, I think this one looks promising." She pointed to a set of garments.
She had been eyeing this piece for a long time, hesitating whether to purchase it. But this time, with the "Senior" by her side, she hoped to snag it for free.
[Wind Lotus Skirt]
Grade: Low-Grade Defensive Artifact
Attributes: Resonates with Wind and Thunder. Suitable for Fire and Wood Spirit Roots, as well as Mutated Thunder Spirit Roots.
Effect: Offers moderate resistance to Heavenly Tribulations.
Price: 500 Low-Grade Spirit Stones.

Glancing at the description, Zhang Xian shook his head. Mediocre. Typical low-grade artifacts were worth around 20 low-grade Spirit Stones at most. This item's value lay primarily in its ability to withstand Heavenly Tribulations, hence the inflated price.
But that wasn’t the main issue. The real problem was that it was simply too cheap—below his standards.
"Mediocre. Is there a second floor?"
Everyone knew that any shop worth its salt had a second—or even third—floor. The higher the floor, the more prestigious the items, befitting the status of those with discerning taste.
"Yes, but the second floor is quite expensive," Lin Yinyin murmured softly.
Zhang Xian waved his hand, signaling her to lead the way, acting every bit the sophisticated connoisseur.

The two ascended to the second floor. The atmosphere here was far more serene, with only a handful of cultivators scattered about. In a corner sat a middle-aged scholar dressed in gray, reclining comfortably in a Taishi chair, sipping tea and reading a book with leisurely ease.
The reason was simple: the goods on the second floor were prohibitively expensive. Transactions were rare; most items were displayed purely for show.
Zhang Xian scanned the room. Nearly all the artifacts were mid-grade, with prices starting at no less than 20 mid-grade Spirit Stones. He was thoroughly satisfied.
Lin Yinyin certainly has excellent taste—she brought me straight to the best section!
Lin Yinyin, however, felt somewhat hesitant. She had visited once before, only to be deterred by the prices.

The second floor primarily featured items suitable for cultivators at the mid-to-late stages of Foundation Establishment and the early stages of Golden Core. Even her entire fortune wouldn’t suffice to purchase a single item, and even then, only the cheapest one available.
At this moment, her gaze fell upon a light-blue robe.
[Cage-Silk Garment]
Grade: Mid-Grade Defensive Artifact
Description: As thin as cloud gauze, naturally translucent.
Attributes: Suitable for cultivators with various Spirit Roots. Enhances mental clarity and benefits cultivation when worn.
Effect: Easily refined, offering remarkable defensive power.
Price: 100 Mid-Grade Spirit Stones.
What a stunning garment! And I could actually use it—but the price is simply outrageous!
"This one." Zhang Xian nodded, immediately addressing the middle-aged scholar nearby.
Lin Yinyin was utterly shocked. Such extravagance!
The middle-aged scholar smiled and approached. "Fellow Cultivator has excellent taste! Why not try it on first?"
"Buying it means trying it on anyway." Zhang Xian was even more eager than they were, swiftly paying the bill.
"Let’s try it on."
Lin Yinyin was thrilled. She gently caressed the silk garment. Instantly, it transformed into a pale-white ribbon that gracefully wrapped around her gown, lending her an ethereal, otherworldly aura.
Oh, how beautiful! Lin Yinyin’s heart raced.
"It suits you perfectly—I’m giving it to you as a gift."
"But what about Senior Brother Zhang’s sister?"
Although Lin Yinyin had mentally prepared herself, hearing Zhang Xian actually offer the garment to her was still hard to believe.

This was 100 mid-grade Spirit Stones! Just given away like that! Her entire fortune amounted to barely twenty-something mid-grade stones—she would have to work in a mine for thirty years just to afford this single garment.
"Oh, then please wrap up another one for me as well—I’ll give it to my sister. And this one is my thanks for accompanying me on this shopping trip."
Senior Brother Zhang casually pointed to a nearby garment valued at 80 mid-grade Spirit Stones for the second purchase.
He was really giving it to me! Is this a token of affection?
Lin Yinyin felt dizzy with happiness. Should she act coy now, playing the role of a demure young lady and refusing just to maintain her image?
No. She simply couldn’t bring herself to do it.
"Thank you, Brother Zhang." She couldn’t bear to part with this magical garment—not even for a moment. She vowed never to take it off for the rest of her life.
With this magical garment, she felt confident enough to face her Heavenly Tribulation immediately!
[Ding! Successfully gifted the mid-grade Cage-Silk Garment. Returning 10 high-grade magical garments.]
[High-Grade Magical Garments: High-grade defensive artifacts, each with unique functions. Please enter the System Space to view details.]
[Ding! Current Favorability: 31.]
"Shall we look at something else? I saw some fine swords over there." Zhang Xian gestured toward a neighboring counter.
"Huh?" Lin Yinyin, still reeling from her overwhelming happiness, was abruptly pulled along by Zhang Xian.
[Ding! Successfully gifted the mid-grade Stopping-Water Soft Sword. Returning 10 high-grade attack swords.]
[High-Grade Attack Swords: High-grade offensive artifacts, each with unique functions. Please enter the System Space to view details.]
[Ding! Current Favorability: 36.]
[Ding! Successful. Returning 3,000 Foundation Establishment Pills.]
[Foundation Establishment Pills: Yellow-grade medicinal pills that enhance cultivation for Qi Refining and Foundation Establishment cultivators, with diminishing effects upon repeated use.]
[Ding! Current Favorability: 37.]
[Ding! Successfully gifted the Arcane-grade Cold Ice Condensing Soul Technique. Returning 100 Arcane-grade techniques.]
(Note: Techniques are considered one-time consumables based on personal insight—once someone learns a technique, their insight is exhausted, and no one else can learn it again.)
[Special Note: The current Host cannot cultivate other techniques, thus receiving a hundredfold return in equivalent value.]
[Ding! Current Favorability: 38.]
[Ding! Successful. Returning 50 Arcane-grade Spirit Talismans.]
[Arcane-Grade Spirit Talismans: Successfully refined and ready for immediate use. Please enter the System Space to view details.]
[Ding! Current Favorability: 39.]
Zhang Xian was going wild.

Zhang Xian followed Lin Yinyin into the store.
The interior was a world unto itself, occupying an area comparable to a small plaza.
Hundreds of display cases lined the space, shimmering with a dazzling array of goods.
Lin Yinyin led Zhang Xian straight to one particular display case.
"Senior Brother Zhang, I think this one looks promising." She pointed to a set of garments.
She had been eyeing this piece for a long time, hesitating whether to purchase it.
But this time, with the "Senior" by her side, she hoped to snag it for free.
[Wind Lotus Skirt]
Grade: Low-Grade Defensive Artifact
Attributes: Resonates with Wind and Thunder.
Suitable for Fire and Wood Spirit Roots, as well as Mutated Thunder Spirit Roots.
Effect: Offers moderate resistance to Heavenly Tribulations.
Price: 500 Low-Grade Spirit Stones.
Glancing at the description, Zhang Xian shook his head.
Mediocre.
Typical low-grade artifacts were worth around 20 low-grade Spirit Stones at most.
This item's value lay primarily in its ability to withstand Heavenly Tribulations, hence the inflated price.
But that wasn’t the main issue.
The real problem was that it was simply too cheap—below his standards.
"Mediocre.
Is there a second floor?"
Everyone knew that any shop worth its salt had a second—or even third—floor.
The higher the floor, the more prestigious the items, befitting the status of those with discerning taste.
"Yes, but the second floor is quite expensive," Lin Yinyin murmured softly.
Zhang Xian waved his hand, signaling her to lead the way, acting every bit the sophisticated connoisseur.
The two ascended to the second floor.
The atmosphere here was far more serene, with only a handful of cultivators scattered about.
In a corner sat a middle-aged scholar dressed in gray, reclining comfortably in a Taishi chair, sipping tea and reading a book with leisurely ease.
The reason was simple: the goods on the second floor were prohibitively expensive.
Transactions were rare; most items were displayed purely for show.
Zhang Xian scanned the room.
Nearly all the artifacts were mid-grade, with prices starting at no less than 20 mid-grade Spirit Stones.
He was thoroughly satisfied.
Lin Yinyin certainly has excellent taste—she brought me straight to the best section!
Lin Yinyin, however, felt somewhat hesitant.
She had visited once before, only to be deterred by the prices.
The second floor primarily featured items suitable for cultivators at the mid-to-late stages of Foundation Establishment and the early stages of Golden Core.
Even her entire fortune wouldn’t suffice to purchase a single item, and even then, only the cheapest one available.
At this moment, her gaze fell upon a light-blue robe.
[Cage-Silk Garment]
Grade: Mid-Grade Defensive Artifact
Description: As thin as cloud gauze, naturally translucent.
Attributes: Suitable for cultivators with various Spirit Roots.
Enhances mental clarity and benefits cultivation when worn.
Effect: Easily refined, offering remarkable defensive power.
Price: 100 Mid-Grade Spirit Stones.
What a stunning garment!
And I could actually use it—but the price is simply outrageous!
"This one." Zhang Xian nodded, immediately addressing the middle-aged scholar nearby.
Lin Yinyin was utterly shocked.
Such extravagance!
The middle-aged scholar smiled and approached.
"Fellow Cultivator has excellent taste!
Why not try it on first?"
"Buying it means trying it on anyway." Zhang Xian was even more eager than they were, swiftly paying the bill.
"Let’s try it on."
Lin Yinyin was thrilled.
She gently caressed the silk garment.
Instantly, it transformed into a pale-white ribbon that gracefully wrapped around her gown, lending her an ethereal, otherworldly aura.
Oh, how beautiful!
Lin Yinyin’s heart raced.
"It suits you perfectly—I’m giving it to you as a gift."
"But what about Senior Brother Zhang’s sister?"
Although Lin Yinyin had mentally prepared herself, hearing Zhang Xian actually offer the garment to her was still hard to believe.
This was 100 mid-grade Spirit Stones!
Just given away like that!
Her entire fortune amounted to barely twenty-something mid-grade stones—she would have to work in a mine for thirty years just to afford this single garment.
"Oh, then please wrap up another one for me as well—I’ll give it to my sister.
And this one is my thanks for accompanying me on this shopping trip."
Senior Brother Zhang casually pointed to a nearby garment valued at 80 mid-grade Spirit Stones for the second purchase.
He was really giving it to me!
Is this a token of affection?
Lin Yinyin felt dizzy with happiness.
Should she act coy now, playing the role of a demure young lady and refusing just to maintain her image?
No.
She simply couldn’t bring herself to do it.
"Thank you, Brother Zhang." She couldn’t bear to part with this magical garment—not even for a moment.
She vowed never to take it off for the rest of her life.
With this magical garment, she felt confident enough to face her Heavenly Tribulation immediately!

chapters.title: Chapter 15 I Really Do Treat You Like a Little Sister
paragraphs: Lin Yinyin was overwhelmed by Zhang Xian’s relentless generosity. At first, she was so excited that her legs wouldn’t stop trembling; later, she even started feeling numb. Staring at the densely packed treasures in her storage pouch, she felt a wave of dizziness.

She was now fully equipped with mid-grade magical artifacts, along with Foundation Establishment pills and various talismans and elixirs. After calculating everything, she realized that the value of the items Zhang Xian had bought for her exceeded five hundred mid-grade Spirit Stones. Suddenly, she felt that all her previous years of austere cultivation had been lived in vain. This newfound happiness felt like a dream.
Just who is this "Senior Brother Zhang"? What level of cultivation must he have reached to be so extraordinary?
Zhang Xian, on the other hand, felt refreshed and invigorated. This shopping spree had been utterly satisfying, and he couldn’t wait to return home and start cataloging his purchases.

He wondered what would happen if he consumed all the Foundation Establishment pills at once. Each pill alone was worth five mid-grade Spirit Stones! Perhaps he could save some for Xuanwei and Miaoyin—another round of returns awaited them soon.
As he indulged in these pleasant thoughts, he suddenly noticed Lin Yinyin tugging gently at the sleeve of his robe.
"Senior Brother Zhang," she said softly, "you’ve given me so much today... I don’t even know how to repay you."
This was already her fifteenth "Older Brother." Yet compared to him, the previous fourteen combined seemed insignificant.

"Senior cultivator, there’s no need for such formalities," Zhang Xian replied calmly. "I simply feel we’re destined to meet. Besides, you’ve also helped me select many excellent items—you truly deserve all this."
Lin Yinyin’s eyes sparkled with shyness as she murmured, "Senior Brother Zhang, calling me ‘senior cultivator’ makes it sound so distant!"
"Well then," he said with a smile, "I’ll call you Yinyin instead."

"Mn!" Lin Yinyin exclaimed happily, immediately looping her arm through Zhang Xian’s. It was the first time in all her years managing her "fishpond" that she’d taken such initiative. She just couldn’t resist!
"Senior cultivator—or rather, Yinyin—today has been exhausting, hasn’t it? I’ve received your transmission; let’s meet again another day," Zhang Xian said, eager to return home.
"Oh!" So he was leaving already. Lin Yinyin couldn’t help but feel a pang of disappointment.
Senior Brother Zhang is so strange! Why didn’t he say anything? I've already been so proactive—how frustrating!
She desperately wanted to open up and chat freely with Senior Brother Zhang. Who gives gifts without confessing their feelings?
Lin Yinyin was so anxious she wanted to stomp her feet.
Watching Zhang Xian’s figure gradually fade into the distance, Lin Yinyin bit her lip silently. If he isn’t going to take the initiative, why not take it myself?

"Senior Brother Zhang!" she called out, then hurried over to loop her arm through his again, saying sweetly, "Senior Brother Zhang, I still don’t know where you live—are you staying here in Shuiyun City?"
"Yes, just ahead, not far away," Zhang Xian replied, pointing toward a mansion in the distance.

Lin Yinyin didn’t even need to look to know which area he was referring to—those were all grand mansions, each standing alone, surrounded year-round by Spirit Gathering Formations. The spiritual energy there was even richer than at the Shuiyun Sect itself. Such a property was worth at least a thousand mid-grade Spirit Stones.

Lin Yinyin came from an ordinary family; her parents were commoners incapable of cultivation, and they had passed away early. But because she possessed a Water Spirit Root, she managed to join the Shuiyun Sect as a registered disciple. As a registered disciple, however, she didn’t have a fixed master, nor did she have a proper place to stay—she merely lived in the dormitories at the foot of the sect's mountain gate, requiring half an hour to reach Shuiyun City each time.
How I long for a home!
"May I... may I visit your home? And meet your sister too?" Lin Yinyin asked timidly.

At first, she hadn’t believed Zhang Xian had a sister, thinking it was merely an excuse for him to get closer to her. But now, seeing him buy everything in duplicate, she was starting to lose confidence in her judgment. Is she really his sister, or some random woman?

Even if he truly had a consort, Lin Yinyin wouldn’t mind—it was only natural, given his extravagant generosity. After all, in the cultivation world, strength reigned supreme, and it was quite common for powerful cultivators to have over ten consorts.
"Alright," Zhang Xian agreed readily, surprised by her sudden eagerness. In his view, Lin Yinyin was nothing more than a walking ATM.
"My sister isn’t here; usually, I’m the only one living there. But there are plenty of rooms—so if you don’t mind, you’re welcome to stay."

"Of course not!" Lin Yinyin replied, her heart pounding wildly with nervous excitement. Despite having so many "Older Brothers," she’d never before shared a room with a man. Deep down, she was still an innocent young girl.
Oh dear, what if he... what should I do—refuse or accept? Her heart raced with anxiety and trepidation.

Their intimate gestures were inadvertently spotted by several mining friends who had come into the city together to purchase supplies. These men had all once pursued Lin Yinyin, eventually becoming her "Older Brothers." Originally rivals, they had given up on winning her affection and gradually grown fond of each other, becoming friends instead.
"Hey! Isn’t that Lin Yinyin? And who’s that man with her?" To them, their common enemy had always been Zhao Jia, that despicable scoundrel. But now, she was arm-in-arm with someone else!
"No, not Zhao Jia! Wait, he looks familiar—isn’t that the pervert?"
"Which pervert?"
"The one who spent ten mid-grade Spirit Stones to buy Yinyin’s handkerchief! He used to trade high-value Spirit Stones at the mine, calling himself Zhang Xian—I recognize him!"
Zhang Xian’s behavior had already spread widely among the miners, as no one had ever heard of such a fool and pervert combined.
As for Yinyin, how could they bring themselves to criticize her? No one could refuse ten mid-grade Spirit Stones!

After all, each of them secretly kept a handkerchief of hers—a precious memento from the days when she’d handed them cloths to wipe their sweat while they worked selflessly in the mine. But surely, those handkerchiefs weren’t worth ten mid-grade Spirit Stones!
"No way! He must have used some special means! Yinyin isn’t the type of woman who’d sell herself for money—she even turned down Zhao Jia!"

They couldn’t accept it! Over the past few months, Yinyin hadn’t taken advantage of them, and they’d saved up quite a bit, planning to buy her something she loved to win her favor. But now, they’d witnessed this scene instead.
Seeing Lin Yinyin clinging to Zhang Xian’s arm, practically glued to him, the miners were devastated!
"No! We haven’t even touched Yinyin’s hand!"
Why would you fall for that pervert, of all people—and such an ugly one, too! Yinyin, is your taste really that extreme?!
Unable to bear it any longer, several of them followed Zhang Xian and Lin Yinyin all the way to a mansion in the western district.
So it was a rich pervert, after all!
Pfft! One miner with a weak constitution couldn’t hold back his tears and spat blood. His Goddess Yinyin was checking into a hotel with another man!
Damn rich people! Even Yinyin has been corrupted by money!
The miners pounded their chests and wailed pitifully before Zhang Xian’s mansion, grief-stricken beyond measure.
Yinyin has fallen, and our youthful innocence has ended along with her!

Neither Zhang Xian nor Lin Yinyin noticed they were being followed as they entered the mansion. One was preoccupied with the System’s returns, the other lost in thought about her own desires. Neither paid attention to anything else.
When Zhang Xian returned to his room, Lin Yinyin stood awkwardly at the doorway, her face flushed bright red.
What is Senior Brother thinking? Should I take the initiative again?

"Don’t overthink it," Zhang Xian said, pointing to a row of empty rooms beside him. "These are all vacant rooms—feel free to choose one and move in. Just imprint your spiritual energy onto the lock, and you can come and go as you please. Treat it just like your own home."
Why does this sound so familiar? Wasn’t this exactly the line I always used?
Could it be that I’m just a backup option too? Lin Yinyin was still dazed when she saw Zhang Xian close the door behind him.
Closed.
Lin Yinyin was utterly dumbfounded.

She mechanically selected a room on Zhang Xian’s left side, finding it lavishly furnished, far more luxurious than her tiny dormitory at the foot of the Shuiyun Sect. But she had no heart to appreciate it now—her mind was filled only with question marks and exclamation points.
Who am I? Where am I?

chapters.title: Chapter 16 The Tribulation Thunder Fails to Penetrate the Armor
paragraphs: Lin Yinyin waited for a week, but Zhang Xian didn’t step out of his room even once.
"Senior is in seclusion."

Lin Yinyin quickly adjusted her mindset. If she couldn’t figure it out, she simply stopped trying. Besides, with the Zhou Tian Protective Formation safeguarding Shuiyun City, she had no reason to worry about Senior doing anything harmful to her. At least the treasures she carried were all genuine.

Lin Yinyin swallowed a Foundation Establishment Pill, immediately feeling an overwhelming sense of comfort. The dispersed medicinal energy began to surge through her internal organs, smoothing her bones and meridians. After half an hour, she opened her exquisite eyes, filled with newfound clarity. She had sensed the Heavenly Tribulation—she was about to break through! This was two full years earlier than her original plan.
"Thank you, Senior, for your kindness!"
Lin Yinyin left a message transmission behind and headed straight for the Shuiyun Sect’s Steward Hall.

"Registered disciple Lin Yinyin is preparing to break through to the Foundation Establishment stage and requests the sect’s protection during the tribulation," Lin Yinyin said to one of the stewards at the hall.

"Oh? So soon? I remember last year you had just reached the eighth level, Junior Sister Yinyin, and now you’re already at Foundation Establishment? Congratulations!" The steward attending to Lin Yinyin was a young-looking cultivator. Though there were over a thousand registered disciples in the Shuiyun Sect, he remembered Lin Yinyin clearly—mainly because she was exceptionally beautiful.
"Thank you, Senior Brother. I’ve had some recent insights," Lin Yinyin replied with a smile.
The steward handed her a jade slip. "Junior Sister can choose one of the Elders to protect you during the tribulation."

In the Southern Region, most sect disciples maintained relationships with their sects akin to employer-employee arrangements: one side fulfilled tasks, the other provided compensation. The Shuiyun Sect was no exception. Only a very few exceptional talents received free, intensive cultivation from the sect—a form of investment, bluntly speaking, aimed at nurturing these prodigies so they could later repay the sect with their strength.

Lin Yinyin examined the jade slip and finally selected a female cultivator at the late Foundation Establishment stage. Her protection fee was five mid-grade Spirit Stones per session. "I’ll choose Elder Sun then."
The steward was somewhat astonished. Elder Sun was the most expensive cultivator listed on the jade slip! Lin Yinyin truly had deep pockets!
In the past, Lin Yinyin would never have dared spend such a sum. But now, with Senior as her backing, five mid-grade Spirit Stones were still precious, but her life was far more valuable.

The Southern Region had enjoyed peace for many years, and most cultivators who met their ends did so due to Heavenly Tribulations. Even armed to the teeth, Lin Yinyin still needed to proceed with utmost caution.

Soon after, Elder Sun arrived at the Steward Hall. She appeared as a gentle, elderly woman. Foundation Establishment cultivators enjoyed a lifespan of 500 years, and she was already over 480 years old. Unfortunately, she had only reached the eighth level of Foundation Establishment and had no hope of further advancement.

Seeing Lin Yinyin’s delicate features and vibrant energy, Elder Sun couldn’t help but recall her own youth. She, too, had once been a beautiful female cultivator, young and full of vitality. But now, with her lifespan dwindling and her spiritual power declining, even maintaining her youthful appearance was becoming increasingly difficult. To eke out a few more years of life, she had resigned herself to letting her appearance age naturally.

Lin Yinyin politely performed a respectful bow to Elder Sun, and the two stepped into the teleportation array within the hall, arriving at a mountain peak inside the Shuiyun Sect grounds. The peak was shrouded in swirling spiritual energy, and the rocks bore numerous scorched marks—this was a common site for disciples to undergo their Heavenly Tribulations.

Elder Sun skillfully tossed several low-grade Spirit Stones, activating a Spirit Gathering Formation that intensified the spiritual energy at the peak. She then thoughtfully cast another recovery formation, this time of the Water element, around Lin Yinyin. After all, she too cared about her reputation.

Once the preparations were complete, Elder Sun sat cross-legged at the center of the formation. "With me here, no one will disturb you. You may cultivate peacefully and await your breakthrough without worry."
"Thank you, Senior," Lin Yinyin replied with a deep bow, her expression solemn.

From the moment she left Shuiyun City and lost the protection of the Zhou Tian Formation, Lin Yinyin could clearly feel a shadow descending upon her heart—a sign that the Heavenly Tribulation was imminent, arriving anywhere from half a day to a full week.

Whether it was the protective formation or the surrounding recovery arrays, these were all external factors. Ultimately, overcoming the Heavenly Tribulation depended entirely on oneself. Yet clutching the various magical treasures in her bosom, Lin Yinyin managed to ease her anxiety somewhat.
With that, she calmed her mind and settled down at the center of the mountain peak, patiently awaiting the arrival of the Heavenly Tribulation.
Two days later, dark clouds gathered above the peak, accompanied by thunderous roars and the faint sound of dragon cries echoing between the clouds.
The Heavenly Tribulation had arrived!

The first bolt of tribulation lightning was as thick as an arm, striking directly toward Lin Yinyin’s crown. But she wore her Cage-Silk Robe, whose surface shimmered with a silver glow, instantly neutralizing the tribulation’s force.

Elder Sun’s eyebrows twitched in surprise. Who would have guessed? That seemingly simple white robe adorned with ribbons is actually a mid-grade defensive artifact—its quality even surpasses my own defensive gear!

The second bolt of tribulation lightning came even faster, identical in size to the first, yet winding sinuously from the clouds, striking for a full half-minute. Through the Cage-Silk Robe, the lightning struck Lin Yinyin, turning her delicate face deathly pale. A burning, piercing pain spread throughout her body—so agonizing!
Before long, the second bolt subsided. Elder Sun gazed up at the darkening clouds, growing increasingly astonished. There was still a third bolt coming?!

Cultivation was defying Heaven itself, and the number of tribulation bolts was essentially proportional to one’s innate talent and potential. Typically, Foundation Establishment tribulations involved one or two bolts. Even Elder Sun, whose talent ranked among the top in the Shuiyun Sect, had only faced two tribulations. Yet this lovely little girl had three!
Oh, there is still a third?!

Lin Yinyin sensed this, her heart both anxious and secretly thrilled. Three tribulation bolts were indeed terrifying, but they were also Heaven’s recognition of a cultivator’s worth. And fortunately, she had prepared thoroughly this time.

Calmly, she drew a stack of Spirit Talismans from her bosom and swiftly activated an Earth-element talisman, which instantly formed a humanoid shield around her, providing robust protection. She then hastily consumed a Spirit Pill and sipped from a Spirit Spring.

Elder Sun’s lips twitched as she watched this spectacle. Each Earth-element talisman cost five mid-grade Spirit Stones, and Lin Yinyin still had a whole stack! And those Spirit Pills and Springs—she herself felt envious! This little girl was simply too wealthy!
If you’re so well-prepared, what need do I have to be here?
Then came the third tribulation bolt, even more colossal than the previous two, yet unable to pierce the protective barrier created by the Earth-element talisman.
As the tribulation clouds dissipated and dawn broke, Lin Yinyin’s Foundation Establishment Tribulation passed without incident.
The gaseous spiritual energy within her body gradually transformed, flowing like a rushing stream.
She had successfully reached Foundation Establishment!
"Congratulations, Fellow Cultivator!" Elder Sun greeted her with a smiling bow, addressing her as an equal now that they shared the same cultivation stage.
Lin Yinyin responded with heartfelt gratitude, visibly noticing how her skin had become even fairer and more delicate than before—she absolutely loved it!

"Fellow Cultivator, would you consider joining our Shuiyun Sect’s inner circle and becoming a Direct Disciple under the Sect Master?" Elder Sun extended an invitation, eager not to miss out on such a promising talent blessed with three tribulation bolts.
"I... I’ll think about it," Lin Yinyin replied softly. Had it been in the past, she would have been overjoyed beyond words—after all, the Shuiyun Sect Master was a veritable Golden Core cultivator!

Elder Sun sighed inwardly, realizing that Lin Yinyin’s wealth likely stemmed from other, unknown opportunities. Nevertheless, she politely handed over a transmission talisman, believing that Lin Yinyin’s talent and abundant resources made her worthy of cultivating a good connection.
Lin Yinyin bid farewell to Elder Sun and returned to Shuiyun City, reluctantly purchasing a pair of boots.

These mid-grade magical boots were comfortable, beautifully designed, and crafted by the Baoqing Workshop. Priced at fifteen mid-grade Spirit Stones, they were the most expensive magical item she had ever bought.
She knew Senior certainly didn’t lack such things, but it was the thought that counted. She wanted to gift them to Senior, hoping he would appreciate them!
Lin Yinyin happily returned to her residence, only to find Zhang Xian gone, leaving behind a single note:
"I’ve gone to find my younger sister. Have fun on your own for a few days."
Hmph! Senior has another younger sister? How disappointing!

"Senior is in seclusion."
Lin Yinyin quickly adjusted her mindset.
If she couldn’t figure it out, she simply stopped trying.
Besides, with the Zhou Tian Protective Formation safeguarding Shuiyun City, she had no reason to worry about Senior doing anything harmful to her.
At least the treasures she carried were all genuine.
Lin Yinyin swallowed a Foundation Establishment Pill, immediately feeling an overwhelming sense of comfort.
The dispersed medicinal energy began to surge through her internal organs, smoothing her bones and meridians.
After half an hour, she opened her exquisite eyes, filled with newfound clarity.
She had sensed the Heavenly Tribulation—she was about to break through!
This was two full years earlier than her original plan.
"Thank you, Senior, for your kindness!"
Lin Yinyin left a message transmission behind and headed straight for the Shuiyun Sect’s Steward Hall.

So soon?

"Thank you, Senior Brother.
I’ve had some recent insights," Lin Yinyin replied with a smile.
The steward handed her a jade slip.
"Junior Sister can choose one of the Elders to protect you during the tribulation."

The Shuiyun Sect was no exception.

Only a very few exceptional talents received free, intensive cultivation from the sect—a form of investment, bluntly speaking, aimed at nurturing these prodigies so they could later repay the sect with their strength.
Lin Yinyin examined the jade slip and finally selected a female cultivator at the late Foundation Establishment stage.
Her protection fee was five mid-grade Spirit Stones per session.
"I’ll choose Elder Sun then."
The steward was somewhat astonished.
Elder Sun was the most expensive cultivator listed on the jade slip!
Lin Yinyin truly had deep pockets!
In the past, Lin Yinyin would never have dared spend such a sum.
But now, with Senior as her backing, five mid-grade Spirit Stones were still precious, but her life was far more valuable.

Even armed to the teeth, Lin Yinyin still needed to proceed with utmost caution.

She appeared as a gentle, elderly woman.
Foundation Establishment cultivators enjoyed a lifespan of 500 years, and she was already over 480 years old.
Unfortunately, she had only reached the eighth level of Foundation Establishment and had no hope of further advancement.
Seeing Lin Yinyin’s delicate features and vibrant energy, Elder Sun couldn’t help but recall her own youth.
She, too, had once been a beautiful female cultivator, young and full of vitality.
But now, with her lifespan dwindling and her spiritual power declining, even maintaining her youthful appearance was becoming increasingly difficult.
To eke out a few more years of life, she had resigned herself to letting her appearance age naturally.
Lin Yinyin politely performed a respectful bow to Elder Sun, and the two stepped into the teleportation array within the hall, arriving at a mountain peak inside the Shuiyun Sect grounds.

chapters.title: Chapter 17 Unprecedented and Unparalleled, Stirring the Heavens and Earth
paragraphs: hapter 17: Unprecedented and Unparalleled, Stirring the Heavens and Earth
What Lin Yinyin didn’t know was that just as she had finished her Foundation Establishment Tribulation, Zhang Xian was already preparing for his own.

He had chosen the Small World of the Great Liang Kingdom as the place to undergo his trial. When he reappeared at the nameless Taoist temple, Xuanwei’s jaw nearly hit the floor—Zhang Xian had already reached the peak of Qi Refining!

How could this be happening so fast? Back then, Senior Sister Li Miaoyin had spent a full twenty years cultivating to reach the peak of Qi Refining. But Zhang Xian—barely a year into his journey—was already preparing to face his tribulation! And he was just a mortal without Spiritual Roots!
"Xiao Xuanzi, here’s a box of Foundation Establishment Pills for you. Take good care of them," Zhang Xian said.
Xuanwei was utterly dumbfounded. He had never heard anyone quantify Foundation Establishment Pills by the "box."

When he opened it, his eyes nearly popped out of their sockets. A rich medicinal fragrance wafted up immediately—these were top-quality Foundation Establishment Pills, incredibly valuable for Qi Refining cultivators like themselves. And there were fully twenty pills in this single box!

He almost burst into tears. The only other time he’d seen Foundation Establishment Pills was over a hundred years ago, during the Grand Competition at the Shuiyun Sect. Back then, only the top three received one pill each. His sister had placed fourth, leaving her deeply disappointed for a long time afterward.

But Zhang Xian wasn’t done yet. He casually tossed over a dozen mid-grade magical artifacts. They clattered onto the ground with a careless whoosh. "Pick whatever you like. Don’t hold back—I’ve prepared something for each of you."

Xuanwei’s eyes nearly popped out again as he stared at the pile of mid-grade artifacts scattered across the floor. He collapsed to his knees, reaching out to touch one after another, completely abandoning any semblance of dignity as a handsome young cultivator.
Just then, Li Miaoyin arrived, her robes fluttering in the wind, her voice preceding her presence. "Junior Brother, what are you doing? How can you behave so disgracefully?"
As soon as she landed, a box was thrust into her hands. "This box of Foundation Establishment Pills is for you, Miaoyin. Pick out a few items too. My storage space is about to overflow!"
Thud!
Another person hit their knees.
[Beep! Transaction successful. Returning 3,000 Foundation Establishment Pills.]
[Beep! Mid-grade magical artifacts gifted successfully. Returning 10 high-grade magical artifacts.]
[Beep! Mid-grade magical artifacts gifted successfully. Returning 10 high-grade magical artifacts.]

After a long while, Xuanwei helped Li Miaoyin to her feet. Both of them clutched several magical artifacts, their expressions somewhat unnatural. They had lost control of their emotions earlier and behaved rather improperly.
"Lord Zhen, where on earth did you get so many magical artifacts and pills?" Xuanwei asked.
"Oh, I just got lucky—I unearthed a hidden cave dwelling. Don’t you want to pick some more? I still have plenty left."

Zhang Xian thought to himself regretfully, It’s such a pity I can’t give you high-grade magical artifacts. You can’t use them, and I won’t get anything in return. I had to spend my own money to buy these lower-grade ones specifically for you.
Who would believe him if he told the truth? His System storage was overflowing with high-grade artifacts he couldn’t give away, yet he had to spend money to buy "trash" to gift!
"Enough! Enough!" the two of them exclaimed repeatedly, their faces unable to hide their joy. Xuanwei even slapped himself several times to check if he was dreaming.
"Oh," Zhang Xian said, pulling out several large bags and dumping them onto the ground with a clatter.

"You’ve had a tough time here too, haven’t you? I’ve got a few bags of mid-grade Spirit Stones for you—just enough for your cultivation. Xuanwei and Miaoyin, take one bag each. These are all Water-attribute mid-grade stones. There’s also a mixed bag—leave that for your nephew Yu Yun and the others."
The sight of three and a half bags piled up to waist height—each containing at least several hundred stones—left Xuanwei and Li Miaoyin utterly bewildered.
Who am I? Where am I?
[Beep! Transaction successful. 184 stones exceeded Li Miaoyin’s usage limit. Equivalent return: 1,160 high-grade Spirit Stones.]

"Lord Zhen, you’re giving us far too much! My Sister and I simply can’t use this many Spirit Stones here in this Small World. Spirit Stones are the very foundation of cultivation. Your kindness is beyond measure," Xuanwei stammered, his voice trembling.

"Xiao Xuanzi, you’re being too polite. If you and Miaoyin hadn’t helped me resolve my doubts and guided me onto the path of cultivation, how could I have obtained such opportunities? Sharing these blessings is only natural. Otherwise, my conscience wouldn’t allow it, and I’d fear developing a Heart Demon. Xiao Xuanzi, surely you wouldn’t stand by and watch me descend into madness?"

Hearing Zhang Xian’s twisted reasoning, Xuanwei could only laugh and cry at the same time. Lord Zhen was truly generous beyond compare. He didn’t just call him Xiao Xuanzi; he might as well ask him to become his adoptive father right now!
After several attempts, Zhang Xian had gradually figured out the System’s return rules.

First, the System returned items based on the actual needs of the recipient. When he secretly slipped two high-grade Spirit Stones into Li Miaoyin’s bag, he received no return, presumably because the System determined she couldn’t use them. The same applied to high-grade magical artifacts.
Second, the items returned to him were limited by the maximum amount he could currently use based on his cultivation level.

Having spent time in the cultivation world, Zhang Xian knew that top-tier prodigies at the Qi Refining stage could wield high-grade artifacts—a phenomenon known as "transcending one’s stage." Fortunately, the artifacts and talismans returned by the System had already been refined, meaning Zhang Xian could use them freely beyond his current stage.

Finally, the return rate was generally either two grades higher or 100 times the original value, prioritizing the increase in grade. If he couldn’t use the higher-grade items, the return would be scaled down to 10 times the original value. For instance, when he forcibly gave Li Miaoyin a low-grade artifact, she was puzzled but accepted it. As expected, Zhang Xian received a high-grade artifact in return.
It seemed he could only receive higher-grade returns once his cultivation level increased.
Upon hearing Zhang Xian’s purpose for returning to the Great Liang Kingdom this time, Xuanwei and Li Miaoyin both felt anxious. Every cultivator harbored a deep-seated fear of Heavenly Tribulations.

"Lord Zhen, please don’t take this lightly. You should refine more defensive artifacts and prepare plenty of restorative pills, not to mention talismans that resist tribulation lightning," Xuanwei urged earnestly.
Zhang Xian nodded repeatedly, thinking to himself, If I pulled out a dozen high-grade defensive artifacts, I’d probably scare you to death!

However, he had heard that Heavenly Tribulations treated people differently—the more extraordinary one’s cultivation, the fiercer the tribulation. What if his tribulation turned out to be unprecedented, causing the heavens and earth to change color?
That was precisely why he had chosen to undergo his tribulation in this Small World—not only was it safe, but it was also discreet.
After making thorough preparations, Zhang Xian selected a secluded spot and began his cultivation, quietly awaiting the arrival of the Heavenly Tribulation.
Ten days later, a glimmer of insight dawned upon Zhang Xian—his tribulation was imminent.
A month later, thunderclouds slowly began to gather above his head.
"The tribulation is coming!" Not far away, Xuanwei and Li Miaoyin stood watch, monitoring every change.

Li Miaoyin’s expression remained calm as she nodded. "Lord Zhen’s fortune is astonishing. To rise from Qi Refining to its peak within less than a year is unprecedented. Even waiting for the tribulation took a full month—this one certainly won’t be simple!"
Not far behind them, the other disciples of the temple had also been summoned to witness the event.

Back when Xuanwei accepted disciples, he only sought those with Spiritual Roots. Now, however, they had no shortage of Spirit Stones, allowing them to easily embark on the path of cultivation. Among them, Yu Yun had already successfully completed Qi Refining and joined the ranks of cultivators.
Dressed in precious armor, holding a talisman in his left hand and a pill in his right, Zhang Xian faced the impending tribulation with utmost seriousness.
After a long wait, a crack echoed through the air. A bolt of tribulation lightning as thick as a thumb descended.
Yet before it even reached Zhang Xian’s body, his protective aura dispersed it entirely.
Finally, it’s here—the first strike!
Zhang Xian’s eyes narrowed slightly. No big deal.
Then, he suddenly felt his internal Qi condensing. Hmm?
Immediately afterward, a gust of wind swept across the tribulation cloud above his head... causing it to dissipate slowly.
Dissipated.
An increasingly awkward silence filled the air.
After a long pause, Xuanwei hesitantly asked, "Sister, was that really a tribulation cloud just now, or did a rain cloud just pass by?"
"It must have been a tribulation cloud—I could sense its energy," Li Miaoyin replied, equally uncertain.
A little while later, Zhang Xian walked over, looking as though he were constipated. "I—I think I’ve established my foundation!"
"Hmm... perhaps it’s because Lord Zhen cultivated a False Core, making the tribulation cloud difficult to detect."

"That’s right! Maybe the rules of this Small World are incomplete, causing the tribulation power to weaken. In any case, Lord Zhen has successfully passed his tribulation—congratulations!" Xuanwei and Li Miaoyin quickly offered words of comfort.
Pfft! Yu Yun almost burst out laughing.
Zhang Xian was utterly bewildered. He had expected the Heavens to deliver a severe punishment, but instead, it had produced nothing more than a weak, insignificant spark.
What a pathetic tribulation! It clearly demonstrated just how poor my innate talent is!

Maybe the rules of this Small World are incomplete, causing the tribulation power to weaken.
In any case, Lord Zhen has successfully passed his tribulation—congratulations!" Xuanwei and Li Miaoyin quickly offered words of comfort.
Pfft!
Yu Yun almost burst out laughing.
Zhang Xian was utterly bewildered.
He had expected the Heavens to deliver a severe punishment, but instead, it had produced nothing more than a weak, insignificant spark.
What a pathetic tribulation!
It clearly demonstrated just how poor my innate talent is!

chapters.title: Chapter 18 Does She Think I’m a Pervert
paragraphs: After slightly stabilizing his cultivation, Zhang Xian successfully advanced to the seventh stage of the Classic of Nurturing Golden Cores with Azure Wood. He then spent ten mid-grade Spirit Stones on travel expenses to return to the Main World.

The technique of cultivating a False Core allowed him to absorb spiritual energy, but it couldn’t enhance his innate talent. His artificially created Wood Spirit Root was of the lowest grade, which explained why his Heavenly Tribulation had been so lackluster.

When Zhang Xian returned to his residence in Shuiyun City, he found the front courtyard transformed. It was filled with exotic herbs and plants, and a small pond had even been dug. Lin Yinyin was carefully watering everything with a watering can.
[Beep! Current Favorability: 40.]
Upon seeing Zhang Xian, she exclaimed with delight, "Brother, you’re finally back!"

These past few days, Lin Yinyin had been living the life of her dreams. Not only had she successfully established her foundation, but she had also moved into a grand mansion in Shuiyun City, with cultivation resources abundant beyond measure.
She no longer had to work in the mines and could instead cultivate spiritual plants and live a carefree life.
The only downside was her brother’s personality. He was a bit strange, and his whereabouts were too unpredictable. He had disappeared again for over two months.
"Hmm, just taking care of some matters," Zhang Xian replied, noticing that Lin Yinyin had also broken through. "Congratulations on establishing your foundation!"
"Thanks to the Spirit Stones and Foundation Establishment Pills Brother gave me! Otherwise, it would have taken me at least another two years."

"By the way, Brother! My tribulation this time was incredible—the tribulation cloud had three distinct strikes! The Senior who protected me even invited me to become a Direct Disciple of the Shuiyun Sect, but I declined. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have been able to stay by your side!"
Zhang Xian was deeply moved. "Yinyin, you’re truly remarkable. Reaching the Golden Core is just around the corner!"

"Not at all! Here, this is for Brother, and this is for your younger sister." Lin Yinyin’s cheeks flushed pink as she handed two boxes to Zhang Xian, then turned and hurried back into the house without looking back.
Zhang Xian opened the first box and found a pair of exquisite mid-grade magical boots. Hmm, not very useful—my System Storage already contains a pile of high-grade ones.
He accepted them graciously nonetheless.
Then he opened the second box. Inside was a neatly folded set of clothing: a goose-yellow short tunic and skirt, along with matching undergarments, delicate cotton socks, and decorative pendants.
Lying on top was a silk handkerchief bearing a delicate inscription: "I’ve used this myself. Your younger sister should like it."
Zhang Xian’s face turned dark with frustration. Does she think I’m some kind of pervert?!
He wanted to explain but didn’t know where to begin. Forget it—let her be happy. Her future cultivation resources still rely on me anyway.
"Focus on your cultivation. I’ll take care of all your resources from now on," Zhang Xian sent via transmission.
Inside the house, Lin Yinyin glanced at Zhang Xian’s message, and her lips curved into a faint smile. So I guessed correctly!
My Brother is a pervert—he has a fetish for personal items!
This was the conclusion she had painstakingly reached over the past few months. Her Brother wasn’t good with words, but she had to be understanding.
He was too shy to ask directly, so I had to take the initiative myself!
Taking such abundant resources from him in exchange for just a few personal items was a small price to pay—even if it was embarrassing.
More than a month passed. Lin Yinyin and Zhang Xian grew even closer, their cultivation progressing smoothly.
However, her communication talisman kept vibrating with occasional messages, causing Lin Yinyin to furrow her brow slightly.
These days, almost all the "fish" in her pond had been driven away, except for one persistent suitor—Zhao Jia.
"Yinyin, are you there? You haven’t responded to me at all. Can we talk in person?"
"Yinyin, just one meeting would be enough."
"After all my gestures of affection—can’t you even spare me a single meeting? I’m waiting for you at the teahouse not far from your residence."
Zhao Jia had just sent this latest message.
Lin Yinyin squeezed her communication talisman tightly, her lips pressed together. Is he following me?
Zhao Jia had been in a terrible mood lately, plagued by rumors and gossip.

Many people at the mine admired Lin Yinyin, and Zhao Jia was considered the most competitive suitor—everyone knew this. He had long regarded Lin Yinyin as his exclusive possession, believing it was only a matter of time before she became his. But suddenly, news spread that Lin Yinyin had been acting intimately with a stranger. They had even entered a certain residence together and hadn’t emerged for days!
Zhao Jia felt thoroughly betrayed, as if he were wearing a massive green hat. Even when miners whispered amongst themselves, he couldn’t help but feel they were mocking him.

Since their parting at the restaurant, he hadn’t seen Lin Yinyin again. Occasionally, they exchanged messages, but her replies had grown increasingly distant, filled with clear rejections. Eventually, she stopped responding altogether.
He knew exactly who the man was—a cultivator who had once appeared at the mine, nothing more than a pervert!
So he launched a private investigation into Zhang Xian. The more he investigated, the angrier he became.
This so-called "Senior" wasn’t a Senior at all—he was just a Qi Refining cultivator over a hundred years old, a complete piece of trash! How dare he lay a hand on Yinyin!

Even more infuriating was that he had deceived Zhao Jia at the restaurant, presenting himself as a "Senior" to Yinyin, causing her to regard that trash with respect. In effect, Zhao Jia had personally pushed his beloved woman into the arms of another. Every time he thought about this, he was consumed by rage, ready to spit blood.
A moment later, Lin Yinyin arrived.
"Senior Brother Zhao, what do you want to talk to me about?" Lin Yinyin wore plain clothes, her expression devoid of emotion.
Perhaps it was because of her recent breakthrough, but Lin Yinyin looked even more radiant without makeup.

In the past, Lin Yinyin always wore a gentle smile, no matter who she was speaking to. But Zhao Jia had never seen her so cold and aloof. This stark contrast only intensified the burning desire in his gut.
I must have her!
"Little Yinyin, you’ve finally come! I’ve ordered your favorite Bi Chun tea," Zhao Jia said, forcing a smile.
Lin Yinyin sat down. "I’ll drink the tea, but I think I’ve made some things perfectly clear."

"Yinyin, for so many years, you’ve always known my feelings. Why can’t you accept me? Instead, you follow that pervert Zhang Xian—someone you’ve only known for a few days?" Zhao Jia’s voice trembled with emotion.
Lin Yinyin shook her head. "If you’re going to keep talking like this, then there’s no need for us to meet."

"I’m telling you, he’s not a Senior at all—he’s just a Qi Refining cultivator over a hundred years old, a complete piece of trash! Who knows where he got those Spirit Stones—maybe they were even stolen from our own mine! How could he possibly deserve you? How does he even compare to me?"

Lin Yinyin certainly knew this. At first, she had thought Zhang Xian was deliberately pretending to be weak to catch a tiger ("playing the pig to eat the tiger"), but after spending time with him, she realized he truly wasn’t a high-level Senior.

She replied calmly, "So what? Senior Brother Zhao, I’ve appreciated your kindness over the years, but that doesn’t mean I have to become your partner. Whom I choose is my business, and it has nothing to do with you."
"Nothing to do with me? Which time have I failed to give you extra stones? How many gifts have I given you over the years? And now you’re telling me it has nothing to do with me?"

Lin Yinyin casually flipped her hand, and five mid-grade Spirit Stones appeared on the table. Her tone remained unchanged. "I can return your gifts. These five stones are enough to cover everything you’ve given me over the years, and the rest can be considered interest."
Zhao Jia’s face contorted in anger. "You bitch—"
Before he could finish his sentence, he felt a large hand resting heavily on his shoulder.
"Jia'er, remember this: Never lose your composure in any situation!"
Zhao Jia spun around and gasped. "Grandfather!!" He jumped up in fright.

chapters.title: Chapter 19 I Never Resort to Coercion
paragraphs: Behind Zhao Jia stood none other than his grandfather, the Patriarch of the Zhao family—Zhao Chengyue. The visitor was tall and imposing, with snow-white hair and beard, yet his features bore the unlined, stern countenance of a young man. He was a renowned Golden Core cultivator in Shuiyun City.

"Grandfather, why have you come?" Zhao Jia asked, visibly flustered. He rarely saw Zhao Chengyue more than twice a year. After all, his grandfather had over a hundred grandchildren, and Zhao Jia was just one unremarkable face among the crowd.

"Little Friend Lin Yinyin, allow me to apologize on behalf of Jia'er," Zhao Chengyue said, his voice booming like a temple bell. Unbeknownst to anyone, the entire teahouse had been emptied, leaving only the three of them.
Lin Yinyin’s body tensed, her nerves palpable.

Zhao Chengyue’s name carried immense weight. He had risen to fame over six hundred years ago, starting as an obscure wandering cultivator and gradually building the Zhao family into the powerhouse it was today. With a cultivation base at the third level of the Golden Core realm, he was among the most prominent figures not only in Shuiyun City but in the surrounding regions. Even without making a move, his mere presence felt like a towering mountain pressing down upon one's soul.
"Greetings, Senior," Lin Yinyin replied, performing a respectful bow.
"I hear you’ve been living with someone named Zhang Xian lately," Zhao Chengyue said calmly, his tone carrying an inexplicable pressure.

"Yes." Have you come here to settle matters for your grandson? Lin Yinyin wondered, puzzled. Her entanglements with Zhao Jia were trivial, hardly worth the attention of such a formidable figure. Could it be...
"The old man has no interest in your affairs. I’ve come for Zhang Xian."
"For Zhang Xian? Why involve me?" Lin Yinyin glanced at Zhao Jia, only to find him equally bewildered.

"It’s like this: every so often, the Zhao family consults the Celestial Eye Formation. We discovered that Zhang Xian mined Jade Crystal Essence from our mine, failed to turn over the mandatory eighty percent, and instead hoarded it all, secretly selling it to the Yunshang Pavilion. He violated our family’s rules, and I’m here to reclaim what’s rightfully ours."

Jade Crystal Essence was a legendary treasure of the mines, far more precious than even the finest Spirit Stones. Legend had it that if Jade Crystal Essence were placed in an ordinary mine, it would eventually give rise to a new Spirit Vein. Moreover, it was an essential ingredient for crafting top-tier spiritual artifacts—its value could scarcely be overstated.

"Is this true, Grandfather?" Zhao Jia exclaimed, his anger mounting. "That bastard Zhang Xian seduced my woman, and now he’s stealing resources from our own family! He deserves to die a thousand deaths!"

Zhao Chengyue cast a disdainful glance at his foolish grandson, then turned to Lin Yinyin, who remained silent. He produced a jade slip and placed it on the table. "This contains evidence of his dealings with the mine and the Yunshang Pavilion."

Zhao Jia’s voice rose sharply, furious. "Yinyin, didn’t I tell you? That scoundrel is no good! He even dared to steal our family’s Jade Crystal Essence! Next time I see him, I’ll tear him limb from limb!"
Lin Yinyin’s heart trembled as she stared at the jade slip. The reason behind Zhang Xian’s sudden wealth finally became clear.
Indeed, when they first met, he was already over a hundred years old yet still only at the Qi Refining stage. Without some extraordinary fortune, how could he have become so affluent overnight?
"I don’t believe it," Lin Yinyin murmured, shaking her head.
"Yinyin!" Zhao Jia tried to intervene.
"Be silent!" Zhao Chengyue bellowed.
Zhao Jia instantly wilted, shrinking into silence.

Zhao Chengyue continued in a resonant voice, "I never resort to coercion. I can summon the City Lord of Shuiyun City and the Chief Steward of the Yunshang Pavilion for a direct confrontation—provided you, Lin Yinyin, bring Zhang Xian back to the mine."
The reason was obvious: even someone as powerful as Zhao Chengyue couldn’t act openly within the city’s protective formation.

"In return, I guarantee that one-tenth of the Jade Crystal Essence will go to you. Another tenth will go to the City Lord and the Yunshang Pavilion. I will take only what’s rightfully mine—eighty percent."

Seeing that Lin Yinyin remained silent, Zhao Chengyue pressed on. "I am willing to swear a Heaven Oath on these terms. If you bring Zhang Xian, I promise not to lay a hand on you. And if my grandson Zhao Jia continues to harass you, I’ll break his legs myself."
"With one-tenth of the Jade Crystal Essence, your path to immortality will be assured."
Lin Yinyin’s breath caught, her nails digging deeply into her palms. After a long pause, she finally whispered, "Swear the Heaven Oath, and I’ll bring Zhang Xian back to the mine."
Zhao Chengyue’s lips curved into a faint smile. As promised, he invoked the Heaven Oath, a golden aura coalescing at his brow to seal the vow.
Lin Yinyin sighed with relief. In the cultivation world, breaking a Heaven Oath could lead to Heart Demons at best, or utter annihilation at worst.

"Lin Yinyin, please keep this matter confidential with Zhang Xian. Just bring him when the time comes. Otherwise, if he hides within Shuiyun City, it benefits no one. I’ll await your news." With that, Zhao Chengyue beckoned Zhao Jia and departed the teahouse.
Left alone, Lin Yinyin sat silently, staring blankly into her teacup.

"Grandfather! Leave that scoundrel Zhang Xian to me! I’ll deal with him however I please! And Yinyin... Grandfather, you’re not really going to let her go, are you? I must have her!" Zhao Jia growled fiercely as he followed Zhao Chengyue back to the Zhao estate.
Zhao Chengyue glared at Zhao Jia’s pathetic demeanor. His anger rose, yet he restrained himself. "Jia'er, there was never any Jade Crystal Essence."
"None? Then—"

"The Sect Master of the Shuiyun Sect and the Chief Steward of the Baoqing Workshop were also fakes. Zhang Xian holds a secret, and I must uncover it. All you need to do is maintain contact with Lin Yinyin and persuade her to bring Zhang Xian out of the city as soon as possible."
"During this time, treat Lin Yinyin with care and patience. Don’t be hasty. Once Zhang Xian is gone..."
"...that girl will naturally belong to you.
Zhao Jia was first stunned, then excited. "Yes, Grandfather! Whether the Jade Crystal Essence is real or not doesn’t matter. All I want is Zhang Xian dead—and Lin Yinyin for myself!"

Zhao Chengyue sighed softly. His descendants were nothing but inept individuals like Zhao Jia; otherwise, he wouldn’t have to chase every single opportunity himself. Once he was gone, the Zhao family would cease to exist.
It was only when Zhao Jia sent people to investigate Zhang Xian that Zhao Chengyue took notice.

Zhao Chengyue wielded immense influence in Shuiyun City, and his investigations revealed far more than Zhao Jia’s. He discovered that Zhang Xian not only lavished money on Lin Yinyin at the Yunshang Pavilion but had also personally purchased over ten mid-grade magical artifacts there.
Low cultivation, extravagant spending. And this was likely just the tip of the iceberg. Zhao Chengyue, nearing the end of his lifespan, needed these secrets desperately.
Lin Yinyin returned to the residence in a daze, only to find Zhang Xian engrossed in a book, comparing it to the greenery she had planted in the courtyard.
Upon seeing her, Zhang Xian said, "I’ll be in seclusion for a while longer. Yinyin, see if there’s anything you desire—I’ll buy it for you."
"I don’t need anything anymore, Brother. I lack for nothing at the moment." Lin Yinyin sat numbly on a stone bench in the courtyard.
"Brother, why do you spend every day reading these books instead of studying cultivation techniques? These spiritual herbs are just for us girls to play with."
"Do you think I don’t want to learn? My foundation is too weak!" Zhang Xian lamented internally, on the verge of tears.

Yet he merely replied calmly, "You don’t understand. Knowledge lies within books. Though my body remains in Shuiyun City, daily study allows me to comprehend the affairs of the world. Daytime for reading, nighttime for cultivation—both are equally important."

Lin Yinyin pursed her lips. Over the past few days, both she and Zhang Xian had advanced rapidly in cultivation, reaching the second level of Foundation Establishment. But now, with the diminishing potency of the Foundation Pills, their progress had begun to slow.
Noticing Lin Yinyin’s lack of enthusiasm, Zhang Xian said, "Let me paint you a picture first. When your cultivation rises further, I’ll surprise you again."
He thought to himself, Then I’ll arm you with top-grade magical artifacts, arrange for you to receive a Gold-Infused Pill, and offer another generous reward.
But seeing Lin Yinyin still lost in thought, Zhang Xian shook his head. Women had those days when they were unpredictable—something he knew all too well.
[Ding! Current Favorability: 50.]
"Brother, I have something to tell you."

After a long pause, she finally whispered, "Swear the Heaven Oath, and I’ll bring Zhang Xian back to the mine."
Zhao Chengyue’s lips curved into a faint smile.
As promised, he invoked the Heaven Oath, a golden aura coalescing at his brow to seal the vow.
Lin Yinyin sighed with relief.
In the cultivation world, breaking a Heaven Oath could lead to Heart Demons at best, or utter annihilation at worst.
"Lin Yinyin, please keep this matter confidential with Zhang Xian.
Just bring him when the time comes.
Otherwise, if he hides within Shuiyun City, it benefits no one.
I’ll await your news." With that, Zhao Chengyue beckoned Zhao Jia and departed the teahouse.
Left alone, Lin Yinyin sat silently, staring blankly into her teacup.
"Grandfather!
Leave that scoundrel Zhang Xian to me!
I’ll deal with him however I please!
And Yinyin...
Grandfather, you’re not really going to let her go, are you?
I must have her!" Zhao Jia growled fiercely as he followed Zhao Chengyue back to the Zhao estate.
Zhao Chengyue glared at Zhao Jia’s pathetic demeanor.
His anger rose, yet he restrained himself.
"Jia'er, there was never any Jade Crystal Essence."
"None?
Then—"
"The Sect Master of the Shuiyun Sect and the Chief Steward of the Baoqing Workshop were also fakes.
Zhang Xian holds a secret, and I must uncover it.
All you need to do is maintain contact with Lin Yinyin and persuade her to bring Zhang Xian out of the city as soon as possible."
"During this time, treat Lin Yinyin with care and patience.
Don’t be hasty.
Once Zhang Xian is gone..."
"...that girl will naturally belong to you.
Zhao Jia was first stunned, then excited.
"Yes, Grandfather!
Whether the Jade Crystal Essence is real or not doesn’t matter.
All I want is Zhang Xian dead—and Lin Yinyin for myself!"
Zhao Chengyue sighed softly.
His descendants were nothing but inept individuals like Zhao Jia; otherwise, he wouldn’t have to chase every single opportunity himself.
Once he was gone, the Zhao family would cease to exist.
It was only when Zhao Jia sent people to investigate Zhang Xian that Zhao Chengyue took notice.
Zhao Chengyue wielded immense influence in Shuiyun City, and his investigations revealed far more than Zhao Jia’s.
He discovered that Zhang Xian not only lavished money on Lin Yinyin at the Yunshang Pavilion but had also personally purchased over ten mid-grade magical artifacts there.
Low cultivation, extravagant spending.
And this was likely just the tip of the iceberg.
Zhao Chengyue, nearing the end of his lifespan, needed these secrets desperately.
Lin Yinyin returned to the residence in a daze, only to find Zhang Xian engrossed in a book, comparing it to the greenery she had planted in the courtyard.
Upon seeing her, Zhang Xian said, "I’ll be in seclusion for a while longer.
Yinyin, see if there’s anything you desire—I’ll buy it for you."
"I don’t need anything anymore, Brother.
I lack for nothing at the moment." Lin Yinyin sat numbly on a stone bench in the courtyard.
"Brother, why do you spend every day reading these books instead of studying cultivation techniques?
These spiritual herbs are just for us girls to play with."
"Do you think I don’t want to learn?
My foundation is too weak!" Zhang Xian lamented internally, on the verge of tears.
Yet he merely replied calmly, "You don’t understand.
Knowledge lies within books.
Though my body remains in Shuiyun City, daily study allows me to comprehend the affairs of the world.
Daytime for reading, nighttime for cultivation—both are equally important."
Lin Yinyin pursed her lips.
Over the past few days, both she and Zhang Xian had advanced rapidly in cultivation, reaching the second level of Foundation Establishment.
But now, with the diminishing potency of the Foundation Pills, their progress had begun to slow.
Noticing Lin Yinyin’s lack of enthusiasm, Zhang Xian said, "Let me paint you a picture first.
When your cultivation rises further, I’ll surprise you again."
He thought to himself, Then I’ll arm you with top-grade magical artifacts, arrange for you to receive a Gold-Infused Pill, and offer another generous reward.
But seeing Lin Yinyin still lost in thought, Zhang Xian shook his head.
Women had those days when they were unpredictable—something he knew all too well.
[Ding!
Current Favorability: 50.]
"Brother, I have something to tell you."

chapters.title: Chapter 20 Surprise or Not
paragraphs: Lin Yinyin ultimately decided to reveal everything about Zhao Chengyue, including their entire plan.
Zhang Xian listened silently, lost in thought. He had anticipated being targeted, but never imagined it would happen so soon.

Having spent some time in the cultivation world, he knew that every cultivation city in the Southern Region was protected by a Zhou Tian Protective Formation, one that only Nascent Soul cultivators could breach. Yet absolute safety was an illusion, for even the creators of these formations were human—and humans could always be bribed.
Zhao Chengyue had been entrenched in Shuiyun City for years; it was impossible to rule out the possibility that he possessed methods to disable the Zhou Tian Formation.
"Why did you choose me?" Zhang Xian asked.

Lin Yinyin shook her head. "It wasn’t that I chose you—it was that I didn’t trust the Zhao family. Their reputation is terrible. Zhao Chengyue speaks grandly of righteousness, but everyone in Shuiyun City knows where his seventy concubines came from, and about his shadowy enterprises."

"Evidence can be fabricated, and his reasons for demanding a face-to-face confrontation were equally unreliable. As long as he lured me to the mine, neither of us would have any say in the matter afterward. When I asked him to swear a Heavenly Oath, it was merely to stall him."
A clever little girl, Zhang Xian thought, a hint of admiration crossing his face. Originally, he had regarded her merely as a walking ATM, but now he had to revise his assessment upward.
"I come from a Small World, rich in spiritual energy and abundant resources. But it has its flaws, and the reason lies in a Heavenly Oath—I cannot disclose it."

"And if our world’s cultivation levels are too high, we cannot easily pass through the world’s barriers. For now, only I have come here first," Zhang Xian explained slowly, deciding to create a plausible identity in the cultivation world.
"So your actual cultivation level wasn’t Qi Refining—it was only lowered artificially to allow you to enter this world, right?" Lin Yinyin’s eyes lit up.
"Yes, exactly."

"No wonder when I first saw you, your bone structure and age seemed over a hundred, yet your cultivation level was only Qi Refining! I wondered who this wandering cultivator was, older than my grandfather yet lower in cultivation than I was!" Lin Yinyin murmured softly. "And then you cultivated so rapidly afterward—your talent must be extraordinary, Brother Zhang Xian!"
Zhang Xian remained silent.
Lin Yinyin’s heart raced. She never imagined that behind Brother Zhang Xian lay the power of an entire Small World! Oh, I must hold onto this powerful ally tightly!

There were over three thousand Small Worlds discovered in the Southern Region, ranging in size from a single mountain range to vast expanses spanning tens of thousands of square li, even reaching thirty percent of the Southern Region’s area. Legend had it that the Southern Region’s top sect, Lingxu Sect, originated from one such Small World.
"To put it simply, your brother’s family owns a mine. So don’t feel burdened when accepting gifts from me. You are my guide in this world, and these gifts are rightfully yours," Zhang Xian continued.
"Mn!" Lin Yinyin nodded, then grew troubled again. "But what about Zhao Chengyue?"
For several days, Zhao Jia had been restless, patiently coaxing Lin Yinyin with kind words. Finally, he received a message:
"Meet at the mine tomorrow afternoon."
Success! Zhao Jia was overcome with excitement and immediately reported to his ancestor.
The next day, at noon.
"Registered Disciples Lu Ren and Long Tao, heading to Langshan to gather Ghost Spirit Grass. Requesting mission execution." Two cultivators entered the Shuiyun Sect’s Steward Hall.

The steward examined their tokens, verified the mission list, and nodded. "Take the teleportation array, pay ten low-grade Spirit Stones, and arrive directly at the foot of Langshan." He checked their cultivation levels—both were only at mid-stage Qi Refining—and added a warning: "Langshan is infested with spider swarms, some of which are poisonous. Be careful!"
A dark-skinned male cultivator handed over the Spirit Stones and said awkwardly, "Thank you, Senior Brother."
The steward accepted the stones, and the two stepped into one of the teleportation arrays. Light rippled, and their figures vanished in an instant.
Swish! In another flash, the two appeared at the foot of a mountain range.
Langshan, two thousand li from Shuiyun City.
The nearest cultivation city to Langshan was Yiyang, approximately nine hundred li away.

Upon landing, the two exchanged smiles and immediately set off toward Yiyang. As they quickened their pace, their cultivation levels gradually rose, eventually reaching Foundation Establishment, and their appearances transformed into those of Zhang Xian and Lin Yinyin.

Lin Yinyin secretly rejoiced. Registered disciples of the Shuiyun Sect had virtually no entry barriers, making it easy to purchase their identities on the black market and then obtain a corresponding mission. Using the sect’s teleportation array to leave the city was the fastest method!
She had pretended to send Zhao Jia a false message, then slipped away ahead of time—likely while Zhao Jia was busy setting up at the mine...
Suddenly, the sun disappeared. The moon emerged, and the stars reversed their course.
The space around Zhang Xian and Lin Yinyin seemed to freeze, instantly shifting from day to night, with a bright moon hanging high in the sky.
"Surprise or not?"
Zhao Jia stood atop a nearby rock, clad in white, hands clasped behind his back.
"This is the Star River Divine Lock Formation! Zhao has been waiting for you both for a long time! Hahaha!" Zhao Jia laughed heartily, feeling more handsome than ever before.
At the same moment, behind Zhao Jia appeared a figure in a green robe, a middle-aged male cultivator with a long beard, carrying a broad sword case on his back.

"Elder Song!" Lin Yinyin gasped in horror. It was none other than Elder Song, the Outer Gate Grand Elder of the Shuiyun Sect, whose cultivation had reached the Eighth Level of Foundation Establishment.

"You wretched woman! The ancestor was right—you really ran off with this dog of a man! You thought you were clever, didn’t you? Ha! Those two identities you bought on the black market were deliberately sold to you by our Elder Song!"
Elder Song spoke sternly, "Lin Yinyin, we were fellow disciples once. I don’t wish to harm you. Step aside!"
With that, he snapped his fingers, and the sword case behind him sprang open, releasing five long swords in rapid succession, hovering motionless in mid-air.
Lin Yinyin’s eyes filled with tears, while Zhao Jia felt an unparalleled sense of delight. Now, he wanted nothing more than to utterly humiliate Lin Yinyin right before Zhang Xian’s eyes.
He grinned wickedly, "Yinyin, it’s not too late to regret it! Just return to my side!
"Really?" Lin Yinyin’s voice trembled with despair.
"Of course!" Zhao Jia’s heart leapt with joy. As expected, at the brink of life and death, Lin Yinyin would still change her mind.
Lin Yinyin immediately released Zhang Xian’s hand, murmuring apologetically, "I’m sorry," and stepping aside.
Zhang Xian merely sighed deeply, refusing to look at her!
Zhao Jia laughed even more gleefully. "Lin Yinyin, you are mine!"
"Elder Song, destroy him!" Zhao Jia commanded coldly, then lightly leaped toward Lin Yinyin, intending to embrace her and watch Zhang Xian die with his own eyes.
In mid-air, he saw Lin Yinyin waving to him.
Oh? Yinyin is being so proactive?
"Beware!" Elder Song bellowed.
But before Zhao Jia could react, a silver python shot forth from Lin Yinyin’s hand, swiftly wrapping itself around him several times, binding him like a rice dumpling.
Zhao Jia’s spiritual energy was sealed by the silver python artifact, causing him to plummet from mid-air, landing face-first on the ground.

Meanwhile, on the other side, Zhang Xian struck first, unexpectedly unleashing a Spirit Talisman. A bolt of thunder crashed down from beneath the moon, instantly shattering Elder Song’s sword formation.
An Exquisite-Grade Spirit Talisman! Elder Song was utterly terrified.

Exquisite-grade talismans were extraordinarily rare, equivalent to the full-force attack of a late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator. Elder Song was nearly frightened out of his wits—how could a mere second-level Foundation Establishment cultivator possess such a talisman? How could he possibly refine it?
Fortunately, Elder Song reacted swiftly, letting out a strange cry and leaping into the air.

In mid-air, he glimpsed a streak of azure light faster than any artifact he had ever seen, followed by a dizzying sensation. His vision spun wildly until the scene finally froze on the sight of his own headless body.
What was that? I’ve been beheaded by a single sword strike?!
Another bolt of thunder descended, obliterating Elder Song’s head and consciousness along with it.
All of this transpired in the blink of an eye. Zhao Jia, his face smeared with blood, was still struggling to rise when he saw Zhang Xian’s smiling face.
"Surprise or not?"
