chapters.title: Chapter 21 Come At Me!
paragraphs: Zhao Jia’s face was the color of ash, his entire body trembling uncontrollably. Elder Song, an expert at the eighth level of Foundation Establishment, was just... dead?

He and Elder Song were at the third and eighth levels of Foundation Establishment, respectively. They had assumed that capturing Zhang Xian and Lin Yinyin—both merely at the second level—would be as effortless as turning over a hand. Who could have imagined that before they could even make a move, one would be dead and the other injured?
Zhang Xian paid him no further mind. Instead, he shouted toward a spot not far away, "Old ghost, quit hiding! Come out now, or your little grandson is finished!"

Scarcely had the words left his mouth when a streak of crimson flame descended from the heavens. The ground within a ten-zhang radius instantly melted into glass, and the tremendous impact swept outward like a hurricane. Zhang Xian immediately deployed two spirit talismans; they transformed into earthen shields, blocking the residual shockwaves.
As the flames dissipated, a figure with white hair and a white beard appeared. It was Zhao Chengyue.
"Whoa!" Zhang Xian exclaimed in exaggerated surprise.

Beside him, Lin Yinyin’s face was pale and bloodless; the crushing pressure of a Golden Core cultivator made it difficult for her to even breathe. Even though Zhang Xian had warned her that they might encounter Zhao Chengyue, facing the patriarch in person sent a chill through her limbs.
"Grandfather, save me!" Zhao Jia screamed.
"Shut up!" Zhang Xian raised his hand and slapped Zhao Jia hard across the face. The smack echoed crisply as several teeth flew from Zhao Jia’s mouth.
Zhao Chengyue’s expression remained impassive. He didn’t so much as glance at his pitiful grandson, merely speaking in a cold tone. "Little Friend Zhang, how did you discover my presence?"
"I guessed. A simple bluff, and out you came."

"Hah!" Zhao Chengyue shook his head. He glanced at the headless corpse in the distance and sighed. "Little friend, what ruthless methods. Two Profound-grade Thunder Talismans to take Elder Song’s life. If I am not mistaken, that flying sword you used just now is a top-grade magic artifact."
"Patriarch Zhao has a keen eye." With a thought from Zhang Xian, a fiery red longsword materialized, hovering threateningly directly above Zhao Jia’s head.
Zhao Chengyue fell silent. Zhang Xian’s decisiveness in killing made even his eyelids twitch.

He was particularly disturbed by the second Thunder Talisman that had finished off Elder Song. At that point, Elder Song had already lost his head and any ability to resist, yet Zhang Xian had still thrown out another expensive talisman to ensure his destruction on the spot.

A single Profound-grade Thunder Talisman was worth over a thousand mid-grade spirit stones. Many Foundation Establishment cultivators couldn't afford one in their entire lifetimes. Yet, this boy tossed them out as if they were free. Coupled with such ruthless decisiveness... Elder Song did not die unjustly.
Furthermore, that fiery red longsword was top-tier, even among top-grade magic artifacts.
Zhao Chengyue pondered this. Even he had only refined three top-grade magic artifacts in his life. This Zhang Xian was extraordinary, carrying heavy treasures far beyond what he had imagined.

"Patriarch Zhao, how about this: I release your grandson and gift you this magic sword as compensation? We act as if we never met today. What do you say?" Zhang Xian proposed, seeing Zhao Chengyue remain silent for so long.
"Agreed! Release Jia’er and sever your blood bond with the magic weapon. This old man might even be willing to befriend you."

"No, no, no! You first dispel this grand formation and let Yinyin and me enter Yiyang City. Once we are safe, I will hand over your grandson and the magic weapon with both hands, respectfully. Then, I’ll set up a banquet to personally apologize to you."
After a long pause, Zhao Chengyue finally snorted. "Are you joking with this old man?"
"You started the joke."
"You don't actually think a few measly spirit talismans and one top-grade magic weapon are enough to challenge this old man, do you?!" Zhao Chengyue said coldly.
His sleeves billowed without wind as the terrifying pressure of his Golden Core cultivation flooded the area like a rising tide.
Without warning, several fiery serpents shot out from cracks in the ground, intertwining in mid-air to form a crimson cage that trapped Zhang Xian inside.
"Grandfather—!"
Zhao Jia’s scream was abruptly cut off as the fiery serpents incinerated him, reducing him to nothing more than a puddle of bloody water.

Zhang Xian had been prepared for this; he had never truly considered Zhao Jia as leverage against a man like this. With swift reflexes, he threw out another spirit talisman. It condensed into stone armor, wrapping around him in a protective sphere to block the assault of the fire serpents.
Simultaneously, Zhang Xian’s red longsword shot out with a sharp whistle, heading straight for Zhao Chengyue’s face.
Zhao Chengyue brought two fingers together, clamping onto the sword tip with ease, and immediately forced it down, binding it to the ground.
"You actually have a Profound-grade Stone Armor Talisman as well." Furious to the extreme, Zhao Chengyue channeled his spiritual power, causing the aura of the crimson serpents to intensify.
"Brother Zhang Xian!" Lin Yinyin, looking deathly pale, moved to help.
Zhao Chengyue flicked his sleeve, sending out a wave of force. However, a water shield suddenly formed in front of Lin Yinyin, blocking the attack.
Yet another Profound-grade spirit talisman!

"Let’s see how many more you have!" Zhao Chengyue’s hair and beard bristled with rage. He suddenly clenched his hand in mid-air. The crimson fiery serpents exploded with a boom, shattering the stone armor... only to reveal another layer of stone armor beneath it.
Another one!
A vein throbbed violently at Zhao Chengyue’s temple. Then, he saw two more streaks of light shoot out from within the broken armor, heading straight for his face.
Two top-grade magic swords: one azure like ice, the other wreathed in green wind energy.

Zhao Chengyue snorted coldly. His hands formed seals, and a layer of crimson light instantly enveloped him. A black short blade flew from his sleeve, slicing through the air to deflect the incoming ice sword. Immediately after, his figure shifted like a ghost; flames gathered at his fingertips as he repelled the wind sword with a blast of force.
However, just as he thought he had blocked every attack...
The two magic swords, along with the fire-attribute sword originally bound to the ground, suddenly trembled violently in unison. Blinding light erupted from their blades simultaneously!
Zhao Chengyue’s pupils contracted sharply. Before he could react—
BOOM!!!
All three swords self-destructed violently!

A chaotic storm of spiritual power swept outward; waves of fire, frost shards, and wind blades intertwined, ravaging everything within a ten-zhang radius. The ground was blasted into fragments, sending dust shooting into the sky. Although Zhao Chengyue managed to deploy his protective spiritual light in time...
He was still blasted staggering backward! His robes were torn, and his hair and beard were singed black—a truly sorry sight.
"You little beast!" Zhao Chengyue roared furiously, killing intent surging in his eyes.
How dare he self-destruct three top-grade magic swords at once?! How could he bear the cost?!
Zhao Chengyue formed a seal with one hand, and his figure abruptly vanished.
The next instant, he appeared directly above them! Both his palms pressed down fiercely, transforming into an enormous fiery palm that smashed down with thunderous force.
Lin Yinyin’s face turned as pale as paper, her pupils contracting violently. The pitch-black depths of her eyes reflected only overwhelming flames. Am I going to die?
In that split second...
Brilliant cyan light erupted around her—it was a directional teleportation Wind Spirit Talisman!
Zhang Xian suddenly appeared by her side. An ancient jade pendant bloomed with dazzling golden light, transforming into a translucent golden barrier that firmly protected both of them.
The fiery palm smashed onto the barrier, exploding with a deafening thunderclap. Scorching waves of fire spread in all directions, instantly turning the ground into scorched earth.
Shock and fury warred within Zhao Chengyue. He actually has top-grade defensive magic equipment too?!
With an enraged roar, Zhao Chengyue channeled every ounce of spiritual energy within him to its limit, hurling his own body against the golden barrier!
The barrier first showed spiderweb cracks... then shattered completely!

Amidst the shower of broken golden light, Zhao Chengyue’s right sleeve burned away completely. His exposed skin was covered in bloody gashes from the backlash damage. But, ignoring his injuries completely, he pressed down ferociously once more!

At the critical moment, a cyan talisman flew from Zhang Xian’s sleeve. As the paper ignited without wind, both he and Lin Yinyin blurred into afterimages, retreating rapidly to a spot dozens of zhang away.
Zhang Xian, holding the shaken Lin Yinyin, spat a mouthful of bloody foam and cursed, "Old thing, impressive, huh? You even smashed my magic equipment!"

Zhao Chengyue forced down the blood rising in his throat—those last two strikes had already inflicted heavy internal injuries. The self-destruction of the three swords, in particular, had nearly taken half his old life.
His mind was roiling with stormy waves. In just this short exchange, Zhang Xian had already expended four top-grade magic weapons and two Wind Talismans!
This kid’s resources were a bottomless abyss!
"This old man doesn’t believe you still have—"
Before he could finish his sentence, he saw several streaks of light suspended in mid-air behind Zhang Xian, glowing in different colors.
Clearly, five more top-grade magic swords.
Simultaneously, a cyan magical robe draped over Zhang Xian before transforming into a barrier, once again protecting both him and Lin Yinyin.

Zhang Xian swallowed a recovery pill. He raised his left hand, clutching a thick stack of spirit talismans, while his right arm held Lin Yinyin’s slender waist. He looked at the Golden Core patriarch with a sneer.
"COME AT ME!!"
Pfft!!
Zhao Chengyue finally couldn’t withstand it any longer and vomited a large mouthful of blood!

sentences.text: Zhao Jia’s face was the color of ash, his entire body trembling uncontrollably.
Elder Song, an expert at the eighth level of Foundation Establishment, was just... dead?
He and Elder Song were at the third and eighth levels of Foundation Establishment, respectively.
They had assumed that capturing Zhang Xian and Lin Yinyin—both merely at the second level—would be as effortless as turning over a hand.
Who could have imagined that before they could even make a move, one would be dead and the other injured?
Zhang Xian paid him no further mind.
Instead, he shouted toward a spot not far away, "Old ghost, quit hiding!
Come out now, or your little grandson is finished!"
Scarcely had the words left his mouth when a streak of crimson flame descended from the heavens.
The ground within a ten-zhang radius instantly melted into glass, and the tremendous impact swept outward like a hurricane.
Zhang Xian immediately deployed two spirit talismans; they transformed into earthen shields, blocking the residual shockwaves.
As the flames dissipated, a figure with white hair and a white beard appeared.
It was Zhao Chengyue.
"Whoa!" Zhang Xian exclaimed in exaggerated surprise.
Beside him, Lin Yinyin’s face was pale and bloodless; the crushing pressure of a Golden Core cultivator made it difficult for her to even breathe.
Even though Zhang Xian had warned her that they might encounter Zhao Chengyue, facing the patriarch in person sent a chill through her limbs.
"Grandfather, save me!" Zhao Jia screamed.
"Shut up!" Zhang Xian raised his hand and slapped Zhao Jia hard across the face.
The smack echoed crisply as several teeth flew from Zhao Jia’s mouth.
Zhao Chengyue’s expression remained impassive.
He didn’t so much as glance at his pitiful grandson, merely speaking in a cold tone.
"Little Friend Zhang, how did you discover my presence?"
"I guessed.
A simple bluff, and out you came."
"Hah!" Zhao Chengyue shook his head.
He glanced at the headless corpse in the distance and sighed.
"Little friend, what ruthless methods.
Two Profound-grade Thunder Talismans to take Elder Song’s life.
If I am not mistaken, that flying sword you used just now is a top-grade magic artifact."
"Patriarch Zhao has a keen eye." With a thought from Zhang Xian, a fiery red longsword materialized, hovering threateningly directly above Zhao Jia’s head.
Zhao Chengyue fell silent.
Zhang Xian’s decisiveness in killing made even his eyelids twitch.
He was particularly disturbed by the second Thunder Talisman that had finished off Elder Song.
At that point, Elder Song had already lost his head and any ability to resist, yet Zhang Xian had still thrown out another expensive talisman to ensure his destruction on the spot.
A single Profound-grade Thunder Talisman was worth over a thousand mid-grade spirit stones.
Many Foundation Establishment cultivators couldn't afford one in their entire lifetimes.
Yet, this boy tossed them out as if they were free.
Coupled with such ruthless decisiveness...
Elder Song did not die unjustly.
Furthermore, that fiery red longsword was top-tier, even among top-grade magic artifacts.
Zhao Chengyue pondered this.
Even he had only refined three top-grade magic artifacts in his life.
This Zhang Xian was extraordinary, carrying heavy treasures far beyond what he had imagined.
"Patriarch Zhao, how about this: I release your grandson and gift you this magic sword as compensation?
We act as if we never met today.
What do you say?" Zhang Xian proposed, seeing Zhao Chengyue remain silent for so long.
"Agreed!
Release Jia’er and sever your blood bond with the magic weapon.
This old man might even be willing to befriend you."
"No, no, no!
You first dispel this grand formation and let Yinyin and me enter Yiyang City.
Once we are safe, I will hand over your grandson and the magic weapon with both hands, respectfully.
Then, I’ll set up a banquet to personally apologize to you."
After a long pause, Zhao Chengyue finally snorted.
"Are you joking with this old man?"
"You started the joke."
"You don't actually think a few measly spirit talismans and one top-grade magic weapon are enough to challenge this old man, do you?!" Zhao Chengyue said coldly.
His sleeves billowed without wind as the terrifying pressure of his Golden Core cultivation flooded the area like a rising tide.
Without warning, several fiery serpents shot out from cracks in the ground, intertwining in mid-air to form a crimson cage that trapped Zhang Xian inside.
"Grandfather—!"
Zhao Jia’s scream was abruptly cut off as the fiery serpents incinerated him, reducing him to nothing more than a puddle of bloody water.
Zhang Xian had been prepared for this; he had never truly considered Zhao Jia as leverage against a man like this.
With swift reflexes, he threw out another spirit talisman.
It condensed into stone armor, wrapping around him in a protective sphere to block the assault of the fire serpents.
Simultaneously, Zhang Xian’s red longsword shot out with a sharp whistle, heading straight for Zhao Chengyue’s face.
Zhao Chengyue brought two fingers together, clamping onto the sword tip with ease, and immediately forced it down, binding it to the ground.
"You actually have a Profound-grade Stone Armor Talisman as well." Furious to the extreme, Zhao Chengyue channeled his spiritual power, causing the aura of the crimson serpents to intensify.
"Brother Zhang Xian!" Lin Yinyin, looking deathly pale, moved to help.
Zhao Chengyue flicked his sleeve, sending out a wave of force.
However, a water shield suddenly formed in front of Lin Yinyin, blocking the attack.
Yet another Profound-grade spirit talisman!
"Let’s see how many more you have!" Zhao Chengyue’s hair and beard bristled with rage.
He suddenly clenched his hand in mid-air.
The crimson fiery serpents exploded with a boom, shattering the stone armor... only to reveal another layer of stone armor beneath it.
Another one!
A vein throbbed violently at Zhao Chengyue’s temple.
Then, he saw two more streaks of light shoot out from within the broken armor, heading straight for his face.
Two top-grade magic swords: one azure like ice, the other wreathed in green wind energy.
Zhao Chengyue snorted coldly.
His hands formed seals, and a layer of crimson light instantly enveloped him.
A black short blade flew from his sleeve, slicing through the air to deflect the incoming ice sword.
Immediately after, his figure shifted like a ghost; flames gathered at his fingertips as he repelled the wind sword with a blast of force.
However, just as he thought he had blocked every attack...
The two magic swords, along with the fire-attribute sword originally bound to the ground, suddenly trembled violently in unison.
Blinding light erupted from their blades simultaneously!
Zhao Chengyue’s pupils contracted sharply.
Before he could react—
BOOM!!!
All three swords self-destructed violently!
A chaotic storm of spiritual power swept outward; waves of fire, frost shards, and wind blades intertwined, ravaging everything within a ten-zhang radius.
The ground was blasted into fragments, sending dust shooting into the sky.
Although Zhao Chengyue managed to deploy his protective spiritual light in time...
He was still blasted staggering backward!
His robes were torn, and his hair and beard were singed black—a truly sorry sight.
"You little beast!" Zhao Chengyue roared furiously, killing intent surging in his eyes.
How dare he self-destruct three top-grade magic swords at once?!
How could he bear the cost?!
Zhao Chengyue formed a seal with one hand, and his figure abruptly vanished.
The next instant, he appeared directly above them!
Both his palms pressed down fiercely, transforming into an enormous fiery palm that smashed down with thunderous force.
Lin Yinyin’s face turned as pale as paper, her pupils contracting violently.
The pitch-black depths of her eyes reflected only overwhelming flames.
Am I going to die?
In that split second...
Brilliant cyan light erupted around her—it was a directional teleportation Wind Spirit Talisman!
Zhang Xian suddenly appeared by her side.
An ancient jade pendant bloomed with dazzling golden light, transforming into a translucent golden barrier that firmly protected both of them.
The fiery palm smashed onto the barrier, exploding with a deafening thunderclap.
Scorching waves of fire spread in all directions, instantly turning the ground into scorched earth.
Shock and fury warred within Zhao Chengyue.
He actually has top-grade defensive magic equipment too?!
With an enraged roar, Zhao Chengyue channeled every ounce of spiritual energy within him to its limit, hurling his own body against the golden barrier!
The barrier first showed spiderweb cracks... then shattered completely!
Amidst the shower of broken golden light, Zhao Chengyue’s right sleeve burned away completely.
His exposed skin was covered in bloody gashes from the backlash damage.
But, ignoring his injuries completely, he pressed down ferociously once more!
At the critical moment, a cyan talisman flew from Zhang Xian’s sleeve.
As the paper ignited without wind, both he and Lin Yinyin blurred into afterimages, retreating rapidly to a spot dozens of zhang away.
Zhang Xian, holding the shaken Lin Yinyin, spat a mouthful of bloody foam and cursed, "Old thing, impressive, huh?
You even smashed my magic equipment!"
Zhao Chengyue forced down the blood rising in his throat—those last two strikes had already inflicted heavy internal injuries.
The self-destruction of the three swords, in particular, had nearly taken half his old life.
His mind was roiling with stormy waves.
In just this short exchange, Zhang Xian had already expended four top-grade magic weapons and two Wind Talismans!
This kid’s resources were a bottomless abyss!
"This old man doesn’t believe you still have—"
Before he could finish his sentence, he saw several streaks of light suspended in mid-air behind Zhang Xian, glowing in different colors.
Clearly, five more top-grade magic swords.
Simultaneously, a cyan magical robe draped over Zhang Xian before transforming into a barrier, once again protecting both him and Lin Yinyin.
Zhang Xian swallowed a recovery pill.
He raised his left hand, clutching a thick stack of spirit talismans, while his right arm held Lin Yinyin’s slender waist.
He looked at the Golden Core patriarch with a sneer.
"COME AT ME!!"
Pfft!!
Zhao Chengyue finally couldn’t withstand it any longer and vomited a large mouthful of blood!

chapters.title: Chapter 22 When We Meet Again, I Will Take Your Dog Life!
paragraphs: Despite his long-standing fame, it took Zhao Chengyue some time to calm the roiling blood in his chest after vomiting it up. Eventually, both sides began a new round of combat.
However, after the smoke cleared, despair finally dawned upon the patriarch.

This time, he had been cautious. He hadn't been directly injured by the exploding swords. But Zhang Xian was simply too shameless! Seeing that he couldn't physically harm Zhao Chengyue, Zhang Xian would decisively self-destruct his weapons the moment they made contact with Zhao’s defenses!
It was the tactic of damaging the enemy by a thousand while losing eight hundred of one's own!

Zhao Chengyue was frequently forced to play his trump cards, resulting in damage to his own foundation. Meanwhile, the result for Zhang Xian was merely the loss of another five top-grade swords, one top-grade defensive weapon, and several talismans.
And then, Zhao saw it again.
Yet another new set of five swords and a top-grade defensive robe appeared around Zhang Xian!
Zhao Chengyue was utterly dumbfounded.

He was trembling uncontrollably, every breath causing a sharp pain in his lungs—a sign of spiritual exhaustion. He hadn't been in such a wretched state for centuries. He stared fixedly at the five floating swords behind Zhang Xian and the glowing cyan robe.
"Fine! Very fine!!"

Zhao Chengyue gnashed his teeth, his voice hoarse as blood dripped from his beard. This battle had not only destroyed most of his protective treasures, but even his Purple Palace Golden Core foundation had been damaged. Meanwhile, his opponent—
Was still swallowing pills!
His resources seemed endless. How was this even possible?!
Hatred surged in his heart, yet he felt helpless. If he continued fighting, let alone killing this brat, he might forfeit his own old life here!
"Today counts as this old man’s defeat." He sighed deeply.
"You honor me." Zhang Xian’s tone was calm, but he didn't relax his vigilance in the slightest.

Zhao Chengyue closed his eyes, then suddenly waved his sleeve. Remnant spiritual power stirred up a gale, and his figure transformed into a crimson streak, fleeing far into the distance. Only his fierce words remained, drifting on the wind:
"When we meet again in the future, I will take your dog life!"
With his departure, the moon set and the sun began to rise. The Star River God-Locking Formation automatically dispelled.
Zhang Xian shook his head, thinking, These people are really uncreative. Don’t they know that fierce talk while running away just sounds lame?
He retrieved the swords and talismans but kept them in hand, fearing the old thing might circle back for an ambush.
Lin Yinyin nestled into his embrace, her eyes full of sweetness. She wiped the fine sweat from his forehead. "Brother, are you okay?
"No problem. Those weapons and talismans were already refined; activating them consumes very little energy. A few pills and I'm fine."
"I support you."
Only after entering Yiyang City did Zhang Xian completely relax his guard.
"Let’s stay at an inn and rest for a day," Lin Yinyin suggested shyly.
If I speak first, I can suggest just one room, and then...
While she was still fantasizing, Zhang Xian waved his hand and said, "We’ll buy a place directly."
Wherever he stayed, he bought a mansion. It was mainly because inn rooms were too small and he was unaccustomed to them—a habit formed over years in the Great Liang Kingdom.
"Oh." Lin Yinyin was slightly disappointed.
He spent a thousand mid-grade spirit stones and bought a mansion estate.
Lin Yinyin was no longer surprised. After all, her brother had exploded over a dozen top-grade weapons just now; she was somewhat immune to his spending habits.
They hadn't rested for long when they heard a knock at the mansion's main gate.
Zhang Xian was puzzled. They had just settled in—who would be visiting?
"Cloud Raiment Pavilion Internal Affairs Commander, Yun Xi, requests a meeting with Daoist Zhang Xian," a voice called from outside the gate.
Cloud Raiment Pavilion? Zhang Xian seemed to recall something. His fingertips lightly tapped the stone table three times, and the mansion's perimeter restrictions silently dissipated.
He rose and opened the door.

Standing there was a young male cultivator with handsome features, dressed in white brocade robes. Behind him stood two black-robed cultivators carrying a black coffin, from which a faint aura of blood seeped out.
Upon seeing Zhang Xian, the young man politely cupped his hands. "Daoist Zhang, Yun Xi has come to apologize."
Zhang Xian returned the courtesy and welcomed them into the courtyard.

Sensing the moment he saw Yun Xi, Zhang Xian noted that the man's aura was deep and steady. Though suppressed by the Zhou Heaven Protection Formation, Zhang Xian could feel that this man's cultivation was even higher than Zhao Chengyue's!
Lin Yinyin brewed tea in the front courtyard and served them both.
They sat opposite each other in the courtyard.
"To what apology does Daoist Yun refer?" Zhang Xian initiated the conversation.

"Previously, you purchased many items at our Water Cloud City branch. Unfortunately, the steward there was bribed and leaked your information, causing unnecessary trouble for you. This was our Pavilion’s negligence, and we are truly sorry."
After speaking, Yun Xi waved his hand. A box appeared on the ground, the lid opening automatically to reveal countless neatly arranged mid-grade spirit stones.
"Here are three thousand mid-grade spirit stones as compensation."
Zhang Xian merely blew on the steam rising from his tea, not even glancing at the stones. "I do not lack stones."
Yun Xi then gestured to the black-robed cultivator behind him. With a flick of a finger, the coffin lid was flung open violently.

Inside lay a blood-soaked body. It was precisely the steward who had received Zhang Xian at the branch! Now, his eyes had been gouged out and the root of his tongue severed. He could only emit hoarse gasps.
"This person leaked a guest's whereabouts. According to the Pavilion’s rules, he has been stripped of his bones and blood, and his spiritual roots have been destroyed," Yun Xi introduced calmly.
As soon as he finished speaking, the black-robed cultivator produced a short dagger, plunged it into the steward's skull, and stirred it twice. The body was completely silenced.
Gag!
Lin Yinyin, sitting to the side, nearly vomited.
Zhang Xian praised, "Your Pavilion’s rules are strict. I admire that."

Yun Xi smiled and waved his hand again. Another box appeared on the ground. An Ice Silkworm Snow Gauze Dress floated into the air, the skirt flowing like moonlight, seeming to possess a liquid quality.

"This dress is a gift for Miss Lin. Although it is mid-grade, it excels in its exquisite water affinity, making cultivation twice as effective with half the effort. Its price is comparable to top-grade artifacts."

Lin Yinyin’s heart raced. She had seen this in the jade slip catalog. It was a limited edition, hailed as a luxury item among dresses, worth a full three thousand mid-grade spirit stones! Instantly, she felt her own hundred-stone gauze dress had lost its appeal.
"The dress is accepted. Please return the stones," Zhang Xian said calmly.
Behind him, Lin Yinyin pouted. Three thousand mid-grade stones... that can buy my life! You don’t want them, but I do! My heart aches!
"This is our sincerity. Please don’t decline," Yun Xi said, bowing deeply, his posture extremely low.
Zhang Xian waved his hands repeatedly. "Truly, I do not lack stones. Just help me with a favor. The previous matters will not only be wiped clean, but we can also cooperate deeper."
"What favor? Please speak freely."
"It’s like this..." Zhang Xian repeated the fabricated origin story he had told Lin Yinyin earlier.
"So that’s how it is," Yun Xi sighed understandingly.

"As a newcomer to this great world, I am unfamiliar with this place. I just request your help to inquire about one matter. I want to know where heaven-and-earth treasures that enhance bone structure or spiritual root aptitude exist. If the Pavilion has such a treasure, I am willing to pay a high price to purchase it."

chapters.title: Chapter 23 Taught a Harsh Lesson
paragraphs: Upon hearing Zhang Xian’s request, Yun Qi let out a bitter laugh. "Fellow Daoist Zhang, it is not that I, Yun, am making excuses. Such heavenly treasures—forget my Cloud Raiment Pavilion, even if you were to search the entire Southern Region, one might not appear in a hundred years. And even if one did, the owner would be unlikely to sell it."
Cultivators valued innate talent above all else. Heavenly treasures capable of enhancing one's bone structure or spiritual roots were the most precious items in existence.

Yun Qi continued, "Twenty years ago, a buyer commissioned our Cloud Raiment Pavilion to auction a single incomplete Marrow-Cleansing Fruit. It fetched a sky-high price of four hundred thousand mid-grade spirit stones and was purchased by a mysterious cultivator."
Zhang Xian’s expression remained unchanged. "Fellow Daoist Yun need only provide me with the information; consider it a favor I owe you. Whether I can successfully bid for it is my own affair."
Seeing how casually Zhang Xian dismissed the matter actually made Yun Qi somewhat uncertain.
After speaking, Zhang Xian smiled. "Since this is a partnership, I should also show some sincerity."
Suddenly, Zhang Xian flicked his sleeve.
Whoosh.
Countless Foundation Establishment Pills poured out like a golden waterfall, piling up into a dazzling mountain on the stone table in the courtyard.

"Our minor world has recently overproduced Foundation Establishment Pills, leading to some stagnation in sales. I would like to trouble your esteemed sect to help sell them. There are nearly six thousand pills here. As a gesture of sincerity, I am willing to forgo twenty percent of the profits."

Yun Qi casually picked up one pill and saw its quality was actually slightly better than those sold in his own shops. As the Head of Internal Affairs, he understood all too well what this meant. A Foundation Establishment Pill was worth about five mid-grade spirit stones. By offering twenty percent, Zhang Xian was essentially giving up six thousand mid-grade spirit stones in pure profit.
Seeing so many Foundation Establishment Pills, Yun Qi was now completely convinced that Zhang Xian had a minor world backing him.

Without the support of a massive sect, how could one possibly refine so many pills? Moreover, producing this quantity would require an army of alchemists. Even a top-tier immortal sect like Penglai couldn't produce this many in a single year.

"This is just the first batch. If our cooperation goes smoothly, there will be more later—spirit talismans, cultivation techniques, magical instruments, and the like. Our minor world has plenty of those too, even higher grades. All can be sold to you in bulk for long-term cooperation," Zhang Xian continued to drop bombshells.
"Higher grades! And sold in bulk?" Yun Qi’s breathing immediately became heavy.
Zhang Xian nodded with an inscrutable expression.

Yun Qi accepted the Foundation Establishment Pills, his heart filled with astonishment. Nearly six thousand pills were worth almost thirty thousand mid-grade spirit stones, yet Zhang Xian hadn't even blinked. He didn't ask for a contract or seem worried about Yun Qi embezzling them.
The strength backing him must be immeasurable!

Yun Qi took a token from his robe and offered it forward. "This is our Cloud Raiment Pavilion token. I hope Fellow Daoist will accept it. Henceforth, bearing this token will make you our most honored guest."
Zhang Xian took the token and examined it repeatedly, fearing there might be some hidden mechanism.
He couldn't help it; he had died before.
Yun Qi thought he was just being naturally cautious and didn't comment further.
After some more polite exchanges, they finally parted on good terms. Yun Qi stood up with his subordinates and took his leave.
Once the outsiders were gone, Lin Yinyin immediately and excitedly picked up the Ice Silkworm Snow Gauze Dress to try it on.
The moment her fingertips touched the fabric, the dress automatically wrapped around her like a living thing. The semi-transparent gauze rippled with light, accentuating her graceful figure.
"So cool," she exclaimed softly.

The moment the gauze touched her skin, snowflake-like spiritual energy flowed along her meridians. Her tied-up hair automatically loosened, the ends dancing without wind. Even the flow of spiritual energy within her body became slightly faster.
The most exquisite part was the design at the waist—twelve strands of ice silkworm silk interlaced into butterfly wings, emitting halos with every step she took. It was exceptionally beautiful.
Lin Yinyin almost wanted to cry; it was devastatingly gorgeous!

Zhang Xian glanced at the chest on the floor containing exactly three thousand mid-grade spirit stones. Originally intended as compensation, it had been left there as a deposit for the Foundation Establishment Pills. He said nonchalantly, "Yinyin, these spirit stones are for you."
[Ding! Successfully gifted. 2,235 stones exceed Lin Yinyin's usable limit and are converted and returned as 7,650 high-grade spirit stones.]
[Ding! Current Favorability: 65.]

Heavenly treasures capable of enhancing one's bone structure or spiritual roots were the most precious items in existence.

chapters.title: Chapter 24 They’re Not Going To Do That, Are They
paragraphs: Two years passed in a flash.

During this time, Zhang Xian returned to the Great Liang Kingdom once. Li Miaoyin had successfully weathered two heavenly tribulations, officially stepping into the Foundation Establishment stage. Zhang Xian promptly sent a batch of supplies and magical treasures as congratulatory gifts.

Xuanwei cultivated to the peak of Qi Refining, nervously preparing for his heavenly tribulation. Even Yu Yun reached the mid-stage of Qi Refining. Yu Yun had left the temple and returned to the Great Liang Kingdom, determined to suppress Duke Zhenguo's influence and embark on his own path of invincibility.
Cooperation with the Cloud Raiment Pavilion grew increasingly pleasant. Zhang Xian gave up twenty percent of the profit, allowing Yun Qi to earn handsomely.

Correspondingly, Yun Qi reciprocated by crushing the Zhao Family of Tianshui City into dust. Tianshui City no longer had a Zhao Family. Zhao Chengyue retreated in disgrace, reportedly fleeing to the Southern Region’s border.

The only slight regret for Zhang Xian was that he had just reached the third stage of Foundation Establishment, while Lin Yinyin had been at the fourth stage for some time. Fortunately, though he lost in cultivation level, on another battlefield, he could always make Lin Yinyin beg for mercy repeatedly.

During this period, Lin Yinyin cultivated with exceptional diligence. There was a simple reason: Zhang Xian had placed several sets of high-grade magical instruments before her, promising that if she could refine them, he would give them to her.

Lin Yinyin immediately coveted them. High-grade magical instruments! How many Golden Core cultivators lacked high-grade instruments? Back then, Zhang Xian had relied on the advantage of his high-grade instruments to force Zhao Chengyue into a resentful retreat.

Lin Yinyin had almost succeeded in refining them while at the fourth stage of Foundation Establishment. If she reached the fifth stage, she definitely could! For this goal, she hadn't happily played with Brother Zhang Xian for months.
Today, they were eating as usual at the most expensive restaurant in Yiyang City.
Both were feasting heartily when Zhang Xian sensed an incoming message from Yun Qi.
[Three months later, the Baogingfang Auction Conference in Jade Capital City has what Fellow Daoist seeks.]

Jade Capital City differed greatly from Yiyang and Shuiyun Cities, being one of the Southern Region's top cultivation world hubs. It sat within the territory of the Lingxu Sect. The Lingxu Sect, Yunmiao Sect, Baogingfang, Chan Temple, Penglai, and the Great Xia Imperial Court were collectively known as the Southern Region's Six Top Sects.
Jade Capital City was located at the very center of Lingxu Sect territory. Rumors said the Lingxu Sect's sect pocket dimension floated above the city.
Zhang Xian's eyes lit up. It wasn't easy, but I finally waited for this.
"Yinyin, want to go to Jade Capital City?" Zhang Xian asked.

"I want to! But Brother, I feel I'm about to break through recently. Can we wait until after the breakthrough to go?" Their relationship was much closer now, but Lin Yinyin still liked calling him "Brother."
She had originally prepared to change her address to call him "Husband," but she discovered Zhang Xian liked hearing her call him "Brother," especially during their "playtime."
Thus, she kept calling him that way. No choice, she was just that considerate.
"There's an auction we can't miss," Zhang Xian said. Hearing her say she was near a breakthrough made him feel even more anxious inside.

Now, both of their cultivation resources were nearly unlimited, and Lin Yinyin's spiritual root advantage was fully displayed. If he truly allowed himself to be left behind by two stages, it would be too shameful.
"Okay, Brother!
After eating, they went to the Cloud Raiment Pavilion shop. The shop steward quickly rose to welcome them; he knew these two were honored guests of the Cloud Raiment Pavilion.
"Elder Yun Qi sent a message saying your flying boat will pass here a few days later. He told me to find you to confirm the timing and hitch a ride."

"I will check immediately!" The steward hurriedly took out his sect jade slip, looked for a moment, and said, "Yes, Fellow Daoist Zhang! Five days later, the sect's flying boat will pass Yiyang City. Elder Yun Qi instructed me to tell you beforehand."
He finished registering Zhang Xian's contact. A busy moment later, Zhang Xian saw him already sweating profusely.
This person's body is quite weak, ah. Zhang Xian was somewhat puzzled. He stood up and bid farewell. The steward bowed deeply, daring not to rise for a long time.

Are you kidding?! He had heard that a colleague in the neighboring Shuiyun City had accidentally offended this guest, and the result was torture and death, with his whole family beheaded. Such a terrifying person absolutely cannot be provoked.

Five days later, Zhang Xian and Lin Yinyin arrived at the city gate. An exquisite flying boat was already hovering mid-air. The boat's body was entirely made of thousand-year spirit wood, carved with complex array patterns. The boat's prow was carved with a spreading blue luan, lifelike in detail. Against the blue luan's background was printed a big "Cloud" character.
Someone aboard saw the two and withdrew the protective formation. Zhang Xian, hand-in-hand with Lin Yinyin, lightly leaped and landed on the deck.

Lin Yinyin excitedly boarded and ran to the shipside, leaning half her body out to look down. Shortly, the flying boat started. Yiyang City gradually shrank beneath their feet, becoming an outline on a chessboard.
The distant mountains and rivers were like an ink-wash painting scroll, shrouded in mist, making Lin Yinyin's eyes sparkle brightly.

Cultivators needed to be at the late stage of Foundation Establishment to control objects and fly, while treading the empty air required near the late stage of Golden Core. Previously, their movement was only considered a long jump. This time, she could count this as experiencing the pleasure of flight early.
"Brother, look quickly! Immortal birds over there!"
Zhang Xian shook his head, smiling. His gaze fell to the other end of the flying boat deck, where Yun Qi leaned against the railing, standing with a leisurely expression.
"Fellow Daoist Yun, long time no see." Zhang Xian walked forward, cupped his hands, and said, smiling.
Yun Qi politely returned the courtesy. But Zhang Xian’s next sentence almost made him stumble.
"How many spirit stones did this flying boat cost? How about you sell it to me?"
"Cough, cough! Fellow Daoist, don't joke. How would I know the cost? This is our sect's heritage treasure. Selling it would probably get me killed by the Pavilion Master."
"Not that you won't sell it, just that there's no suitable price. Later, help me ask for a quote," Zhang Xian continued. Various mounts were always a fatal attraction to men.
"I’ll ask." Yun Qi took it as a joke. Then the two chatted, discussing the recent situation in the Southern Region and exchanging cultivation insights. The atmosphere was quite harmonious.

"This auction isn't massive in scale, but there are many good items. The commissioned auctions are probably anonymous commissions from sect seniors. It's a pity our Cloud Raiment Pavilion didn't secure the auction rights, so I don't know much."

"There is one heavenly treasure called the Ascension Immortal Grass. The name is a bit exaggerated, but it does have the effect of improving spiritual root quality. Whether it works for your purposes cannot be guaranteed. But just the possibility will definitely fetch a sky-high price.
Zhang Xian nodded. He had already done research; ancient texts indeed recorded information about the Ascension Immortal Grass.

"Fellow Daoist truly wants to buy it. You need to prepare more funds. Also, I can promise that if you lack spirit stones for circulation, our Cloud Raiment Pavilion can advance two hundred thousand mid-grade spirit stones. Repaying with equivalent goods afterward is fine."

"Two hundred thousand? Unexpectedly, my name is so valuable." Zhang Xian mentally acknowledged Yun Qi's goodwill. They hadn't met many times over the past years, but they had cooperated frequently and gradually familiarized themselves.
"Yes, what if you run away? I'd only beg you to repay the debt," Yun Qi teased, following the banter.
"Hahaha, bring it!" Zhang Xian reached his hand out.
"Ah? You really want it?"
Zhang Xian’s voice suddenly turned a bit sneaky. "Weren't you always curious how I repelled Zhao Chengyue?"
"Hmm?" Yun Qi was immediately hooked. This was also why he had originally invested in Zhang Xian; he only knew Zhao Chengyue lost but couldn't find the reason.
"I self-detonated a dozen-plus high-grade magic swords in front of him! They almost blew him dead."
Yun Qi was shocked inwardly. Too extravagant! Wait, why is he telling me this now?
"So, I prepared to use high-grade instruments to collect your spirit stones!"
The world behind him actually mass-produces even high-grade instruments!

Yun Qi was excited beyond measure. High-grade instruments were the cultivation world's hard currency. Above high-grade, instruments already belonged to the treasure category. Each one was priceless, and nobody was willing to sell them. Those possessing such treasures across the entire Southern Region were as rare as phoenix feathers and unicorn horns.
"Go! Quick, take them out, let me see!" Yun Qi excitedly pulled Zhang Xian, entering the flying boat's interior room and casting an isolation spell.
Lin Yinyin, witnessing this scene, stood with a stunned expression. What are they going inside to take out???
They're not going to do that, are they?!
She had heard that better-looking male cultivators were easier to stray onto a crooked path. Coincidentally, both of them possessed good looks.
No! I must straighten him back! Lin Yinyin tightened her small fist. Today, I'll make Brother call my name nonstop!

chapters.title: Chapter 25 The Soundproofing Array Isn’t Very Good
paragraphs: The next day, Zhang Xian woke up refreshed and early, arriving on the deck to watch the morning mist gradually pierced by the clouds. A surge of heroic spirit welled up in his chest.
This is truly the life of cultivation!

From afar, he saw Yun Qi sitting cross-legged at the bow of the ship, practicing his breathing exercises. Zhang Xian approached and greeted him, "Fellow Daoist Yun is so diligent. Don't tell me you've been meditating here all night?"

Yun Qi turned his head, looking somewhat weary. "Fellow Daoist Zhang Xian, our flying ship is a bit old. The soundproofing arrays between the rooms aren't very good." After saying this, he patted Zhang Xian's shoulder and walked away.
Uh! Zhang Xian felt a bit awkward.
Yun Qi's room was right next to Zhang Xian's. Originally, Zhang Xian had planned to meditate in peace, but he had no choice but to run to the deck and endure the cold wind all night.
After traveling for over half a month on the flying ship, they finally arrived at Jade Capital City.

From a distance, Jade Capital City resembled an immortal city. Its walls were entirely built of white jade, gleaming with a soft luster under the sunlight. Pavilions and towers were scattered throughout the city, with the highest point being a nine-story glazed pagoda whose spire pointed directly at the heavens, faintly shimmering with spiritual light.

The flying ship slowly descended onto a landing platform outside the city, where disciples from the Cloud Raiment Pavilion were already waiting. Yun Qi led Zhang Xian and his companion off the ship, and several disciples immediately stepped forward to bow.
"Elder Yun, accommodations have been arranged," the lead disciple said respectfully.
Yun Qi nodded and turned to Zhang Xian. "Fellow Daoist Zhang, the auction will require a few more days of preparation. Why not come with me first to rest at the Cloud Raiment Pavilion's lodgings?"

Zhang Xian had originally wanted to purchase a residence in Jade Capital City. However, considering that spirit stones should be spent wisely, he had no choice but to agree. "Then I'll be imposing on you."

The Cloud Raiment Pavilion's property in Jade Capital City was located in the southern part of the city. Behind the shop was a quiet and elegant courtyard with artificial mountains, flowing water, and spiritual plants adorning it. The spiritual energy here was several times denser than outside, clearly prepared specifically for distinguished guests.

Yun Qi personally led the two into the main hall and ordered spiritual tea to be served before speaking. "Although this Treasure Azure Workshop auction is small in scale, the items are all quite valuable. Representatives from all six major powers of the Southern Region will be present, and I estimate there will also be many reclusive seniors."
Zhang Xian raised an eyebrow. "Oh? So Golden Cores will be as common as dogs, and Nascent Souls will be everywhere? A weak Foundation Establishment cultivator like me won't have much standing."

"Go on, you're the dog! Where did you hear such nonsense? Golden Core cultivators like us are considered experts even among the six major powers. As for Nascent Soul Patriarchs, there are only about ten in the entire Southern Region." Yun Qi punched Zhang Xian lightly on the arm.
"According to convention, auctions usually start with consumables like pills and talismans; then come techniques and magical instruments; finally, there are the rare treasures as the grand finale."

He paused before continuing. "The Treasure Azure Workshop's rule is that auctions must be settled with spirit stones. If you lack sufficient spirit stones, you can use equivalent treasures as collateral. However, treasures offered as collateral on-site will be valued far below market price."

After this introduction, Yun Qi took out an identity token and handed it to Zhang Xian. "This is an entry pass for the auction. It allows two people to enter together. It contains a small array that constantly changes to conceal your identity. Even the Treasure Azure Workshop itself won't know who you are."

"Look at this; this is what you call professionalism." Zhang Xian unceremoniously reached out and took it. "Your Cloud Raiment Pavilion still has a lot to learn if you want to catch up to Treasure Azure Workshop.
Yun Qi smiled. "Well, we still have to rely on Fellow Daoist Zhang Xian to take care of our business."

After exchanging a few pleasantries, Yun Qi arranged a fine guest room for Zhang Xian and whispered before leaving, "The soundproofing array has been specially re-setup, and both adjacent rooms are empty. Fellow Daoist Zhang can rest assured." He then took his leave.
Zhang Xian felt awkward again.

For several days in a row, the two wandered around Jade Capital City. This major cultivation city was far more prosperous than Yiyang. Shops lined both sides of the streets, filled with spiritual materials, magical treasures, and talismans galore. Many cultivators even set up stalls directly on the roadside, with hawking calls rising one after another.

Zhang Xian didn't find anything particularly appealing. Although there were some high-grade magical instruments and Profound-grade talismans for sale, they all required refinement and were far less useful than items produced by his system. However, several famous restaurants were quite good.

Once cultivators reach the Qi Refining stage, they can abstain from eating grains. Mundane food, if eaten too much by cultivators, generates turbid qi, hindering cultivation. Only ingredients cooked with spiritual materials are beneficial, commonly known as "spiritual feasts."
Spiritual feasts were quite expensive. In Shuicheng City and Yiyang, they represented high-end venues. But in Jade Capital City, he didn't expect that eating would require waiting in line?
Looking at the token marked "Jia Seven" in his hand, Zhang Xian felt like he had returned to his previous life.
[Ding! Discovered 92-point Daughter of Destiny Long Zhi]
Wow! Zhang Xian's hand trembled. 92 points! Big cities indeed offer more opportunities.
Apart from Zhang Lele, who had no destiny points, the highest score Zhang Xian had encountered was the 60-point Nan Gongyao. Suddenly encountering a 92-pointer left him at a loss.
Seeing Zhang Xian looking around, Lin Yinyin tugged at his sleeve. "Brother, what are you looking at?"
Zhang Xian shook his head. The system's detection range wasn't very large. In this bustling market area of Jade Capital City, finding someone face-to-face wasn't very likely.
The 60-point Nan Gongyao was already that ruthless. Who knew how brutal a 92-pointer might be?

He already had Lin Yinyin. He should focus on nurturing her well. Thinking this, Zhang Xian squeezed Lin Yinyin's small hand, saying, "It's nothing. I'm just thinking about where we should go play next."
Brother is so good! Lin Yinyin felt a surge of deep affection.
On an official road not far away, a man and a woman were strolling.

The man was tall and slender, dressed in black tight-fitting clothes with a silver mask covering half his face. The woman wore plain white robes, her figure exceptionally graceful with a slender neck, but her facial features appeared rather ordinary.
"Master, not far from here, there's a tavern. I heard they have an excellent Tianye Yuquan wine. Would you like to try it?" the man suggested.
"No."
"Then, Master, should we go first—"
"Go directly to the Glazed Pagoda. It's too noisy here. I don't like it."
"Alright." The man reluctantly agreed.
Their figures gradually faded into the distance.
Auction opening day.
The main hall of the Treasure Azure Workshop was located in the center of Jade Capital City, adjacent to the nine-story glazed pagoda.

The entire building resembled an inverted bronze cauldron. Its outer walls were carved with reliefs of the ancient mythical beast Taotie. The beast's mouth held a large "Treasure Appraisal Pearl," emitting blue light day and night. Cultivators could use it to identify the authenticity of treasures.
There were entrances and exits in all eight directions of the great cauldron. Each entrance was guarded by two Treasure Azure Workshop cultivators. Guests entered orderly using their tokens.
The auction venue was divided into three levels:
First Level: The main auction stage.
Second Level: General seating, bustling with noise.
Third Level: Gilded private boxes, about fifty, reserved for high-end clients. Yun Qi had specifically arranged a third-floor box for Zhang Xian.
This time, Yun Qi didn't accompany Zhang Xian, instead representing the Cloud Raiment Pavilion and sitting in another box.

A maidservant guided Zhang Xian and Lin Yinyin into the box labeled "Jia Seventeen," served spiritual fruits and wine, then withdrew. The box walls were carved with full array patterns, blocking divine sense. The window was covered with a gauze curtain. From inside, they could clearly see the entire venue, but outsiders couldn't peer inside at all.
Zhang Xian looked out the window. "Wow, the first floor is almost full."

chapters.title: Chapter 26 The World Will Ultimately Be Beneath My Feet
paragraphs: [Ding! Discovered 20-point Daughter of Destiny: Li Fuxi]
Zhang Xian was startled. He had discovered another one already?

His divine sense swept over the area. With the isolation array's enhancement, everyone on the second floor appeared as hazy gray figures, making it impossible to even distinguish their gender. But suddenly, above one figure's head, the name [Li Fuxi] appeared, very conspicuous.
The system is truly awesome, directly ignoring the isolation arrays. It's just a pity I can't see her appearance clearly.
Zhang Xian glanced again near Li Fuxi’s position and discovered the figure of [Long Zhi] again.
He had previously learned that third-floor boxes cost two hundred mid-grade spirit stones, while second-floor seats were only five mid-grade spirit stones.
Hah, still a 92-point Daughter of Destiny, but also a poor bastard.
Zhang Xian sat back down, ate spiritual fruits with Lin Yinyin, and quietly awaited the start of the auction.
Suddenly, the first-floor stage lit up, followed by a clear, melodious female voice resounding throughout the venue, drowning out all noise.
"Welcome, everyone!"

On the high platform, a woman dressed in red stepped out into the light. She was barefooted, her features charming, with a vermilion dot between her eyebrows. She smiled as she walked to the center of the stage. "Welcome, fellow Daoists, to the Treasure Azure Workshop auction. Today’s gathering of esteemed guests and distinguished friends has resulted in a full house. This humble woman, Zi Xiao, is honored to host this auction. It is our Treasure Azure Workshop's privilege."
"This auction has only three rules. First, do not ask about the origins of the treasures. Second, do not probe the backgrounds of the buyers. Third, the highest bidder wins."

"Pricing uses mid-grade spirit stones as the unit. If you have insufficient spirit stones, you can also use treasures as collateral on-site. Our Treasure Azure Workshop will definitely give you a satisfactory price. Of course, the collateral period is only one month. After the deadline, the collateral items belong to our Treasure Azure Workshop."

"These are the old rules. Now, let’s have less idle talk. Today’s first auction item is an Earth-grade talisman: the [Thunder Strike Talisman]. After refinement is complete, it can unleash a full-power strike equivalent to the mid-to-late Golden Core stage. Starting price: one hundred mid-grade spirit stones!"
"One hundred!"
"Two hundred!"

Zhang Xian smacked his lips. It was a pity he couldn't use it himself. The system currently gave him Profound-grade upper-tier talismans. The next step would be Earth-grade. This kind of talisman was extremely useful in battles; a Golden Core stage full-power strike could basically turn the situation around.
Lin Yinyin thought Zhang Xian was looking at the beautiful hostess, and her face was full of disdain.

That flirty dress, the slit almost reaching the root of her thigh... shameless! Later, I'll buy a set too, and only wear it for Brother Zhang Xian to see alone! My thighs and bare feet are also beautiful!
Finally, that talisman sold successfully for a price of two thousand mid-grade spirit stones.

"Today’s seventh auction item." Zi Xiao raised a delicate jade hand, and a jade box materialized from the void. "The Beauty Preservation Pill, from the hand of a mysterious alchemy master. It can preserve a youthful appearance. Starting price: five hundred mid-grade spirit stones!

Oh? Zhang Xian immediately sat upright. Cultivators relied on spiritual energy to maintain their appearance, so using a Beauty Preservation Pill saved a lot of spiritual energy. Especially for female cultivators. Moreover, the Beauty Preservation Pill also had beautifying effects, making one look natural and unadorned. This was super effective for boosting the favor of Daughters of Destiny!
Lin Yinyin’s big eyes sparkled pitifully as she looked at Zhang Xian, almost writing "Brother, I want this" on her face.
"Two thousand!" Zhang Xian bid first.
The entire venue quieted, then the second floor started buzzing with discussion.
"Damn, who the hell quadruples the price immediately?"
"It's a third-floor big shot."
"Two thousand one hundred," another third-floor box bid next.
"Four thousand!" Zhang Xian followed with another bid.
"Really damn rich! Four thousand is enough to buy my life! Others use it to beautify themselves."
"Capital is too detestable!"
"This price basically locks the throat. Last time, a black market Beauty Preservation Pill was also around this price."
"Four thousand five hundred." Someone else on the second floor bid again. Zhang Xian was startled to discover the bidder was that [Li Fuxi].
"Six thousand!" Zhang Xian continued bidding. Sorry, unfamiliar Daughter of Destiny. Let me buy one first. Later, I'll bring the Beauty Preservation Pill prices down myself.

Zi Xiao was overjoyed. The Beauty Preservation Pill price had already exceeded expectations. "Any more bids? No more bids? The Beauty Preservation Pill belongs to the Fellow Daoist in Box Jia Seven. Three——Two——"
"Seven thousand!" The bidder was the figure next to [Long Zhi].
Seems the 92-point Daughter of Destiny also loves beauty. Well, sorry again. Zhang Xian continued raising the bid. "Eight thousand!"
"Eight thousand! Eight thousand! Fellow Daoist, are you still adding?"
That figure hesitated a moment before adding again: "Eight thousand one hundred."
"Ten thousand!" Zhang Xian shouted without hesitation.
The entire venue erupted in exclamations.
"This guy is really rich! Ten thousand!"
"Ten thousand can buy two of them!
"You don't understand, this kind of thing is a rare opportunity. Just because it was cheap last time doesn't mean it will be cheap this time."
"Ten thousand spirit stones is enough for a pig to cultivate to Golden Core, right? Too damn extravagant!"
The figure next to [Long Zhi] finally quieted down, and Zhang Xian successfully won the bid.
The teleportation array lit up, signaling a successful transaction. Zhang Xian directly handed the jade box to Lin Yinyin. "Here, Yinyin, for you."
"Mmm!" Lin Yinyin was so excited she almost cried. Brother throwing money around is way too handsome! Giving gifts is even more handsome! I really can't extricate myself anymore!
With a smacking sound, Lin Yinyin kissed Zhang Xian on the cheek. "Brother Zhang Xian, I love you so much!"
She decided she would buy a set of the hostess's clothes later. She also wanted a slit up to the thigh root to secretly wear for her brother to see and give him a surprise.
[Ding! Gift Beauty Preservation Pill successful. Return: Beauty Preservation Pill x100.]
[Beauty Preservation Pill: No grade. Preserves youthful appearance. Jade bones naturally formed.]
On the other side, the figure next to [Long Zhi] almost laughed out loud.
I am Yang Poxiao, a transmigrator bearing a system, destined to become the master of this world, the world's ruler.

When I transmigrated to this world, I simultaneously awakened the [Super Apprenticeship System]. As long as I successfully become an apprentice, I receive massive system points to exchange for countless heavenly treasures.

Moreover, even more awesome is that the system carries a [Prodigy Disciple Halo]. Simply put, whatever the master has, I will slowly acquire too, including magical instruments, spiritual roots, and cultivation.

In a short ten years, I changed three masters. Now my master is the Lingxu Sect Elder Long Zhi, a peak Golden Core stage cultivator with a dragon bloodline who possesses a top-grade Thunder Spiritual Root.

And I have already reached the late Golden Core stage. Through the system store, I exchanged for a top-grade Fire Spiritual Root origin and Alchemy Grandmaster insights. Moreover, because of the [Prodigy Disciple Halo] relationship, I have now also awakened a Thunder Spiritual Root.
Just based on visible strength, I am undoubtedly the number one disciple among the third generation of the Lingxu Sect.

The Beauty Preservation Pill auctioned earlier was commissioned by me. I saw that sucker on the third floor bidding frantically, so I raised the bid a couple of times. Deducting the twenty percent commission fee, I earned an extra three thousand two hundred mid-grade spirit stones.
Hehe. This kind of foolish rich family disciple is destined to be a stepping stone on my cultivation path.
This time, my goal is to acquire the Ascension Immortal Herb to refine the long-lost Immortal Ascension Pill and push my spiritual root talent to the limit!
The world will ultimately be beneath my feet.
My beloved Master Long Zhi privately created a pen name and wrote the book <Divine Eagle Gallant>... I wonder if anyone has read it yet.

I really can't extricate myself anymore!
With a smacking sound, Lin Yinyin kissed Zhang Xian on the cheek.
"Brother Zhang Xian, I love you so much!"
She decided she would buy a set of the hostess's clothes later.
She also wanted a slit up to the thigh root to secretly wear for her brother to see and give him a surprise.
[Ding!
Gift Beauty Preservation Pill successful.
Return: Beauty Preservation Pill x100.]
[Beauty Preservation Pill: No grade.
Preserves youthful appearance.
Jade bones naturally formed.]
On the other side, the figure next to [Long Zhi] almost laughed out loud.
I am Yang Poxiao, a transmigrator bearing a system, destined to become the master of this world, the world's ruler.
When I transmigrated to this world, I simultaneously awakened the [Super Apprenticeship System].
As long as I successfully become an apprentice, I receive massive system points to exchange for countless heavenly treasures.
Moreover, even more awesome is that the system carries a [Prodigy Disciple Halo].
Simply put, whatever the master has, I will slowly acquire too, including magical instruments, spiritual roots, and cultivation.
In a short ten years, I changed three masters.
Now my master is the Lingxu Sect Elder Long Zhi, a peak Golden Core stage cultivator with a dragon bloodline who possesses a top-grade Thunder Spiritual Root.
And I have already reached the late Golden Core stage.
Through the system store, I exchanged for a top-grade Fire Spiritual Root origin and Alchemy Grandmaster insights.
Moreover, because of the [Prodigy Disciple Halo] relationship, I have now also awakened a Thunder Spiritual Root.
Just based on visible strength, I am undoubtedly the number one disciple among the third generation of the Lingxu Sect.
The Beauty Preservation Pill auctioned earlier was commissioned by me.
I saw that sucker on the third floor bidding frantically, so I raised the bid a couple of times.
Deducting the twenty percent commission fee, I earned an extra three thousand two hundred mid-grade spirit stones.
Hehe.
This kind of foolish rich family disciple is destined to be a stepping stone on my cultivation path.
This time, my goal is to acquire the Ascension Immortal Herb to refine the long-lost Immortal Ascension Pill and push my spiritual root talent to the limit!
The world will ultimately be beneath my feet.
My beloved Master Long Zhi privately created a pen name and wrote the book <Divine Eagle Gallant>...
I wonder if anyone has read it yet.

chapters.title: Chapter 27 I Have No ‘P’ Key Today
paragraphs: The auction continued.
When the second round of magic tools was being auctioned, Zhang Xian even saw items he had previously sold to the Cloud Raiment Pavilion.
One fetched six thousand mid-grade spirit stones, and another defensive magic tool sold for a high price of twelve thousand!
What absolute profiteers! Zhang Xian slapped his thigh. He had wholesaled them to Yun Qi at four thousand each. No wonder that kid Yun Qi was so eager; he had made a killing.

It seemed the Cloud Raiment Pavilion and the Treasure Azure Workshop weren't just competitors; their connections were quite tight. The magic tools he sold just a few days ago were already appearing at this auction.
Finally, it was time for the finale of rare treasures, and the atmosphere in the venue gradually built to a climax.
An entrance key to an unknown pocket realm sold for fifty thousand mid-grade spirit stones.
A damaged spiritual treasure fragment awaiting repair also fetched a high price of sixty thousand mid-grade spirit stones.

The most terrifying item was a golden accessory suspected to contain the insights of an ancient Soul Formation cultivator. After dozens of rounds of bidding, it was won by a mysterious big shot on the third floor for the astronomical price of eight hundred thousand mid-grade spirit stones, shocking the entire hall.

The Southern Region hadn't seen a Soul Formation cultivator for thousands of years; it was said even the grand elders of several sects were only at the mid-to-late Nascent Soul stage. Everyone sighed in amazement that a mere possibility of insights could command such an astronomical price. The purchasing power of top-tier big shots was truly terrifying.
Finally, it was time for the final lot: the Immortal Ascension Grass.

"This item originates from an ancient secret realm." The hostess, Zi Xiao, lightly waved her fair hand, and a phantom image of an ethereal blue spirit herb appeared, its leaves densely covered with star-like patterns. "Immortal Ascension Grass. Ancient texts record that it has a chance to improve Spirit Root quality. It is also the main ingredient for refining the Immortal Ascension Pill, though the pill formula is said to be lost. Enough digression. The starting bid is five thousand mid-grade spirit stones!"
The bidding instantly went wild!
"Ten thousand!"
"Thirty thousand!"
"Fifty thousand!"
"Two hundred thousand." Zhang Xian's voice drifted lazily yet clearly from his private box.
"Holy crap, this guy's making a move again."
"Two hundred thousand!! Unbelievably rich!"
"Who knows which top-tier family it is? Just for a chance at improving quality, and they dare bid like this."
After Zhang Xian's bid, the hall fell silent for a moment. No one continued bidding, as if stunned.

Hostess Zi Xiao quickly tried to stir up the atmosphere. "The guest in Box Jia-Seventeen bids two hundred thousand! Any further bids? Such heaven-and-earth treasures that can improve Spirit Root quality are once-in-a-millennium finds! The last time something like this appeared, it was a damaged Marrow Cleansing Fruit. This time, it's a complete Immortal Ascension Grass!"

According to ancient texts, the Marrow Cleansing Fruit's effect surpassed that of the Immortal Ascension Grass. However, last time it was a damaged fruit that sold for four hundred thousand mid-grade spirit stones at auction. It was hard to say which was more valuable compared to this complete Immortal Ascension Grass.
The hostess's hint was clear: there was still room to go higher.
"Two hundred and fifty thousand." Box Jia-Four made a move.
"Three hundred thousand." Zhang Xian continued.
"Four hundred thousand!" Box Jia-Four paused briefly before following.
"Four hundred thousand! Are there any fellow Daoists willing to go higher?" Zi Xiao's pretty face flushed with excitement.
"That's about it. Same price as last time's damaged Marrow Cleansing Fruit.
"Last time it took dozens of rounds to reach four hundred thousand; this time it hit that mark so fast."
"These people are way too rich. I'm so jealous!!"
"Five hundred thousand." Zhang Xian didn't hesitate and directly followed up.
"Holy shit!! He's starting again!!"
"Five hundred thousand! Fellow Daoist in Box Jia-Seventeen bids five hundred thousand!" Zi Xiao waved her hand and shouted; she was already satisfied with this price.
"Five hundred and fifty thousand." A voice came from the second-floor open seating area.
"There's another expert."
"What lurking bastard? How can they still add more?"
Zhang Xian glanced over casually. Oh? It was that figure next to [Long Zhi] again.
Thought he was a poor bastard; seems I misjudged him.
The bidder, Yang Poxiao, gave a sinisterly charming smile, curling his lips.
Heh. All those showing off earlier were just small fry. The real protagonist always appears last.
"Six hundred thousand!"
"Seven hundred thousand!"
"Eight hundred thousand!"
"Eight hundred and fifty thousand!"
"One million!" Zhang Xian's bid directly broke through the million mark.
"No way... am I hallucinating? Someone slap me twice."
"Wah... please stop adding more... Mommy, I'm scared."
"One million! Holy crap! I wouldn't even dare think about that."
"Is that guy in Jia-Seventeen the Treasure Azure Workshop's favorite son or something?!"

Yang Poxiao took a deep breath. Where did this big sucker come from? He's way too damn rich! One million far exceeded his psychological expectation; he had originally thought he could secure it between four hundred and seven hundred thousand. He didn't expect that guy on the third floor to bid so fast and fiercely; he couldn't keep up anymore.
Long Zhi glanced at her disciple. She knew her disciple had excellent natural talent and was also an alchemy master; she hadn't realized he was also so wealthy.
However, she was merely curious. Long Zhi was inherently aloof; her heart held only the Sword Dao.
Moreover, as his master, she couldn't help much either. All her income was spent on nurturing her treasured sword. For sword cultivators, their treasured sword is their wife.
"If you can't manage it, then forget it; your natural talent is already very good," Long Zhi rarely spoke up.

Yang Poxiao's face stiffened. The Immortal Ascension Grass was the main ingredient for him to refine the Immortal Ascension Pill; he absolutely had to have it. Moreover, his beloved master said he couldn't do it—how could he tolerate that?
"One point one million!" Yang Poxiao shouted out loud.
"One point two million." Zhang Xian followed in the next second.
"One point two five million." Yang Poxiao gritted his teeth; this was almost his limit already.
"One point four million." Zhang Xian clicked his tongue in annoyance, as if to say, 'I have no "P" key on my keyboard to pass.'
Yang Poxiao wilted completely.

"One point four million! One point four million!" Zi Xiao's voice cracked slightly with excitement as she shouted, "Fellow Daoist in Box Jia-Seventeen bids one point four million! Are there any fellow Daoists willing to bid higher?"
"If not... I'll start counting down... Three—"
"Wait." Yang Poxiao raised his hand, signaling. "I have items to pledge as collateral."
Zi Xiao nodded and beckoned two senior elders from backstage forward as Yang Poxiao began listing out his treasured collection of pills for appraisal.
Zhang Xian yawned lazily. Indeed worthy of being near a Destiny Daughter with 92 points, always causing trouble somehow...
Yang Poxiao discussed with those two elders for quite some time, seemingly pledging many items, before shouting, "One point five million!!"
"It's one point five million!"
Before the hostess finished speaking, Zhang Xian followed up immediately. "One point six million."
"This bastard doesn't hesitate for even one second when bidding!"
"Inhumanly rich! Inhumanly rich!"
"We're witnessing history here! I'm going crazy!!"
"That friend on the second floor seems like he's done for..."
"He called the hostess over again. Probably pledging something else..."
"This time he's probably pawning his underwear, poor guy..."

Yang Poxiao’s face turned livid with rage. This time, the discussion with those two elders took even longer. He practically pledged everything valuable on him. He even exchanged some items from the system shop...
"One point seven five million!!" Yang Poxiao’s eyes were bloodshot. He went all-in...
"One point seven six million." Seeing he was at the end of his rope, Zhang Xian decided not to waste resources and added just ten thousand to test the waters...
Yang Poxiao felt darkness before his eyes and slumped into his seat...
This script wasn’t what I imagined! Who the hell is brain-damaged enough to spend one point seven six million to buy one Immortal Ascension Grass?! He felt so frustrated he could vomit blood...
He almost cried as he looked towards his master beside him...
Long Zhi sighed lightly and flipped her fair hand, revealing only a few shiny spirit stones. "Master only has this much."
Yang Poxiao despaired. He knew his master would never be willing to pledge her spiritual treasure away, and he didn't dare mention it...
I never thought that even prepared so fully, I would still fail. Damn rich people!
