chapters.title: Chapter 28 Big Brother Must Love Me So Much
paragraphs: The auction concluded, leaving some disheartened and others worried.

Zhang Xian brought Lin Yinyin back to the Cloud Raiment Pavilion courtyard. Once they entered, Lin Yinyin eagerly threw herself onto the soft couch, rolled around twice, then looked up, smiling. "Big Brother, you were so cool today! That person competing with you for the Immortal Ascension Grass was so pitiful. He pledged items twice, but you crushed him effortlessly!"
"I want to bathe and change clothes, then I can happily eat my Beauty Pill~"
Zhang Xian chuckled, thinking, I didn’t even exert my full strength, and he collapsed already. Though he had overpaid by a lot, he had the system.
He then took out the Immortal Ascension Grass—worth 1.76 million mid-grade spirit stones—from his storage ring and handed it over.
"Here, eat this too."
"G-give me?" Lin Yinyin pointed at herself dazedly, her voice floating.
"Otherwise? You didn’t think I bought it for myself, right?"

Lin Yinyin was stunned for two seconds, then quickly waved her hands, her tone panicked. "No, no, no! This is too precious. I really can’t take it. Big Brother, you eat it yourself. My Spirit Root is already very good. It's not like Big Brother, you—"
She suddenly realized she had said the wrong thing and quickly shut her mouth, shaking her head repeatedly.
Over these years together, she had already sensed that Brother Zhang Xian's talent was far inferior to hers; otherwise, he wouldn’t have fallen behind in cultivation realm. Instead...

Thinking of this, she felt touched enough to almost cry. Big Brother’s Spirit Root is so poor, yet he still thinks only of me. He is reluctant to eat a sky-high priced Immortal Ascension Grass himself and insists on leaving it for me. Big Brother must love me so much...
[Ding! Current Favorability: 72]
"Do you want it or not? If not, I'll throw it away!"
"You throw it! I don’t want it!"
"Alright then. Since you don’t want it, I'll leave it for the other sisters."
"I want it!"

Immediately, Lin Yinyin pounced over. Her whole body hung onto Zhang Xian, her legs unconsciously tightening around his waist. She was excited to the point of incoherence. "Big Brother! Big Brother!!"
Zhang Xian was almost suffocated by her hug. He helplessly patted her back. "Alright, alright, I can’t breathe..."
Lin Yinyin then released him, her eyes still sparkling. She held the Immortal Ascension Grass and looked left and right. "Big Brother really doesn’t want it? You really bought it for me?"
"I really have other methods to improve my aptitude; I'm not lying. I won't joke about my own future."
"Super love Big Brother!" Lin Yinyin kissed Zhang Xian on the cheek.
[Ding! Gift Immortal Ascension Grass successful. Returned: Immortal Ascension Grass x100]
[Immortal Ascension Grass: Earth-grade material. Epic rarity treasure. Direct consumption offers a chance to improve Spirit Root quality. Effect diminishes with repeated consumption.]
Zhang Xian's lips curled upward. Here it comes. 1.76 million really isn't expensive at all...

Soon, Lin Yinyin finished bathing. She had already taken the Beauty Pill. Her jet-black long hair cascaded like a waterfall, and her skin, under the Beauty Pill's nourishment, was increasingly radiant and translucent. She had changed into a brand-new snow gauze dress. At her waist, a light blue silk ribbon was tied, accentuating her snow-white skin. Her eyes were like autumn water, and her hair tips were still slightly damp, adding a touch of fresh beauty.
She knelt sitting before Zhang Xian and took out a crystal-clear Spirit Testing Pearl from her storage pouch.

This was the most common Spirit Root testing tool in the cultivation world. Just by injecting spiritual power, one could manifest their Spirit Root quality. The pearl was marked with four scales, respectively written: Twenty, Forty, Sixty, Eighty. Simultaneously, according to the scale, it displayed different colors.
0-20 (White): Indicates a low-grade Spirit Root. Little difference from mortals, basically no future. Can go to third-rate sects to become servants, etc.
20-40 (Green): Indicates a low-grade Spirit Root. Also the vast majority of cultivators' Spirit Root quality.
40-60 (Blue): Indicates a mid-grade Spirit Root. Originally, Lin Yinyin was at this grade. Later, she underwent triple lightning tribulation sublimation and reached high-grade.
60-80 (Purple): Indicates a high-grade Spirit Root. This stage is elite level anywhere. Can easily enter the six major powers and become core disciples.
80+ (Gold): Indicates a Supreme Spirit Root. A deserved top-tier heaven’s pride. Either a sect chief disciple or Holy Son/Saintess level.
Lin Yinyin's fingertip lightly touched the Spirit Testing Pearl, and she slowly injected spiritual power.
Hum——
The Spirit Testing Pearl trembled slightly, then emanated a layer of purple halo. The pearl's scale stopped between the sixty and eighty marks.
Zhang Xian was a bit envious. He had secretly tested himself before; it was always zero and never moved. If not for seeing Lin Yinyin also use this, he would suspect the thing was fake.
"Big Brother, should I really eat it?" Lin Yinyin blinked her big eyes.
"Hurry." Zhang Xian was very expectant.
She carefully plucked a leaf of the Immortal Ascension Grass, her fingers slightly trembling. This is worth 1.76 million mid-grade spirit stones!
Wah, I'm reluctant. She slowly placed it in her mouth.
Instantly, a cool sensation spread through her throat, then transformed into a surging torrent of spiritual power!

"Mmm——!" She couldn’t help but moan. The surroundings emanated an ethereal blue halo. She felt the spiritual energy inside her Purple Palace wildly bursting forth, scouring her entire meridian network!

A long time later, the medicinal effects dissipated. Lin Yinyin didn't even bother wiping the fine beads of sweat from her forehead as she again injected spiritual power into the Spirit Testing Pearl.
Hum——
The measuring pearl lit up with a brighter purple light than before. The scale stopped near the eighty mark position.
Ah, just a little short. Lin Yinyin felt a slight regret in her heart.
"Big Brother! It's really useful! Big Brother, it improved so much!"
Zhang Xian shook his head. "Have another one."
Seeing the familiar-looking ethereal blue spirit grass in Zhang Xian's hand, emitting an even richer aura than the previous one, Lin Yinyin's face was full of question marks.
"Big Brother, where... where did this come from?" Lin Yinyin stammered somewhat.
"Oh, it's like this. I had this before, lying in my storage pouch gathering dust. I just didn’t know what it was. Today, after buying one, I realized it was Immortal Ascension Grass."
Do you hear what you are saying? Lin Yinyin gave him a suspicious look.
"I really cannot eat this again. The medicinal power will diminish, it's too wasteful." Lin Yinyin waved her hand.
Then she saw Zhang Xian conjure another stalk.
Lin Yinyin: "..."
She took a deep breath and swallowed it again without hesitation.
This time, the medicinal power was even fiercer!

The surrounding spiritual power was boiling, the aura rising layer upon layer. Her cultivation, originally at the fourth layer of Foundation Establishment, was actually faintly showing signs of a breakthrough!
Boom!
Inside her body, it seemed a barrier had been broken through. Her spiritual power suddenly solidified, more than doubling in strength!
"Foundation Establishment fifth layer!"
Simultaneously, the solidified spiritual energy inside her body shone as brilliantly as a deep-sea pearl, the light almost illuminating the entire room!
Meanwhile, a system notification sounded in Zhang Xian's mind.
[Ding! Current Destiny Points: 63]
Huh? So Destiny Points can increase too?
Lin Yinyin reached out and tested again. She saw the Spirit Testing Pearl emit a dazzling golden light, the scale stopping at one-third past the 80 mark.
"Supreme Water Spirit Root!"
Lin Yinyin was stunned.
She looked down at her own hands, feeling the surging spiritual power inside her body, momentarily somewhat dazed.
I really became a top-tier talent cultivator?
Zhang Xian chuckled softly, reaching out to rub her head. "Not bad."
Lin Yinyin’s eyes felt hot. She fiercely pounced into his embrace, her voice carrying a slight choke. "Brother, thank you!"
Her little face was flushed with excitement.
Zhang Xian patted her back, then stood up. "Consolidate your cultivation well."
He then turned to leave.
"Tonight... I don't want you to go." Lin Yinyin's voice was almost inaudible. She had bought so many new clothes and even learned some new tricks.
She looked up again, only to see Zhang Xian had already slipped away—and swiped her Spirit Testing Pearl on the way out.
Hmph! Lin Yinyin stomped her foot in resentment.

"Big Brother really doesn’t want it?
You really bought it for me?"
"I really have other methods to improve my aptitude; I'm not lying.
I won't joke about my own future."
"Super love Big Brother!" Lin Yinyin kissed Zhang Xian on the cheek.
[Ding!
Gift Immortal Ascension Grass successful.
Returned: Immortal Ascension Grass x100]
[Immortal Ascension Grass: Earth-grade material.
Epic rarity treasure.
Direct consumption offers a chance to improve Spirit Root quality.
Effect diminishes with repeated consumption.]
Zhang Xian's lips curled upward.
Here it comes.
1.76 million really isn't expensive at all...
Soon, Lin Yinyin finished bathing.
She had already taken the Beauty Pill.
Her jet-black long hair cascaded like a waterfall, and her skin, under the Beauty Pill's nourishment, was increasingly radiant and translucent.
She had changed into a brand-new snow gauze dress.
At her waist, a light blue silk ribbon was tied, accentuating her snow-white skin.
Her eyes were like autumn water, and her hair tips were still slightly damp, adding a touch of fresh beauty.
She knelt sitting before Zhang Xian and took out a crystal-clear Spirit Testing Pearl from her storage pouch.
This was the most common Spirit Root testing tool in the cultivation world.
Just by injecting spiritual power, one could manifest their Spirit Root quality.
The pearl was marked with four scales, respectively written: Twenty, Forty, Sixty, Eighty.
Simultaneously, according to the scale, it displayed different colors.
0-20 (White): Indicates a low-grade Spirit Root.
Little difference from mortals, basically no future.
Can go to third-rate sects to become servants, etc.
20-40 (Green): Indicates a low-grade Spirit Root.
Also the vast majority of cultivators' Spirit Root quality.
40-60 (Blue): Indicates a mid-grade Spirit Root.
Originally, Lin Yinyin was at this grade.
Later, she underwent triple lightning tribulation sublimation and reached high-grade.
60-80 (Purple): Indicates a high-grade Spirit Root.
This stage is elite level anywhere.
Can easily enter the six major powers and become core disciples.
80+ (Gold): Indicates a Supreme Spirit Root.
A deserved top-tier heaven’s pride.
Either a sect chief disciple or Holy Son/Saintess level.
Lin Yinyin's fingertip lightly touched the Spirit Testing Pearl, and she slowly injected spiritual power.
Hum——
The Spirit Testing Pearl trembled slightly, then emanated a layer of purple halo.
The pearl's scale stopped between the sixty and eighty marks.
Zhang Xian was a bit envious.
He had secretly tested himself before; it was always zero and never moved.
If not for seeing Lin Yinyin also use this, he would suspect the thing was fake.
"Big Brother, should I really eat it?" Lin Yinyin blinked her big eyes.
"Hurry." Zhang Xian was very expectant.
She carefully plucked a leaf of the Immortal Ascension Grass, her fingers slightly trembling.
This is worth 1.76 million mid-grade spirit stones!
Wah, I'm reluctant.
She slowly placed it in her mouth.
Instantly, a cool sensation spread through her throat, then transformed into a surging torrent of spiritual power!
"Mmm——!" She couldn’t help but moan.
The surroundings emanated an ethereal blue halo.
She felt the spiritual energy inside her Purple Palace wildly bursting forth, scouring her entire meridian network!
A long time later, the medicinal effects dissipated.
Lin Yinyin didn't even bother wiping the fine beads of sweat from her forehead as she again injected spiritual power into the Spirit Testing Pearl.
Hum——
The measuring pearl lit up with a brighter purple light than before.
The scale stopped near the eighty mark position.
Ah, just a little short.
Lin Yinyin felt a slight regret in her heart.
"Big Brother!
It's really useful!
Big Brother, it improved so much!"
Zhang Xian shook his head.
"Have another one."
Seeing the familiar-looking ethereal blue spirit grass in Zhang Xian's hand, emitting an even richer aura than the previous one, Lin Yinyin's face was full of question marks.
"Big Brother, where... where did this come from?" Lin Yinyin stammered somewhat.
"Oh, it's like this.
I had this before, lying in my storage pouch gathering dust.
I just didn’t know what it was.
Today, after buying one, I realized it was Immortal Ascension Grass."
Do you hear what you are saying?
Lin Yinyin gave him a suspicious look.
"I really cannot eat this again.
The medicinal power will diminish, it's too wasteful." Lin Yinyin waved her hand.
Then she saw Zhang Xian conjure another stalk.
Lin Yinyin: "..."
She took a deep breath and swallowed it again without hesitation.
This time, the medicinal power was even fiercer!
The surrounding spiritual power was boiling, the aura rising layer upon layer.
Her cultivation, originally at the fourth layer of Foundation Establishment, was actually faintly showing signs of a breakthrough!
Boom!
Inside her body, it seemed a barrier had been broken through.
Her spiritual power suddenly solidified, more than doubling in strength!
"Foundation Establishment fifth layer!"
Simultaneously, the solidified spiritual energy inside her body shone as brilliantly as a deep-sea pearl, the light almost illuminating the entire room!
Meanwhile, a system notification sounded in Zhang Xian's mind.
[Ding!
Current Destiny Points: 63]
Huh?
So Destiny Points can increase too?
Lin Yinyin reached out and tested again.
She saw the Spirit Testing Pearl emit a dazzling golden light, the scale stopping at one-third past the 80 mark.
"Supreme Water Spirit Root!"
Lin Yinyin was stunned.
She looked down at her own hands, feeling the surging spiritual power inside her body, momentarily somewhat dazed.
I really became a top-tier talent cultivator?
Zhang Xian chuckled softly, reaching out to rub her head.
"Not bad."
Lin Yinyin’s eyes felt hot.
She fiercely pounced into his embrace, her voice carrying a slight choke.
"Brother, thank you!"
Her little face was flushed with excitement.
Zhang Xian patted her back, then stood up.
"Consolidate your cultivation well."
He then turned to leave.
"Tonight...
I don't want you to go." Lin Yinyin's voice was almost inaudible.
She had bought so many new clothes and even learned some new tricks.
She looked up again, only to see Zhang Xian had already slipped away—and swiped her Spirit Testing Pearl on the way out.
Hmph!
Lin Yinyin stomped her foot in resentment.

chapters.title: Chapter 29 The Eternal Child
paragraphs: The night was deep and quiet. Zhang Xian sat alone in the east wing room.
Yinyin was wonderful, but cultivation was the proper path.
Zhang Xian withdrew several stalks of Ascension Grass from his system space. Their bodies glowed with a crystalline blue light as he neatly arranged them on the table.
Staring at the eternally unchanging white mark on the Spirit Testing Pearl, he gritted his teeth and swallowed the first stalk.
Gulp.

The grass leaf melted the moment it entered his mouth, transforming into a stream of cool spiritual energy. Zhang Xian closed his eyes and focused his mind, feeling the medicinal power rampaging through his body. This sensation was fantastic.
After a long while, Zhang Xian opened his eyes. He felt he had finally achieved the breakthrough from zero to one.
He reached out to test again. It was still a white light.
However, the mark had now reached around fifteen.
Finally, a qualitative change. That wasn't easy.
I am no longer a zero.
Zhang Xian continued by swallowing the second stalk.
This time, as the spiritual energy flowed through his limbs and bones, he clearly felt a slight stinging pain in his meridians.
The Spirit Testing Pearl glimmered with a trace of green light, the mark stopping just a tiny bit past twenty.
I've turned green!
I've evolved to a Low-Grade Spirit Root!
With an excited heart, Zhang Xian swallowed the third stalk. This time, a piercing cyan light erupted from his entire body before it gradually receded and dissipated inward.
Huh? The mark on the Spirit Testing Pearl only increased a little.
He took the fourth stalk, but the mark didn't move at all.
Alright, that's enough for now.

Zhang Xian rummaged through his system space and pulled out a book titled Azure Emperor's Rejuvenation Art. Previously, he couldn't cultivate it due to his low Spirit Root aptitude. Now that he possessed a Low-Grade Spirit Root, it should be possible.
There were several other wood-attribute cultivation arts in the system space. After studying them, Zhang Xian felt this one suited him best.

He already had talismans and countless magical artifacts at hand, along with the Magical Artifact Self-Detonation Technique as a finishing move. He didn't lack offensive methods; rather, his spiritual energy capacity was too low, lacking endurance.

This shortcoming had been exposed during the fight against Zhao Chengyue. Even though he used refined artifacts and talismans, just activating them made Zhang Xian feel somewhat drained. This Azure Emperor's Rejuvenation Art primarily focused on rapid spiritual energy recovery and also possessed some healing capabilities.
Early the next morning, when Lin Yinyin knocked on the east wing door, she was so startled by the scene before her that she covered her small mouth with her hand.
The entire room was covered in verdant vines, and Zhang Xian was sitting cross-legged within a cocoon woven from these living plants, green light dancing at his fingertips.
"Brother, you are...

"A newly learned cultivation art." Zhang Xian flicked his finger, shooting out a beam of green light. The bruise on Lin Yinyin's knee from a few days ago instantly healed. "Although not great for fighting, it makes me quite qualified as a support healer."
"Yinyin. You're already at the fifth layer of Foundation Establishment. Try to see if you can refine a Superior-grade magical artifact."
"Oh right, can you take the Golden Core Nurturing Pill now?"
"Brother, what are you saying? The Golden Core Nurturing Pill is effective only at the late Foundation Establishment stage at the earliest. It's too early to prepare for Golden Core formation now."
"Alright."
[Ding! Successfully gifted Superior-grade Magical Artifact. Returned: Superior-grade Magical Artifact x100.]
[Ding! Successfully gifted Superior-grade Magical Artifact. Returned: Superior-grade Magical Artifact x100.]
Mmm! Lin Yinyin's face was full of sweetness. Being pampered by her brother felt so good.
By evening, Yun Qi finished his tasks and returned to the Cloud Raiment Pavilion's detached courtyard.

He found Lin Yinyin in the courtyard, playing with her Superior-grade magic sword. A normal cultivator without system cheats would need at least three months to half a year to refine a Superior-grade artifact. To achieve seamless mastery would take even longer. Some cultivators might never fully unleash their artifact's potential in their lifetime.
Yet, wherever Lin Yinyin's sword tip passed, three-foot-long ice spikes condensed instantly, freezing the pond water in the courtyard solid.
Seeing this, Yun Qi raised an eyebrow. Good heavens, another extremely high-quality Superior-grade artifact! And she's only at the fifth layer of Foundation Establishment!
Thinking back to when he first met them two years ago, she was only at the second layer. In just two years, she had reached the fifth layer. How many resources had been piled onto her?
Suddenly, he noticed Lin Yinyin's aptitude had increased significantly compared to a few days ago.
"Miss Lin, your Spirit Root..." His pupils contracted slightly as he looked at Zhang Xian incredulously. "You didn't give her the Ascension Grass to eat, did you?"
"No! Your aptitude seems to have increased too!" Yun Qi exclaimed in shock.
Zhang Xian lazily leaned back in his chair. "No need to be so dramatic."
Yun Qi drew in a sharp breath. Both their aptitudes had improved? How is that possible!?
Yun Qi's thoughts raced rapidly. Zhang Xian still has secrets! Perhaps the strength of the minor world behind him is even stronger than our Cloud Raiment Pavilion!

Moreover, his identity wasn't as simple as just being an envoy for a minor world. He had casually consumed 1.76 million mid-grade spirit stones; he must be at the level of an heir with actual authority.

Take Yun Qi himself, for example. Although he held the position of Grand Commander and handled transactions worth far more than that amount daily, that wealth belonged to the Cloud Raiment Pavilion, not him personally.
This financial power... this scale... I'm afraid I've still underestimated Zhang Xian's background.

Yun Qi sighed inwardly. No matter what, he considered himself a famous third-generation rich kid in the Southern Region. Yet here he was, constantly being shocked and reduced to a background character again and again; he felt somewhat like a failure.
He forced out two dry laughs. "Fellow Daoist Zhang is indeed generous."
Zhang Xian waved his hand. "It's all small change."
Yun Qi: "..."
Just as Yun Qi was about to take his leave, the clear sound of bells suddenly came from outside.
[Ding! Discovered Daughter of Destiny with 12 points: Yun Zhen'er]
"Little Brother! Little Brother!"

A petite figure came bouncing in energetically. She looked no more than eleven or twelve years old, with twin ponytails and wearing traditional ruqun attire adorned with silver bells tied around her waist that jingled merrily as she ran.
Zhang Xian glanced up.
[Ding! Yun Zhen'er's Favorability towards you is 0. Binding successful.]
Yun Zhen'er ran up to Yun Qi's side and tugged on his sleeve. "Little Brother! You promised to play with me today!"
Little Brother?
Zhang Xian and Lin Yinyin exchanged glances; their expressions turned slightly odd.
Yun Qi helplessly rubbed her head. "Zhenzhen, don't cause trouble now; I'm discussing important matters here. I'll play with you soon."
Yun Zhen'er pouted; her curious gaze shifted towards Zhang Xian and Lin Yinyin.

Lin Yinyin couldn't take her eyes off the adorable Yun Zhen'er. Upon seeing her, she immediately took off an ornament hanging from her waist and approached cheerfully. "Little Sister! This one can sing!"

Infused with spiritual energy by Lin Yinyin’s will alone, the ornament not only emitted melodious tunes but also scattered sparkling dots of light around itself. Yun Zhen'er’s eyes instantly lit up brightly as she chased after both Lin Yinyin and those dancing lights all over the courtyard, playfully laughing.
"Who is this little girl? Why does she call you Little Brother?" asked Zhang Xian smilingly, watching the scene unfold before them.

With an expression full of doting affection, Yun Qi explained softly. "Her name is Yun Zhen’er; she’s my aunt’s daughter. She was born under unfortunate circumstances due to our enemies’ schemes, causing a congenital soul deficiency within her body. Since birth, the family has been forced to use the spirit treasure [Time Sand Lock], supplemented by a Profound Ice Array, to seal her physical growth completely. Her mental development is frozen in a childhood state permanently. Hence why she calls me ‘Little Brother,’ because technically, she was born earlier than me."
Wow! So she’s actually an eternal child immortal type figure? Zhang Xian thought.
He observed closely, noticing that despite her youthful appearance, she actually possessed a Golden Core stage cultivation level.
Both men watched the two females—one adult-sized, the other child-sized—chasing each other around the yard, laughing joyfully. It created a picture-perfect moment.
"Huff... huff..." Little Yun Zhen’er was tired after running for a while, still clutching tightly onto Lin Yinyin’s ornament with her small hands, refusing to let go.

"Be good now; return the jade pendant to Elder Sister, please. Big Brother will take you shopping later, okay?" Yun Qi said gently, patting her head affectionately. He recognized the value of the priceless artifact immediately; its worth was far beyond ordinary trinkets.
"It’s ‘Little Brother’; I am your Elder Sister, correct!" she corrected immediately, pouting slightly, though she reluctantly handed the ornament back toward Lin Yinyin.
"Yes, yes! You are the Elder Sister indeed!" Yun Qi chuckled amusedly, shaking his head fondly.

From within his robe's pocket, Zhang Xian produced another jade pendant of a similar design, but this one emitted fiery red sparkles instead of cool blue ones. He handed it over toward the little girl.
"Here, this one is for you. Look, it's red!"
He shook his hand slightly, making the sparkles dance in the air, mesmerizingly capturing her attention completely.
"Wow!" she exclaimed excitedly, her eyes lighting up once again.

chapters.title: Chapter 30 You Think You’re Yang Guo
paragraphs: The next day, Zhang Xian found himself bored and idle. Lin Yinyin was still in seclusion, intently refining her precious magical artifact.
"If only I could get my hands on more rare treasures like the Immortal Ascension Grass," Zhang Xian mused.

He contacted Yun Qi and mentioned that he had another batch of high-grade magical artifacts for sale. It couldn't be helped; the system had given him too many. Furthermore, auctioning off the Immortal Ascension Grass had indeed cost him a significant portion of his savings.

As for Lin Yinyin, she had already been "filled to the brim" by him recently, reaching the limit of what he could gift her for immediate returns. Currently, the only target left for potential returns was the little loli, Yun Zhen'er, but giving her gifts without a valid reason would seem strange.
Thinking this, Zhang Xian got up and went out alone.
First, he went to the east of the city to eat a basket of the famous steamed buns. Then, he headed to the market located under the nine-story glazed pagoda in the city center.
He had heard that other transmigrators often stumbled upon rare treasures at such markets, so Zhang Xian wanted to try his luck as well.
Yang Poxiao had been very irritable lately. Failing to secure the Immortal Ascension Grass at the auction had disrupted his plans, and he was unwilling to accept the outcome.
He had set up a stall at the market within Jade Capital City, selling pills. He also displayed a blackboard that read: “Buying all kinds of rare treasures, including Immortal Ascension Grass.”
For several days in a row, he hadn't gained much. However, he did manage to sell a few of the pills he had refined.
Today was his last day lingering in Jade Capital City. His master, Long Zhi, sat quietly meditating behind him like a statue.
Sigh. His master's eyes were only for the sword.
Yang Poxiao smiled self-deprecatingly. What was he fantasizing about? What rare treasures could he possibly acquire in a street market? This wasn't some novel where opportunities fell from the sky.
At that moment, a person with a restrained aura walked up to his stall. Pointing at one of the pills on display, the stranger asked, "How much for this Life Extension Pill?"

Yang Poxiao glanced at him. The man's features were indistinct, and he wore artifacts that blocked detection. There were many cultivators who didn't want their identities known, so Yang Poxiao didn't think much of it.
"One thousand mid-grade spirit stones."
"Oh? What are its effects? Does it work for Foundation Establishment cultivators too?"

Adhering to the principle that the customer is king, Yang Poxiao patiently explained, "Mortals who take it can extend their lifespan by a hundred years. For cultivators, the effect diminishes sharply. Generally, Qi Refining cultivators can extend their lifespan by about ten years, and Foundation Establishment by roughly one year or so. Beyond that, it has little to no effect."
"I see. I'll take one then." The man decisively took out the money.
Huh? Yang Poxiao hadn't expected him to be so straightforward. He accepted the payment and handed over the pill.

Seeing the man still examining his wares, Yang Poxiao added, "Although my pills are slightly more expensive than the market price, they are all of superior quality. Their efficacy is generally better."
The man then shifted his gaze to a Beauty Preservation Pill.

Yang Poxiao continued, "This Beauty Preservation Pill is eight thousand mid-grade spirit stones. It's also top-grade, similar in quality to the one auctioned off a few days ago which sold for ten thousand."
He almost added that the auctioned one was also his product.

The man withdrew his gaze and asked, "Do you have any other similar pills here? For example, ones that aren't restricted by cultivation level and can increase lifespan, comprehension ability, vitality, or Spirit Roots? Or perhaps rare treasures that can heal foundational injuries?"
"You jest, Fellow Daoist," Yang Poxiao said. "Such rare treasures are encountered by chance, not sought out easily."

As he spoke, he suddenly paused and took out a pill from a storage pouch at his chest. "There is this Vitality Pill. It can increase vitality somewhat and is quite effective for mortals and martial artists."
"I'll take one of those as well."
"You're very decisive, Fellow Daoist. I'll charge you one hundred mid-grade spirit stones then."
Yang Poxiao thought to himself, Actually, it only costs ten mid-grade spirit stones... I'll fleece you a little less, otherwise my conscience might hurt.
After their transaction was complete, the buyer looked around but couldn't find anything else he needed. He asked, "You're still buying rare treasures? What exactly are you looking for?"
"That depends on what you have, Fellow Daoist. To be frank with you, I am an alchemist. For any rare treasure, I will offer a satisfactory price."
"Oh?" The buyer took out a snow ginseng. "How about this?"
"Millennium Spirit Ginseng... Fellow Daoist, this hardly counts as a rare treasure."
"Then what about this?"
The buyer produced a spiritual herb that was entirely translucent blue.
"Immortal Ascension Grass!!"
Yang Poxiao's pupils contracted sharply. His mind raced—Was this the person who outbid me?

No... Yang Poxiao was an Alchemy Grandmaster, after all; his ability to identify herbs was extremely high. He could tell at a glance that this stalk was different from the one auctioned—its appearance was even better.
Could he be the one who consigned it for auction? Does he have a second stalk?
"This... I can offer six hundred thousand for it." Yang Poxiao tried his best to keep his voice calm.
"Heh, Fellow Daoist. This fetched 1.76 million at auction. Isn't six hundred thousand a bit low?"
Yang Poxiao's expression changed slightly but quickly steadied. "Auctions involve premiums. Moreover, this is a private purchase after all...
"Forget it then." The figure turned as if to leave.
"Fellow Daoist! Wait!" Yang Poxiao called out frantically. "I can add more."
"Two million! Non-negotiable!"
Yang Poxiao gritted his teeth. "Are you joking with me?"

Yang Poxiao snorted. "Naturally, to refine an Immortal Ascension Pill."
Whoa! An ancient lost pill formula! This guy has something! Zhang Xian marveled internally.
"Then how about we make a deal? I won't charge for this Immortal Ascension Grass. If you succeed in refining it... give me a few pills then."

"You have quite the plan figured out," Yang Poxiao said darkly. "I am likely the only one under heaven who can refine an Immortal Ascension Pill now! And you want 'a few'? One batch yields at most two or three pills."
He thought to himself, A typical alchemist gets two or three finished pills from one recipe batch at most; as a super-genius alchemist, naturally, I get more.
"Then I want half."
Yang Poxiao pondered for a moment before saying, "Fine! Give me the Immortal Ascension Grass, and I will swear a Heart Demon Oath that upon successful refinement, I will give you half."

"I have one small condition," said Zhang Xian coolly, shaking his head slowly. He crossed his arms over his chest, defiantly staring back into those furious eyes. "I don't trust you! Let your master behind you swear the oath instead."
He pointed towards Long Zhi, who sat quietly meditating nearby, seemingly oblivious to everything happening around her until now.
Suddenly, a system notification popped up inside Zhang Xian's head.

Yang Poxiao flew into a rage immediately upon hearing the demand. The words clearly implied distrust in him personally while trusting his master implicitly.
"What do you mean by this, Fellow Daoist?! How could I possibly break a promise under a Heart Demon Oath?!"
"If that is not acceptable, then the deal is cancelled." Zhang Xian's tone left no room for negotiation.

chapters.title: Chapter 31 Wealthy, Stunning, With a Daughter, a Widow
paragraphs: Zhang Xian hummed a little tune as he returned to the Cloud Raiment Pavilion's annex. From afar, he could already hear silvery laughter ringing out from the courtyard.

Pushing the door open, he saw Lin Yinyin playing and frolicking with Yun Zhen'er. The little loli had new crimson jade pendants tied to her twin ponytails. As she ran, red light shimmered around them, making her little face flush.
"Brother!"
"Uncle!"

Zhang Xian stepped forward and wrapped an arm around Lin Yinyin's slender waist. Smiling at Yun Zhen'er, he said, "Little girl, your form of address isn't quite right. You call Yinyin 'Sister,' so why call me 'Uncle'?"
"Because... because Uncle looks old." Yun Zhen'er blinked her big eyes innocently.

Lin Yinyin couldn't help but giggle. Zhang Xian concealed his true appearance outside, looking like a simple, honest middle-aged man. Only when alone with her would he reveal his original handsome features.
Zhang Xian stroked his stubble. "Well, we can't mess up the seniority. From now on, Yinyin, you'll have to call me 'Uncle' too. And you, Yun Qi, you should also call me 'Uncle'."
Lin Yinyin cooed sweetly, "Whatever you like, I'll call you anything. Uncle! Uncle!"
Yun Qi, standing under the corridor eaves, rolled his eyes and walked over. "Alright, enough teasing. The Pavilion Master requests your presence."
Zhang Xian was taken aback. The Pavilion Master of the Cloud Raiment Pavilion was a true heavyweight in the Southern Region and actually wanted to see him personally.
In an elegant room on the third floor of the Cloud Raiment Pavilion, sandalwood incense filled the air.
[Ding! Discovered a 55-point Daughter of Destiny: Yun Wanqing.]
[Yun Wanqing's Favorability towards you is 10. Binding successful.]
A woman was seen kneeling before a low table; she was the acting Pavilion Master of the Cloud Raiment Pavilion.

Her features were like a painting. A plain white silk gown flowed around her like water. Her dark hair was simply gathered with a jade hairpin, a few stray strands falling against her snow-white neck.

She appeared to be only around thirty years old, with an extremely beautiful face and skin as lustrous as fresh snow. Her eyebrows were like distant mountains tinged with azure, and the outer corners of her eyes slanted slightly downward, carrying a hint of weariness.
Her gaze was gentle as autumn water. Seeing Yun Qi lead Zhang Xian in, she revealed a faint smile. "Fellow Daoist Zhang Xian, it's our first meeting."

She looked almost exactly like a grown-up version of Yun Zhen'er, just a more serene one. Zhang Xian hadn't expected both mother and daughter to be Daughters of Destiny—truly worthy of a prominent family.
"Greetings, Fellow Daoist."
"Aunt.

Zhang Xian and Yun Qi took their seats. Yun Wanqing lightly raised her delicate hand, and two cups of spirit tea silently slid before them. "Thank you for gifting my daughter that magical artifact. She likes it very much."
"As long as Zhen'er is happy."
"So! Auntie, my judgment is good, right? I've brought an honored guest to our Cloud Raiment Pavilion," Yun Qi quickly claimed credit.

"Otherwise I wouldn't have recommended you for the position of Internal Affairs Commander," Yun Wanqing said with a slight smile. "I heard Fellow Daoist Zhang has another batch of high-grade magical artifacts for sale."

"Of course. This time we can trade one hundred pieces first." As he spoke, Zhang Xian took out a large chest and continued, "I'll still have to trouble your esteemed pavilion to help me gather more information on rare treasures and materials. I'm very satisfied with this batch of Immortal Ascension Grass; this is additional compensation for Pavilion Master Yun."
Why is it for my aunt?
Yun Qi opened the chest. "Holy crap!!!"
Inside were neatly arranged high-grade spirit stones—a full thousand of them.

"Damn! These high-grade spirit stones! The information about the Immortal Ascension Grass came from me! Shouldn't these be for me??" Even someone as worldly-wise as Yun Qi couldn't quite hold back his reaction.

Although the exchange rate between different grades of spirit stones was calculated at one to one hundred, high-grade spirit stones were difficult to mine and refine and could fetch prices as high as 130 to 150 on the black market. This many high-grade spirit stones were worth nearly one hundred and fifty thousand mid-grade spirit stones.
And he just gave them away! Yun Qi suddenly felt like a country bumpkin.

Yun Wanqing appeared unperturbed on the surface, but her assessment of Zhang Xian's strength rose another notch internally. Being able to produce so many high-grade spirit stones wasn't just a symbol of wealth; it was also an indication of the power behind him.

Even an entity as strong as the Cloud Raiment Pavilion ranked firmly within the top three in terms of financial power in the Southern Region. Yet they owned only two mines capable of producing high-grade spirit stones.

"We are deeply grateful for Fellow Daoist's generous gift. The Cloud Raiment Pavilion naturally wishes to reciprocate this kindness in some small measure," Yun Wanqing said gracefully. "From now on, for any items Fellow Daoist sells through us, our pavilion will take only ten percent of the profit."
Zhang Xian clasped his hands in thanks.
[Ding! Gift of 1000 high-grade spirit stones to Yun Wanqing successful. Return triggered: 100,000 high-grade spirit stones returned.]
Comfortable.
Zhang Xian thought to himself; it really had to be someone with substance like Yun Wanqing who could directly absorb a thousand high-grade spirit stones.
Not like little Yinyin—she couldn't handle even a bit.
After discussing some more details about business for a while longer, Yun Wanqing said, "Yun Qi, step outside for a moment. Fellow Daoist and I have some private matters to discuss."
Oh? Yun Qi retreated with a gossipy look on his face.
As the door closed behind him, the soundproofing formation in the elegant room activated automatically.
Zhang Xian was also curious and gazed at her stunning beauty. He had done his homework beforehand and roughly knew about her life story.

Yun Wanqing was at the late Golden Core stage. Her father was the Patriarch of the Cloud Raiment Pavilion family. The Patriarch had been in seclusion for many years. Yun Wanqing had been intelligent since childhood and, as the eldest sister in the clan, had managed more than half of the pavilion's affairs for over a hundred years now under the title of Acting Pavilion Master—she was truly its de facto ruler in power.

Her Dao Companion came from a background as a rogue cultivator; their relationship had been very good. However, many years ago, during her pregnancy, she suffered injuries that nearly killed her; this resulted in her daughter, Yun Zhen'er, being born with an incomplete soul.

The Cloud Raiment Pavilion expended enormous manpower and resources to preserve Yun Zhen'er's life but only addressed the symptoms, not the root causes. For this reason, her Dao Companion ventured into secret realms multiple times seeking vitality for their daughter. Unfortunately, he once became trapped within one such realm; he has been missing ever since—for two hundred years now.
Wealthy, stunning, with a daughter, a widow—and crucially also a Daughter of Destiny. These were labels Zhang Xian assigned her.

"Fellow Daoist possesses resolve firm as bedrock; this palace deeply admires it," Yun Wanqing's voice was as clear as spring water. "However, in this palace's view, Fellow Daoist seems headed down the wrong path."
"Oh? What does Pavilion Master mean by that?"
Yun Wanqing lightly tapped the tabletop with a fingertip; the tea liquid suddenly inverted, forming a mirror reflecting the scene within Zhang Xian's dantian.
A green vortex-shaped form surrounded by swirling, unending spiritual energy.
Yun Wanqing tapped again; as if a wisp of wind passed through, the spiritual energy dissipated, revealing a gray inner core inside.

"Fellow Daoist is a heaven-sent genius using a False Core technique to condense a Spirit Root. Though you have a method to improve your own Spirit Root quality, ultimately, the False Core technique is like rootless duckweed; the path of cultivation is severed and difficult to tread toward the Great Dao."

Not only was she beautiful, but she also possessed keen insight. Her cultivation was high enough to see through the origin of his technique. Being exposed, Zhang Xian merely smiled, saying, "So what? The path of cultivation inherently defies the heavens. As long as a sliver of hope exists, this one will not give up."

"Will not give up..." Yun Wanqing murmured softly; how could she give up on Yun Zhen'er either? With an incomplete soul, her daughter should have died early, but she found ways to forcibly extend her life until now.

"This palace will not inquire into the origins of Fellow Daoist's small world, only hopes that if Fellow Daoist ever encounters a treasure capable of mending the little girl's soul..." When she lifted her gaze, those autumn-water eyes held a plea within them. "...this palace is willing to pay any price! Similarly, what Fellow Daoist seeks, this palace will also exhaust all efforts to search for."
The reason she kept Zhang Xian behind was precisely because she saw this point about him.

He had a mere mortal physique, yet he could embark on the path of cultivation and even possess such financial resources. Thus, she thought to form a good connection; what if his small world possessed a treasure capable of mending her daughter's soul? What if he might encounter one in the future?
For the sake of her daughter, she did not want to miss any opportunity.
"Naturally. If the opportunity arises, I will definitely save little Zhen'er," Zhang Xian replied, feeling a thread of shared sympathy and kinship with her plight.

chapters.title: Chapter 32 Dead Memories Begin to Attack Me
paragraphs: "Since the Fairy said I was heading in the wrong direction, do you have any other advice?" Zhang Xian asked.

Yun Wanqing spoke slowly. "Over these years, while running around for my daughter, I've only gained some immature insights. Fellow Daoist, are you aware of the method of 'Bing Jie' for re-cultivation?"

"'Bing Jie'... it's only mentioned in legends within ancient texts. It's said to be an immortal technique used by Tribulation Crossing stage cultivators for reincarnation and restarting cultivation. But in the Southern Region, forget Tribulation Crossing, there isn't even a single Soul Formation cultivator. I've only seen scattered records."
In recent years, Zhang Xian had worn out countless ancient texts trying to find a method to break through the False Core stage.

It was widely known that cultivation realms progressed in order: Qi Refining, Foundation Establishment, Golden Core, Nascent Soul, Soul Formation, Void Refinement, Body Integration, Tribulation Crossing, and Mahayana. But in the Southern Region, the pinnacle of cultivation techniques and realms only reached Nascent Soul.
The path of Bing Jie was considered by many to be mere fantasy from storybooks.

Yun Wanqing nodded slightly. "Although the path of Bing Jie seems illusory and intangible, it gave me an idea. What if one used puppet techniques to nurture a false body, keeping it consistent with one's own self, only supplementing the missing parts of oneself? Then, by finding a way to transfer one's spiritual consciousness into it... could that not be understood as Bing Jie re-cultivation?"
Preposterous! Audacious to the extreme!

Zhang Xian was stunned. This woman appeared as soft and gentle as water, yet she could conceive such a method of changing bodies to restart cultivation, although there were still many flaws and impractical aspects in its implementation.
Yun Wanqing thought she had frightened him and said somewhat awkwardly, "Fellow Daoist probably thinks I'm indulging in wild fantasies."

Zhang Xian shook his head. "Pavilion Master jests. I too was trapped at the innate stage for many years before entering Qi Refining. The Pavilion Master's struggle against fate for her daughter commands admiration."
The phrase "struggle against fate" struck a chord deep within Yun Wanqing's heart, encapsulating all the hardships she had endured over these years.

The two conversed at length about the path of Bing Jie. Yun Wanqing, worthy of being a late Golden Core stage cultivator with a noble status and broad perspective, proposed some concepts that offered Zhang Xian fresh insights.

After several cups of tea had cooled, Yun Wanqing remarked casually, "Fellow Daoist, why have you stayed in the city all this time instead of going to one of the Six Great Powers? With their foundation, you might gain much more."

Zhang Xian sighed softly. "The city at least has protective formations. If I went to one of the Six Great Powers with my lowly cultivation level and carrying heavy treasures, I would inevitably encounter unscrupulous individuals. The Zhao Family from Shuiyun City serves as a cautionary tale.

Yun Wanqing expressed understanding. She had previously heard from Yun Xi that due to some special reasons, the power behind Zhang Xian could not come to this major world; only Zhang Xian himself acted as their representative. With merely Foundation Establishment cultivation yet possessing millions of spirit stones, it was normal to be cautious.

She thought for a moment, then took out a golden long shuttle and offered it to Zhang Xian. "This is a Boundary-Piercing Shuttle. I gift it to you, Fellow Daoist. If you encounter danger, you can activate it to preserve your life."

Zhang Xian's eyes lit up. This Boundary-Piercing Shuttle was a fine treasure! It could ignore various formation restrictions and shatter space to escape. However, the cost was great: it required consuming a cultivator's vital essence blood to activate. The escape location was also random, and it could only be used once.
Even so, possessing it equated to having one chance to save one's life. This treasure was worth at least several hundred thousand mid-grade spirit stones and was practically impossible to buy.

Zhang Xian did not refuse. With a smile, he accepted it and repeatedly expressed his thanks. He thought to himself that with this Boundary-Piercing Shuttle as a trump card, perhaps he really could visit the Six Great Powers.
"If I were indeed to go to the Six Great Powers, does Pavilion Master have any suggestions?"
Yun Wanqing pondered for a moment before lightly tapping her fingertip. A mist formed before her eyes, coalescing into six faint silhouettes.

"The Six Great Powers have legacies spanning over ten thousand years; their vision is beyond that of ordinary cultivators," she explained eloquently. "Aside from Penglai Immortal Island, with whom we have little interaction, the other five sects... with my Cloud Raiment Pavilion's endorsement, Fellow Daoist can visit them all."
Zhang Xian nodded. Penglai Immortal Island was essentially a group of "technical otakus" dedicated to alchemy and crafting mechanisms.

Zhang Xian had initially held high hopes for them but later heard that even the island master's only son lacked Spirit Roots—a mortal attempting cultivation. He had painstakingly researched and developed the False Core technique. However, when he attempted his breakthrough to the False Core stage some years ago... his False Core shattered, and his realm collapsed. Now, the grass on his grave was already several meters high.

"The Lingxu Sect excels in Sword Dao; their 'Taixu Sword Sutra' emphasizes nurturing spirit through the sword. Like Fellow Daoist's origins, they also originated from a minor world before gradually growing stronger. This Jade Capital City is essentially their backyard."

Zhang Xian acknowledged with an "Mhm." Long Zhi was the chief among the Lingxu Sect's second-generation elders—a peak Golden Core stage cultivator. With no Nascent Soul old monsters appearing in the Southern Region, she was rightfully considered number one. And her disciple, Yang Poxiao, had been making quite a name for himself recently; news about him frequently surfaced these past few years.

"The Great Xia Dynasty resembles secular world dynasties more closely; they possess the most solid foundation. They govern almost all cities and mortals within the cultivation world; the prolonged peace in the Southern Region has been maintained under their leadership as well. They maintain the closest relationship with our Cloud Raiment Pavilion.
Having read history, Zhang Xian knew that the entire Southern Region was once a vast feudal empire; the other five major powers later gained independence.

"Shan Chanyuan practices Buddhism. In theory, Buddhist places emphasize quiet cultivation, yet strangely, these past years Shan Chanyuan has been the most chaotic. The Four Great Chanyuans are locked in internal strife, their relations having deteriorated into fire and water over these years; this palace does not recommend you go there."
It was common knowledge that the Four Great Chanyuans comprised Samsara Chanyuan, Six Paths Chanyuan, Silent Speech Chanyuan, and Joyous Union Chanyuan.

In Zhang Xian's view: Samsara Chanyuan preached cultivating future lives and karma; Six Paths Chanyuan preached equality among all sentient beings; Silent Speech Chanyuan consisted of "mute gourds" who remained silent, preaching non-action; As for Joyous Union Chanyuan... they were simply evil monks practicing dual cultivation. He heard they even abducted female cultivators to use as cauldrons—seeming no different from demonic paths.
Except those female cultivators forced into being cauldrons... afterward would claim they were willing participants, refusing to return.
Matters between consenting adults left no handle for accusations, allowing Joyous Union Chanyuan to continue acting arrogantly.
In short, amongst the Six Great Powers, due to Joyous Union Chanyuan’s influence, Shan Chanyuan’s reputation was the worst.

"I also do not recommend you go to Treasure Azure Workshop. They have a similar background as our Cloud Raiment Pavilion—originating from merchant associations—wealthy but lacking deep foundations compared to other factions."

"As for the Yunmiao Sect... their most renowned 'Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra' emphasizes nurturing jade with spirit, shaping the body with jade. Cultivated to great completion, the flesh body becomes like jade—impervious to all techniques. It is suitable for the little girl beside you."

"Moreover, the Yunmiao Sect differs from other sects: multiple peaks stand like a forest, with a hundred flowers blooming. Dan Ding Peak excels in alchemy; Po Yun Peak masters Sword Dao; Xuan Ji Peak is proficient in formations... Each peak possesses its own legacy, yet they do not interfere with each other while complementing one another. I actually recommend going there."
Zhang Xian’s eyebrow twitched imperceptibly. "Pavilion Master seems quite familiar with the Yunmiao Sect."

"My late husband frequently interacted with the Yunmiao Sect, so I learned a bit." Her tone paused slightly; a trace of recollection flickered in her eyes. "Yunmiao Sect Elder Nangong Yao shares some friendship with me; I can send a message to her requesting assistance in looking after Fellow Daoist, saving you much trouble."
Nangong Yao!?
Dead memories reignited; Zhang Xian smiled.

chapters.title: Chapter 33 I’m Fcking Here
paragraphs: Until nightfall descended, Zhang Xian remained in the Cloud Raiment Pavilion’s courtyard annex.
Yun Qi wore a peculiar expression. "Fellow Daoist Zhang, what major business did you discuss with my aunt? She hasn’t spoken to anyone for so long—many years, in fact."

Lin Yinyin, who was playing a spirit drum, hummed laughingly, "Brother, chatting with the Southern Region’s number one beauty must make you happy, right? Are you reluctant to leave? How beautiful is she?"
Centuries ago, Yun Wanqing was hailed as the Southern Region’s number one beauty. Countless heaven's favored sons vied for her favor, yet in the end, an unknown rogue cultivator got lucky.
Zhang Xian smiled without speaking. Lin Yinyin plucked at the spirit drum, asking Yun Zhen'er, "Zhen-girl, who do you think is prettier, your mother or me, your sister?"
Yun Zhen'er thought for a moment and said in a soft, sticky voice, "Mmm... Sister is younger."
"Haha." Lin Yinyin patted Yun Zhen'er’s head, teasing, "Sister will find your mother another husband, okay?"

"Good! Mother is alone and works hard." Yun Zhen'er nodded repeatedly, then glanced at Zhang Xian. "But Zhen'er doesn't want Uncle to be Daddy. Uncle is a good person, but he's too ugly! He's not worthy of Mother."
"Hahaha." Lin Yinyin laughed even louder.
Zhang Xian's face darkened.
Early the next morning, Lin Yinyin curled up in Zhang Xian’s arms, her voice soft and tender. "This palace is yours from now on; you must be responsible for me."
Zhang Xian was helpless. She's addicted to imitating Yun Wanqing now.
"Yinyin, next month, accompany me to join the Yunmiao Sect."
Lin Yinyin sat up abruptly, as if she had been recharged, ignoring the sudden exposure of her spring scenery. "Really?! Brother!"

"I've already agreed with Pavilion Master Yun; she will recommend us to the Yunmiao Sect's inner sect. They have complete cultivation techniques and famous masters for guidance. With your Supreme Water Spirit Root, I estimate they will be fighting to take you as a personal disciple."
"Wu... I don't want to be a personal disciple. I just want to stay with Brother."
Thus passed several days. Zhang Xian brought Lin Yinyin and boarded the Yun family’s flying boat.
Yun Qi escorted the two to the gangway, pulling Zhang Xian aside. "Everything is arranged properly. The flying boat will pass by the Yunmiao Sect, and someone will receive you there."
"Also, the cabin room's soundproofing formation has been specially repaired. Fellow Daoist Zhang, rest assured this time."
Overhearing this, Lin Yinyin immediately blushed crimson.
Zhang Xian coughed twice. "Also, remember to keep those pills for me; they are very expensive.
"I know, I know. Our Cloud Raiment Pavilion will take the blame for you."

"Oh, and about the flying boat. I asked your aunt earlier, and she said there is a type of small flying boat that costs about four million mid-grade spirit stones. Help me order one. I want it fast, stable, soundproofed, with defensive formations, and puppet controls."

Upon hearing this, Yun Qi's head swelled, and he shook it repeatedly. "You're not really buying it, are you? I thought you were joking! As a dignified Grand Internal Affairs Commander, where would I find the time to supervise work for you? Flying boats are troublesome; I have to coordinate with so many mechanism sects. No time, no time."
"I can add twenty percent as a supervision fee. This is the deposit."
Smack!
Zhang Xian slammed down a large chest. Yun Qi waved his long robe, and the chest vanished as if it had never appeared.
"Please elaborate on your requirements. Within a year, I will personally deliver the flying boat to your door."
Yunmiao Sect, Ascending Immortal Gate.
A winding queue perennially stretched out, extending for hundreds of miles as disciples sought to join the sect.

Someone specially calculated the statistics: every year, the number of disciples seeking immortality at the Yunmiao Sect reached one hundred thousand, yet only a little over a hundred were admitted. This number included outer sect disciples and registered disciples. Even with such slim chances, the number of people seeking immortality only increased every year.
"Wow! What is that?" A cry of amazement erupted from the crowd, spreading for dozens of miles.
"A flying boat! Holy crap, it's huge!"
"A spreading blue luan carved with the character 'Cloud'—it's the Cloud Raiment Pavilion's flying boat!"
"This is what I call f*cking cultivating immortality!"
"I must join the Yunmiao Sect! I want to fly a boat too!"
"Wake up, Fellow Daoist. Even if you enter the Yunmiao Sect, you won't be flying a boat."
Lin Yinyin watched the dense mass of tiny dots below, thinking that if she hadn't met Brother Zhang Xian, she probably would have been one of those people in the crowd.
At the end of the line of dots sat a floating mountain peak. Pavilions and towers appeared faintly at the summit, glowing with a soft golden light under the morning sun.
"Is that the Yunmiao Sect?"

"That is the Yunmiao Sect's Outer Sect Mountain Gate, specifically for receiving prospective disciples," spoke a middle-aged man with a steady appearance, an internal affairs deacon of the Cloud Raiment Pavilion. "The true mountain gate is still behind it."

Following the deacon's pointing finger, as the flying boat moved forward, the clouds and mist gradually receded. A magnificent aura descended from the nine heavens, like an immortal brushing their sleeve to clear away ten thousand miles of vastness.

Peaks stood suspended in the void, their bodies white as jade with rosy light flowing hidden within. At the summits, jade towers layered upon each other. At the base of the peaks, countless white jade rainbow bridges spanned the void.

At the highest point, on the main peak, a glazed immortal palace stood majestically. The palace gate plaque bore four characters written in celestial script: "Yunmiao Heavenly Palace," the strokes sharp as swords.
Such a towering sight left Lin Yinyin somewhat stunned.
So beautiful!
She glanced at Zhang Xian beside her, only to see him standing with a calm face and a faint smile.
Brother is so steady, so handsome. Lin Yinyin's small face turned red again.

Actually, Zhang Xian was no less shocked than she was. The true imagery of an immortal sect was countless times more magnificent and spectacular than any TV screen from his past life. However, he had to maintain his persona as the spokesperson for a minor world.
"Not bad. It has the flavor of an immortal sect."

The flying boat slowly descended onto a platform. Several disciples dressed in moon-white long robes had been waiting for a long time. Seeing the flying boat land, a female cultivator with delicate features stepped forward and bowed with cupped hands.
"Are you the esteemed guests of the Cloud Raiment Pavilion?"

Zhang Xian nodded, took out the token Yun Wanqing had given him, and handed it to her. The female cultivator took it, looked at it, and her expression instantly became several degrees more respectful.
"So it is Elder Nangong's guests. Please follow me."
Lin Yinyin tugged quietly at Zhang Xian's sleeve and whispered, "Brother Zhang Xian, who is Elder Nangong? Do you know her?"
"I don't know her. She's a friend of Pavilion Master Yun."
Inside the Yunmiao Sect's inner gate, spiritual mist swirled, and immortal cranes circled overhead.
The reception female cultivator led the two through layers of restrictions, finally stopping in front of an exquisite courtyard.
"Please rest here for now. Elder Nangong is not in the sect these days. Other elders have been arranged for you two; you will meet them tomorrow."

After the female cultivator left, Lin Yinyin finally couldn't hold back. she spun around the courtyard, exclaiming, "The spiritual energy here is so dense! It's not much worse than the spiritual energy from our Spirit Gathering Array!"
Zhang Xian looked at the scene before him. One hundred years. I never thought I would really have the chance to stand here.
The scene of heavenly fire falling on the small mountain village a hundred years ago was vivid in his mind. That was the moment his destiny changed.
Is the little black girl here? How has she been these years?
And Nangong Yao, you bitch!! I'm fcking here!*

"So it is Elder Nangong's guests.
Please follow me."
Lin Yinyin tugged quietly at Zhang Xian's sleeve and whispered, "Brother Zhang Xian, who is Elder Nangong?
Do you know her?"
"I don't know her.
She's a friend of Pavilion Master Yun."
Inside the Yunmiao Sect's inner gate, spiritual mist swirled, and immortal cranes circled overhead.
The reception female cultivator led the two through layers of restrictions, finally stopping in front of an exquisite courtyard.
"Please rest here for now.
Elder Nangong is not in the sect these days.
Other elders have been arranged for you two; you will meet them tomorrow."
After the female cultivator left, Lin Yinyin finally couldn't hold back. she spun around the courtyard, exclaiming, "The spiritual energy here is so dense!
It's not much worse than the spiritual energy from our Spirit Gathering Array!"
Zhang Xian looked at the scene before him.
One hundred years.
I never thought I would really have the chance to stand here.
The scene of heavenly fire falling on the small mountain village a hundred years ago was vivid in his mind.
That was the moment his destiny changed.
Is the little black girl here?
How has she been these years?
And Nangong Yao, you bitch!!
I'm fcking here!*

chapters.title: Chapter 34 Truth!
paragraphs: The next day.
A handsome young man arrived riding a sword, landing in front of the courtyard.
Zhang Xian and Lin Yinyin were leaning back-to-back, each holding a Yunmiao Sect tome in their hands.
The young man stepped forward and cupped his hands in greeting. "I am the Peak Master of Wuwang Peak, Wangya. You two must be the honored guests from the Cloud Raiment Pavilion."
Zhang Xian and Lin Yinyin returned the courtesy politely.

The message from the Cloud Raiment Pavilion had already explained the origins of the two. One was a wealthy young master from a minor world who had business dealings with the Cloud Raiment Pavilion, accompanied by a Dao Companion of exceptionally high talent, possessing a top-grade Water Spirit Root.

For Yun Wanqing to personally vouch for them, this wealthy young master was definitely not just ordinarily rich. Wangya could tell at a glance that Zhang Xian practiced the False Core technique, further confirming his guess. The False Core technique was not something just anyone could afford to sustain.
"Junior Sister Nangong has gone out on a training journey, so I will be receiving you two."
"We apologize for troubling the Peak Master."
"Pavilion Master Yun has already explained in her message that you two wish to enter our sect's inner sect to cultivate. I wonder if you have any particular cultivation techniques or goals in mind."
Zhang Xian smiled. "I hail from a lower realm and only know that the Yunmiao Sect's Dao methods are peerlessly profound. I wonder what recommendations the Peak Master might have."

"Peerless is an overstatement, but our Yunmiao Sect is diverse, with each peak's Dao methods being quite different. Disciples can choose their path based on affinity and opportunity. Moreover, our sect emphasizes open exchange. It's not that once you choose a particular peak, you can only cultivate there. Each peak holds morning and evening lessons daily, and any inner sect disciple is free to attend them.

"With Pavilion Master Yun's recommendation, you two can choose a peak to cultivate at as nominal disciples. If fate allows in the future, it's not impossible to choose another master and become a personal disciple."
Zhang Xian and Lin Yinyin nodded in agreement. Openness and freedom were major characteristics of the Yunmiao Sect.
"The supreme technique I cultivate is the sect's 'Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra.' If you don't mind, you can join my Wuwang Peak." Wangya directly extended an olive branch.

Lin Yinyin's top-grade Water Spirit Root had sparked his desire for talent. Of course, there was another more hidden reason: he had once been one of Yun Wanqing's suitors. Being able to help his goddess made him very happy.

"My affinity with the Dao is shallow, and I fear we may not be able to bear the weight of the Great Dao. I wonder if there are other cultivation paths within the sect for us to choose?" Zhang Xian quickly refused. Joking aside, he wasn't comfortable placing Lin Yinyin under a young male cultivator, especially one who was so handsome.
Wangya inwardly sighed with regret. With a wave of his sleeve, dozens of lines of text materialized in the air.
Peak Name Peak Master/Supervisor Specialization
Mysterious Mechanism Peak Wangji Formations
Heavenly Puppet Peak Su Yuanshen Puppet Crafting
Spirit Sword Peak Li Fuxi Sword Techniques
"These are peaks that accept nominal disciples. You can take a look," Wangya introduced.
Zhang Xian immediately noticed the name Li Fuxi. He remembered she was also a 20-point Daughter of Destiny who had bid against him for the Beauty Preservation Pill.
"The Spirit Sword Peak looks good. Yinyin and I have been fascinated by swordplay since we were young."

"Oh, Spirit Sword Peak hasn't had a Peak Master for many years. The one currently overseeing Spirit Sword Peak is the Supervisor. She also primarily cultivates the 'Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra.' If you two wish to learn sword techniques, you should go to Po Yun Peak," Wangya kindly reminded them.
"It's fine. That's the one. I feel the words 'Spirit Sword' have an affinity with me," Zhang Xian said determinedly.
"Very well." Wangya's expression turned somewhat odd, thinking to himself that this kid might have ulterior motives. "I'll send a message to Junior Sister Fuxi and have her come fetch you."
After a while, two figures rode the wind and arrived, sheathing their swords as they landed mid-air.
The one behind was a burly young man wearing a moon-white robe, tall and large-framed. Hmm, supporting character, not important.
The leading female cultivator wore a loose white robe with silver patterns and wide sleeves. Her figure was somewhat petite, probably less than 1.6 meters tall, with a somewhat cute braid.
[Ding! Li Fuxi's Favorability towards you is -5. Binding successful.]

Her face was smooth and lustrous, her cheeks still carrying some baby fat, making her appear somewhat youthful. However, she happened to have almond-shaped eyes, and the tear mole under the corner of her eye added a hint of allure. What drew Zhang Xian's attention most were her pair of impressive 'truths,' which even her loose embroidered robe couldn't conceal.
The moment Lin Yinyin saw her, alarm bells rang loudly in her heart.
Danger!!
She even suspected her brother specifically came for this Li Fuxi; it was too suspicious!
Such a beautiful woman! Though a bit short, her 'truths' are far too threatening; Lin Yinyin is no match.
"You're the disciples shoved in by the Cloud Raiment Pavilion?" Li Fuxi's voice was clear and pleasant but carried a trace of impatience.

Not only was Li Fuxi displeased; the burly young man behind her was also scrutinizing them with an examining gaze. His Dao title was Zhenhai, the chief disciple of Spirit Sword Peak, at Golden Core First Layer.

I heard it's some rich second-generation bringing along a pretty girl. They specifically asked to come to our Spirit Sword Peak; their motives might be impure; I need to be careful and vigilant, Zhenhai thought secretly.
Hmm? Damn! This girl is so pretty! Master, please accept her!

Seeing Li Fuxi's unfriendly tone, Wangya quickly stepped forward with a smile: "These two have good aptitude and talent; they might even bring glory to your Spirit Sword Peak." At the same time, he secretly messaged her:

"Junior Sister, your Spirit Sword Peak is short on people right now. This girl has a top-grade Water Spirit Root. Besides, accepting an inner sect disciple means extra spirit stone subsidies every year. Have you forgotten?
"Understood." Li Fuxi responded sullenly.
Hearing Li Fuxi's question, Zhang Xian politely replied: "We are friends of the Cloud Raiment Pavilion who have come seeking apprenticeship and skills."
"Hmph! I heard you even hold that woman Nangong Yao's token? And yet you dare seek apprenticeship under me?" Li Fuxi said coldly.
Oh? Zhang Xian's eyes lit up; this woman seemed to have some grudge against Nangong Yao too. You're the one!
"Ahem. These two don't know Junior Sister Nangong either; Pavilion Master Yun gave them the token," Wangya stepped in to smooth things over.
"Yun Wanqing? No wonder Senior Brother is so concerned about this matter. Don't forget you also cultivate the 'Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra'!" Li Fuxi shot Wangya a sidelong glance.
Wangya gave an awkward smile without speaking.

Li Fuxi glanced at Zhang Xian briefly before looking away—low-grade Spirit Root, cultivating the False Core technique, and ordinary looks; nothing worth seeing. She then glanced at Lin Yinyin and couldn't help but brighten up.
Possessing a top-grade Water Spirit Root indeed made her excellent material for cultivating the 'Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra.' What a pity though.

"Little girl, though your Primordial Yin is already lost, if you sever your emotional ties with him and follow me cultivating the 'Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra,' I guarantee you can achieve Golden Core," Li Fuxi said.
Lin Yinyin frighteningly shrank behind Zhang Xian; this short woman was kind of fierce!
She wanted to change teachers.
Zhang Xian glanced at Li Fuxi several times; he always felt she looked somewhat familiar but couldn't quite remember who she resembled at the moment.
However, he wouldn't give up on a Daughter of Destiny delivered to his doorstep. Pulling Lin Yinyin out from behind him, he made a deep bow. "We ask Daoist Fuxi to accept Yinyin and me."
[Ding! Li Fuxi's Favorability towards you -2. Current Favorability -7.]
"Follow me." Sensing his gaze, Li Fuxi didn't lash out, merely snorted.

With a flick of her embroidered sleeve, she condensed a sword over ten feet wide mid-air. Simultaneously, spiritual energy lifted Zhang Xian and Lin Yinyin as they, along with the others, stepped onto the flying sword. With a whoosh, they disappeared.
"Tsk tsk, didn't even say goodbye to Senior Brother." Wangya shook his head helplessly.
He had a feeling that kid Zhang Xian seemed to be targeting Junior Sister Fuxi.
"Unstable Dao heart, facing the tribulations of lust? That kid has no future," Wangya sighed again.
Right, I should send some messages to Wanqing, telling her to advise these juniors. Don't let anything happen later, affecting our pure relationship.
