chapters.title: Chapter 35 Respect Your Elder
paragraphs: The flying sword cleaved through the sky with a sharp whistle, the wind whipping their robes into a frenzy against their bodies. Lin Yinyin felt a surge of excitement. In the past, flying boats had always been shielded by protective barriers, insulating passengers from the elements. But this? This was riding the wind in the truest sense.
Overjoyed, she hugged Zhang Xian's arm even tighter.
"Junior Sister, don't be afraid! Just channel spiritual energy into your soles to stabilize your stance!" Zhenhai's voice barely carried over the howling gale.
Seeing their intimate posture, a sour taste flooded Zhenhai's mouth. Why? Just because he has some stinking money?
To think such a beautiful Junior Sister is already taken. But I don't mind. I can take over. Zhenhai gazed at Lin Yinyin's back, lost in his own fantasies.

Unfortunately for him, Lin Yinyin feigned deafness against the roaring wind, burrowing even deeper into Zhang Xian's embrace. She peeked ahead at Li Fuxi; the onrushing gale pressed the older woman’s robes tight against her frame, accentuating curves that were nothing short of breathtaking.
Lin Yinyin looked down at herself, bitterness rising in her throat. What sort of "truth" was this? Those were clearly two insurmountable mountains!
Noticing Lin Yinyin's lack of decorum, Li Fuxi raised a hand, casting a wind-blocking spell to silence the gale. She spoke coldly, "On my Spirit Sword Peak, behave with propriety!"
Lin Yinyin could only straighten her posture, her face flushed with shame.
Less than half an hour later, the flying sword dove vertically, piercing the swirling sea of clouds. The true scenery of Spirit Sword Peak gradually came into view.

Lin Yinyin's eyes went wide. Instead of grandeur, she saw only a few dozen crude thatched huts scattered across the mountain ridge. The wind rustled through the dry straw, the sights and sounds identical to a common mortal village.
Were the immortal pavilions and jade towers we saw yesterday all illusions?
Is the Yunmiao Sect actually a scam ring?
"This... this is Spirit Sword Peak?" Zhang Xian was equally stunned. The living quarters here bore a striking resemblance to the small mountain village he had inhabited a hundred years ago.
"Does cultivation require opulence? Austerity fosters focus!" Li Fuxi curled her lips into a cold smile as she turned toward them.
"From this day forth, you two are nominal disciples of my Spirit Sword Peak. Remember, I am your master, Li Fuxi."
As she spoke, she conjured two jade tokens that flew into Zhang Xian's and Lin Yinyin's hands, respectively. The tokens were engraved with the character "Xi."
Seeing the familiar-looking jade token stirred up unpleasant memories for Zhang Xian.
Sword energy burst from Li Fuxi's fingertip. She waved at the air, and two streaks of sword energy dispersed, indicating two thatched huts—one in the east and one in the west.
"You, take the east side." She pointed her sword fingers at Zhang Xian, then turned to Lin Yinyin. "You, take the west side."
The two huts were separated by several miles, with a mountain stream dividing them down the middle. Lin Yinyin's eyes instantly reddened.
She is clearly trying to separate me from my brother!
"Brother..." She looked pitifully at Zhang Xian, only to find him staring up at the highest thatched hut on the peak with a faint, elusive smile on his lips.
It's over! Brother has already been blinded by the "truth."
Lin Yinyin began to somewhat regret coming to the Yunmiao Sect.
"Aren't you going to pay respects to your Master?" Li Fuxi spoke again.
"Do we have to kneel?" Zhang Xian asked. He had never knelt before anyone in his life; he felt an innate resistance to kowtowing.
Li Fuxi snorted. "Immortal cultivation sects do not bother with such empty mortal formalities. A disciple's bow is sufficient."
"Greetings, Master," Zhang Xian said, bowing respectfully.
"Greetings, Master," Lin Yinyin followed suit.

"Hmm." Li Fuxi seemed somewhat satisfied. She materialized two cultivation manuals and continued, "This is the first level of our sect's supreme technique, the Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra. Study it repeatedly. If there is anything you don't understand, you can ask me after the evening lecture each day."

"You don't need to attend today's evening lecture. Go settle in and rest. Later, a disciple will give you a detailed introduction to Spirit Sword Peak's rules. Remember not to be late for tomorrow's morning session!"
With that, Li Fuxi tapped her toes against the ground and soared toward the mountain peak.
"Brother..." Lin Yinyin pouted.
Zhang Xian smiled and patted her shoulder. "Be good. Let's get settled first."
After saying this, he walked toward the small thatched hut in the east.
Lin Yinyin stomped her foot in anger but had no choice but to head west.
Following behind her was an eager Zhenhai. "Junior Sister, let me escort you. I'll explain our peak's rules to you along the way."
Zhang Xian approached his allocated hut and pushed open the creaking bamboo door.

The interior was spartan. The hut contained only a rough wooden bed with a set of blue-and-white disciple robes neatly folded beside it. On the floor lay a plain meditation mat, along with a weathered table and a simple stool.
Zhang Xian wandered around the hut for a moment. In front of it was a small platform with a stone table and several stone stools—a place designed for daily meditation and breathing exercises.
To his surprise, behind the hut lay a living spring. Clear water gurgled from cracks in the rocks, forming a small pool enclosed by bluestone that steamed with faint spiritual energy.

Zhang Xian lightly touched the stone wall at the edge of the spring, finding many grooves carved into it. The edges of these grooves bore inscriptions; presumably, embedding spirit stones here could enhance the spring's power.

He returned inside the thatched hut. Through the open doors and windows, he occasionally saw spiritual birds flitting past. Feeling the abundant spiritual energy permeating heaven and earth, his thoughts gradually drifted far away.
"Brother Shan, are we going hunting today?"
A voice seemed to echo in his ears—the voice of the Little Black Girl—crossing a hundred years of time.
Just as he was lost in thought, hurried footsteps approached from outside. Lin Yinyin appeared at the doorway; she had already changed into the Yunmiao Sect's standard blue-and-white disciple robes.

The elegant fabric clung to her frame, outlining her graceful curves. The silk belt cinching her waist emphasized her slender, delicate figure—looking as if one could span it with a single hand. A wooden hairpin swayed gently in her hair as she moved, making her small face appear even more charmingly lovely.
"Brother," Lin Yinyin said sweetly as she sat down beside Zhang Xian. "That big-chested woman is too hateful; she wants to separate us."
Zhang Xian smiled slightly. "Now she is our Master; we must respect our elder."
"Respect?" she retorted playfully, leaning in conspiratorially. "Tell me honestly—did you have your eye on 'our elder' from the start?"
"How could that be!"
"I saw you sneaking glances at Master several times!"
"I just thought she looked somewhat familiar."

"Hmph! Stop pretending to be such an upright gentleman—that’s exactly how you tricked me back then!" Then, suddenly changing her tone and leaning in close enough to whisper: "By the way... Brother... there’s actually another spiritual spring behind this mountain... I want us both—"
"Ahem." Zhang Xian coughed twice, interrupting her. "Someone’s coming."
They straightened up just as a female cultivator appeared at the doorframe. She wore a high ponytail, and while her features weren’t stunningly beautiful, she carried a certain heroic air.
"Hope I’m not disturbing Junior Brother and Sister?" she asked clearly.
"No!"
"No!"

They answered simultaneously. The female cultivator stepped inside boldly, sitting down on the only available stool while giving them a knowing look. "Tsk tsk... exactly like Senior Brother said—one great beauty alongside one guy... Junior Brother must be quite wealthy then?"
"What makes you say so?" Zhang Xian asked, puzzled.
"Well, it can’t possibly be because you’re good in bed," she replied bluntly, causing a shock to go through the room before she quickly added, "Just joking!"

She clasped her hands together formally. "Let me introduce myself—I am Chen Tiexin; you may also call me Fourth Senior Sister. Today I’ll be giving you the rundown on the basics of our Spirit Sword Peak."
The two imitated the gesture, returning the courtesy with a slight bow.
"Welcome to the poorest peak within the entire sect!"

"Aren't you going to pay respects to your Master?" Li Fuxi spoke again.
"Do we have to kneel?" Zhang Xian asked.
He had never knelt before anyone in his life; he felt an innate resistance to kowtowing.
Li Fuxi snorted.
"Immortal cultivation sects do not bother with such empty mortal formalities.
A disciple's bow is sufficient."
"Greetings, Master," Zhang Xian said, bowing respectfully.
"Greetings, Master," Lin Yinyin followed suit.
"Hmm." Li Fuxi seemed somewhat satisfied.
She materialized two cultivation manuals and continued, "This is the first level of our sect's supreme technique, the Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra.
Study it repeatedly.
If there is anything you don't understand, you can ask me after the evening lecture each day."
"You don't need to attend today's evening lecture.
Go settle in and rest.
Later, a disciple will give you a detailed introduction to Spirit Sword Peak's rules.
Remember not to be late for tomorrow's morning session!"
With that, Li Fuxi tapped her toes against the ground and soared toward the mountain peak.
"Brother..." Lin Yinyin pouted.
Zhang Xian smiled and patted her shoulder.
"Be good.
Let's get settled first."
After saying this, he walked toward the small thatched hut in the east.
Lin Yinyin stomped her foot in anger but had no choice but to head west.
Following behind her was an eager Zhenhai.
"Junior Sister, let me escort you.
I'll explain our peak's rules to you along the way."
Zhang Xian approached his allocated hut and pushed open the creaking bamboo door.
The interior was spartan.
The hut contained only a rough wooden bed with a set of blue-and-white disciple robes neatly folded beside it.
On the floor lay a plain meditation mat, along with a weathered table and a simple stool.
Zhang Xian wandered around the hut for a moment.
In front of it was a small platform with a stone table and several stone stools—a place designed for daily meditation and breathing exercises.
To his surprise, behind the hut lay a living spring.
Clear water gurgled from cracks in the rocks, forming a small pool enclosed by bluestone that steamed with faint spiritual energy.
Zhang Xian lightly touched the stone wall at the edge of the spring, finding many grooves carved into it.
The edges of these grooves bore inscriptions; presumably, embedding spirit stones here could enhance the spring's power.
He returned inside the thatched hut.
Through the open doors and windows, he occasionally saw spiritual birds flitting past.
Feeling the abundant spiritual energy permeating heaven and earth, his thoughts gradually drifted far away.
"Brother Shan, are we going hunting today?"
A voice seemed to echo in his ears—the voice of the Little Black Girl—crossing a hundred years of time.
Just as he was lost in thought, hurried footsteps approached from outside.
Lin Yinyin appeared at the doorway; she had already changed into the Yunmiao Sect's standard blue-and-white disciple robes.
The elegant fabric clung to her frame, outlining her graceful curves.
The silk belt cinching her waist emphasized her slender, delicate figure—looking as if one could span it with a single hand.
A wooden hairpin swayed gently in her hair as she moved, making her small face appear even more charmingly lovely.
"Brother," Lin Yinyin said sweetly as she sat down beside Zhang Xian.
"That big-chested woman is too hateful; she wants to separate us."
Zhang Xian smiled slightly.
"Now she is our Master; we must respect our elder."
"Respect?" she retorted playfully, leaning in conspiratorially.
"Tell me honestly—did you have your eye on 'our elder' from the start?"
"How could that be!"
"I saw you sneaking glances at Master several times!"
"I just thought she looked somewhat familiar."
"Hmph!
Stop pretending to be such an upright gentleman—that’s exactly how you tricked me back then!" Then, suddenly changing her tone and leaning in close enough to whisper: "By the way...
Brother... there’s actually another spiritual spring behind this mountain...
I want us both—"
"Ahem." Zhang Xian coughed twice, interrupting her.
"Someone’s coming."
They straightened up just as a female cultivator appeared at the doorframe.
She wore a high ponytail, and while her features weren’t stunningly beautiful, she carried a certain heroic air.
"Hope I’m not disturbing Junior Brother and Sister?" she asked clearly.
"No!"
"No!"
They answered simultaneously.
The female cultivator stepped inside boldly, sitting down on the only available stool while giving them a knowing look.
"Tsk tsk... exactly like Senior Brother said—one great beauty alongside one guy...
Junior Brother must be quite wealthy then?"
"What makes you say so?" Zhang Xian asked, puzzled.
"Well, it can’t possibly be because you’re good in bed," she replied bluntly, causing a shock to go through the room before she quickly added, "Just joking!"
She clasped her hands together formally.
"Let me introduce myself—I am Chen Tiexin; you may also call me Fourth Senior Sister.
Today I’ll be giving you the rundown on the basics of our Spirit Sword Peak."
The two imitated the gesture, returning the courtesy with a slight bow.
"Welcome to the poorest peak within the entire sect!"

chapters.title: Chapter 36 Master’s Books Have Always Been in the Top Three
paragraphs: Upon hearing Chen Tiexin's words, Lin Yinyin immediately pulled a long face. Having grown up this big, she had never lived in such a shabby house before. It was truly miserable.
Zhang Xian, on the other hand, didn't mind. It didn't matter if Spirit Sword Peak was poor; he was rich.

"There's no need to be disheartened. We may look poor, but everyone's resources are actually equal. Don't be fooled by these thatched huts built one after another like some mountain stronghold. The spiritual energy on our Spirit Sword Peak ranks among the top of the seventy-two peaks. Plus, each household has its own private hot spring spiritual pool. Tsk tsk, that's something other peaks can't enjoy."
"If the resources are all the same, then why are we so poor?" Lin Yinyin asked curiously.
Chen Tiexin smiled and suddenly drew the long sword in her hand with a zheng, her movements as gentle as caressing a lover. "Because all the money is spent feeding my wife!"

She lovingly stroked the sword's spine, where a gold thread as fine as a hair was embedded. "The Profound Gold Sword Pattern needs to be redrawn every year. It allows the sword to perform even better. The material cost alone is fifty contribution points."

As she spoke, she unfastened the scabbard at her waist, revealing densely packed inscriptions on the inside. "Green Gang wood base, lined with Ice Silkworm silk, then commissioned from a talisman cultivator to inscribe Dust Repelling and Nurturing Incantations—that can't be done for less than a hundred points."

"And then there's the sword tassel, the hilt wrapping, the sword case... and I only bought the basic versions." At this point, Chen Tiexin lowered her voice a little. "The most expensive part is the full sword maintenance. Minor maintenance every three months, major maintenance once a year. It's a constant drain of money."
Lin Yinyin: "..."

"The most outrageous are those lunatics from Cloud-Piercing Peak," Chen Tiexin suddenly gritted her teeth. "They buy rouge and powder for their lifebound magic swords! They say the sword has a spirit and also needs grooming."

Just as she was speaking, her long sword suddenly buzzed and trembled violently. Chen Tiexin immediately became flustered and began stroking the sword body affectionately. "Wife, don't be angry! I'll definitely get you a new sword case next month! I'll let you live in a big house."
Zhang Xian: "..."
"What are these contribution points you mentioned?"

"Five points each for morning and evening classes daily, commonly called 'roll call.' Full attendance for the month earns you ten points steadily by month-end; you can take one day off per month. That's the most basic income."

She continued counting on her fingers: "Besides that, you can take on tasks for extra income. The Sect's Mission Hall posts various bounties, like clearing demon beasts, gathering spirit herbs, or appeasing vengeful spirits. The various Peak Masters and Supervisors occasionally also directly assign tasks; the rewards are quite generous too."
"For example, me coming here today to impart experience to you earns me a five-point reward. It's considered a cushy job."

"If you want to study at other peaks, it only costs two points per month as an exchange student fee. Dirt cheap." Chen Tiexin grinned. "Of course, miscellaneous fees are separate. For example, for alchemy classes at Dan Ding Peak, material fees would add at least another five points."
Zhang Xian nodded. So this was what Wangya meant by freedom and openness.

"Of course, if you go study at other peaks, you won't get our Spirit Sword Peak's full attendance bonus anymore. And our Spirit Sword Peak's morning class is for learning sword techniques; the evening class is lecturing on the Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra."

"These two courses are quite repetitive. Plus, Master is only a Supervisor; many of those teaching at other peaks are Peak Masters themselves. That's why there have always been very few people joining our peak."
"What are these Supervisors and Peak Masters you mentioned?
"A Peak Master is the master of a peak; their cultivation must reach the late Golden Core stage. Master happens to be stuck at the sixth layer of Golden Core, so she's a Supervisor."
"But currently, our Spirit Sword Peak only has Master as the sole Supervisor, so she also acts as the Acting Peak Master simultaneously. Did you really come here knowing nothing?"
"Master's morning class business is actually pretty good; disciples from other peaks often come to audit. More people attending means she gets more subsidies from the sect."
"You just said it's very repetitive, and Master is only a Supervisor. Why would people still come to audit?" Zhang Xian asked again.
Chen Tiexin suddenly lowered her voice and gave Zhang Xian an ambiguous look. "They're like you; they came for Master."
Zhang Xian: "?"
Chen Tiexin gestured an exaggerated curve in front of her chest. "The Sword Scripture... Master demonstrates it personally."
Lin Yinyin: "!!!"
Chen Tiexin chuckled slyly. "After all, Master's books have always been firmly in the top three within our sect."
"What books?" Zhang Xian was stunned.

Chen Tiexin glanced out the window and casually set up an isolation array to block detection. She then pulled out several exquisitely bound booklets from her bosom. The covers prominently displayed titles like Deadly Love: My Yandere Master Falls for Me, The Yunmiao Sect Outcast: I Refine All Three Realms, and Starting with Being Jilted: The Empress Ends Up as My Palm Darling.
Lin Yinyin curiously leaned over to look and immediately widened her eyes. "Th-this yandere master... why does she look like Master?!"

"Bingo! It is Master." Chen Tiexin snapped her fingers. "This one is the bestseller this year. Of course, Master often makes cameo appearances as part of harems in other books too. That's why I said top three."

After saying that, she even flipped open a book. Inside were accompanying memory crystal images—unmistakably Li Fuxi's peerless beauty—and from some angles, one could even glimpse the outline of her... profound truths.
Zhang Xian's mouth twitched. "The sect doesn't care?"
"Care?" Chen Tiexin scoffed mockingly. "Guess who tacitly allows these books to circulate?"

She mysteriously pointed upwards with her finger. "It's said that a certain high-ranking figure up there enjoys reading these books very much. As long as you don't write explicit content, no one investigates."

Then Chen Tiexin pointed at Lin Yinyin again. "Also, Junior Sister Lin... your memory crystal images have already been sold off. Probably in a few days' time, there will be books featuring you appearing—like Junior Sister Slacks Off Again? Ended Up Pressed into Cultivation by Me or something similar—so don't be surprised when it happens later on.
Lin Yinyin: "Who? Me? I just arrived yesterday!"

"Who do you think took those memory crystal images of Master? Of course it was Senior Brother Da Shi! But it could also have been other reception disciples or just someone passing by anyway... You'll get used to it eventually," said Chen Tiexin while taking out a memory crystal stone herself, aiming directly at Lin Yinyin’s face and capturing several close-up shots consecutively before exclaiming appreciatively.

"Tsk tsk tsk... Heavenly beauty indeed! Senior Sister sees great potential in you—you might even manage pushing down Teacher from first place someday soon enough! Let me take some absolutely stunning angled shots for now—we split the profits fifty-fifty after selling them!"
Lin Yinyin: "..."

"And there’s more than just that!" continued Chen Tiexin, divulging further gossip. "Those lunatics over at Heavenly Puppet Peak specialize specifically in crafting puppets modeled after female cultivators’ appearances, calling them lovingly ‘wives’."

"They’re all a bunch of deadbeat otakus, really... The most outrageous thing, though? They even offer custom services—as long as enough points are paid up front, they can make anyone’s puppet replica!"

"A few years back, someone made a puppet replica of Supervisor Xingxiu, became obsessively infatuated, crossed certain boundaries, and got suppressed heavily by the sect authorities once discovered... Now it is explicitly prohibited to create exact likeness replicas, but it is still possible to customize a fifty percent resemblance without issues."
"In short, so long as you keep a good grasp on the borderline limits, you won't get banned."
"So how about it? Feeling tempted yet? Vividly lifelike ones, oh~ Senior Sister has connections. I guarantee authentic reproduction plus practical usability is assured!"
Zhang Xian was completely dumbfounded now. "Is the Yunmiao Sect really this open-minded?"

Chen Tiexin patted his shoulder earnestly, saying solemnly, "Junior Brother, ah~ Cultivating immortality cultivates carefree freedom, not strict monastic rules... So long as your strength is sufficient, forget the books, even Teacher herself personally—"

"Junior Brother," interrupted Chen Tiexin, suddenly turning completely righteous-faced again mid-sentence, changing the topic abruptly back to a serious tone. "The Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra remains our sect’s supreme treasure. Thus, the amount of experience I shall impart ends here now, for fear of overloading your digestion capacity."
Zhang Xian adopted a solemn expression immediately, responding respectfully, "Senior Sister, thank you for teaching me."
Lin Yinyin likewise wore a serious expression, nodding along earnestly.
The next moment...
Li Fuxi’s divine sense descended abruptly upon them all instantly!
"Lin Yinyin, why are you still here? Come quickly inside my quarters now. I shall personally instruct you myself."
"Oh..." replied Lin Yinyin looking utterly dejected, reluctantly complying.

chapters.title: Chapter 37 The Yandere Master Falls for Me
paragraphs: As the crushing weight of Li Fuxi’s divine sense finally dissipated, the stagnant air in the courtyard began to flow freely once more.

Chen Tiexin retracted her soundproofing array, her brow furrowed in thought. "Strange. Usually, at this hour, Master would be nurturing her lifebound flying sword. Why did her divine sense descend so suddenly today?"
Her gaze swept over Lin Yinyin, and a wide grin broke across her face. "It seems Junior Sister Yinyin is truly receiving special attention."
Lin Yinyin walked toward the exit, looking back every few steps with wide, anxious eyes. "Brother... I'm a little scared."

Zhang Xian remained calm. He reached into his robes, pulled out the Boundary Crossing Shuttle given to him by Yun Wanqing, and stuffed it into Lin Yinyin's arms. "It's fine. Master isn't some man-eating monster. If she really intends you harm, just use this Boundary Crossing Shuttle to escape immediately."
Scared by Zhang Xian's grave preparations, Lin Yinyin looked on the verge of tears.
Brother, aren't you being a bit too dramatic? It's just a meeting with the Master. Handing me a supreme escape treasure makes me even more nervous!
[Ding! Successfully gifted Lin Yinyin the Boundary Crossing Shuttle. Triggered return. Returned: Void Breaking Shuttle x10.]

[Void Breaking Shuttle: Earth-grade consumable artifact. One-time use. No refinement required. Activated with essence blood. Ignores restrictions to penetrate all phenomena. Can tear through space to teleport tens of thousands of miles away. Using the Void Breaking Shuttle in advance allows setting a specific teleportation destination. Destination cannot be changed after being set.]
Huh? The quality actually improved? What a pleasant surprise.

Lin Yinyin departed with a heavy heart. Zhang Xian then turned his attention to Chen Tiexin. "Senior Sister, aside from missions and perfect attendance, are there faster ways to earn contribution points?"
Chen Tiexin's eyes lit up. "Junior Brother wants to take a shortcut?"
"Mn. After all, we're new here, and contribution points are tight. I also want to have the means to visit the other peaks more often."
"Hehe, of course there is! The black market."
"Black market?"

"Yes. There are always people short on spirit stones, and always people too lazy to grind missions." She rubbed her fingers together in the universal sign for money. "One point is worth about one hundred low-grade spirit stones."
Zhang Xian nodded thoughtfully. "What if I want to exchange for a large amount of points at once?"

"A large amount?" Chen Tiexin raised an eyebrow. "Junior Brother, the points circulating on the black market are limited. Usually, exchanging a few hundred points at once is the maximum. Any more than that, and the exchange rate becomes unfavorable."

"Let's start with twenty thousand points to wet my whistle." Zhang Xian casually pulled a heavy brocade pouch from his storage ring and tossed it to Chen Tiexin. "There are over twenty thousand mid-grade spirit stones in there. Can twenty thousand points be delivered within one month?"
Her eyes went wide, her voice cracking as it jumped an octave. "H-how many?!"
"Twenty thousand points," Zhang Xian repeated calmly. "Is the rate insufficient? If it is, I can add more. Consider any extra as compensation for Senior Sister's trouble."
Chen Tiexin: "..."

Her fingers trembled slightly as she clutched the pouch. Over twenty thousand mid-grade spirit stones... just casually thrown at me by this Junior Brother? She did a rough mental calculation. Even after deducting the black market transaction fees, she'd have about four thousand mid-grade spirit stones left as profit—enough for her to work herself to death for the Yunmiao Sect for fifty years to earn the same amount.
She knew Zhang Xian was wealthy, but she hadn't expected it to be this outrageous.
If not for her noble character, she'd be tempted to drag him into the hut and consummate their relationship right then and there.
"J-Junior Brother," she swallowed hard, her voice still trembling. "You... you aren't by any chance the illegitimate child of the Cloud Raiment Pavilion's head family, are you?"
Zhang Xian smiled faintly. "Nothing that dramatic. My family just owns some mines."

Chen Tiexin took a deep breath, forcing herself to calm down. "Alright! Since Junior Brother is so generous, this Senior Sister will go all out!" She slapped her storage bag and produced a communication jade talisman. "I'll contact the old-timer at the black market right now and have him arrange the point exchange as soon as possible."
"But..." she hesitated slightly, "...twenty thousand points is no small sum. The black market side might need to deliver them in batches to avoid drawing the sect's attention."
Zhang Xian nodded. "That's fine."

They chatted for a while longer, allowing Zhang Xian to gain a clearer understanding of the Yunmiao Sect's inner workings. Before leaving, Chen Tiexin very thoughtfully left him several popular novels to pass the time.
Night deepened. Zhang Xian waited in the thatched hut for a long time, but Lin Yinyin still hadn't returned.
"It seems Master has detained her..."
Feeling somewhat bored, he wandered out to the spirit spring in the courtyard.
Mist curled above the spirit spring's surface. Zhang Xian casually inserted five mid-grade spirit stones into the crevices in the stone wall surrounding it.
Instantly, the spring water's temperature rose, and its spiritual energy concentration skyrocketed.
He soaked his entire body in it; every pore relaxed and opened wide with pleasure.
He couldn't help but let out a long sigh of contentment.
This spiritual energy density was several times better than simply using a Spirit Gathering Array alone.
It seemed Spirit Sword Peak did have some substance after all.
After soaking for a while, he felt the intensity wasn't quite hitting the spot and thought: Since mid-grade spirit stones have such good effects, wouldn't top-grade spirit stones feel even better?
Thus, he grandly took out five top-grade spirit stones and slotted them in.
Boom!
The spirit spring instantly boiled over!
Spiritual energy churned violently; the water temperature soared to dangerous levels!
Zhang Xian had just dipped a toe in when he yelped, "Ow!" and jumped right back out, fleeing the scalding heat.
Flustered, he fished out the top-grade spirit stones and quickly replaced them with mid-grade ones again.
He waited for what felt like an eternity before the spring water gradually calmed down.
Wiping cold sweat from his brow, he felt a lingering fear in his heart. So this is what they mean by 'the body being too weak to receive excessive nourishment'...
Utterly bored now, Zhang Xian dried off and picked up one of the novels Chen Tiexin had given him: Help! The Yandere Master Has Fallen For Me.

[Fuxi's beautiful eyes brimmed with tears; her jade-like hand gently caressed the sword blade as her voice trembled: "Disciple... if you dare betray our sect... this Master will use this sword to kill you first... then end my own life!"]
Zhang Xian: "Oh?"
[Her red lips curved slightly; she lifted her disciple's chin with a fingertip: "Today's Sword Scripture lesson... this Master will personally teach you... hand in hand."]
Zhang Xian: "?"
["Master! Don't!" The young man's face flushed crimson—yet Fuxi's sword tip was already pressed against his throat...]
Zhang Xian: "!!!"
Zhang Xian read all night long, feeling somewhat unsatisfied when he finally finished the volume.

Simultaneously, the Foundation Establishment Third Layer bottleneck that had stalled him for so long finally broke. Thanks to soaking in that spirit spring earlier, his cultivation advanced directly into the Foundation Establishment Fourth Layer!
When dawn arrived, bell chimes rang out across the peak tops, signaling that morning lecture time had come around once more.
Zhang Xian hurriedly got up and dressed himself properly—he mustn't be late on his first day attending class, after all!

Rushing toward the training grounds gave him a sudden sense of déjà vu—as if he were back in his university days, pulling all-nighters at internet cafes and then rushing off to morning exercise sessions...
The corners of his mouth lifted slightly. This feeling is truly nostalgic indeed...
However, upon arriving at the Spirit Sword Peak training grounds, he froze on the spot.
Seventy or eighty disciples already sat cross-legged in neatly arranged rows upon the ground, each craning their necks eagerly as if awaiting the arrival of a deity.
Only a few meditation cushions left in the far corner remained available as seating options.
Lin Yinyin, who had arrived at some unknown time, sat in the front row, center position, looking utterly numb with an expressionless face...
Her Master had specifically instructed her to sit there and not move an inch!
She shot a pitiful glance toward Zhang Xian, causing a stir amongst the crowd immediately.
"Holy crap! Such beauty evokes pity even in me! Where did this top-tier Junior Sister come from? Why haven't I seen her before?"
"You're outdated already! The new Junior Sister just entered yesterday! Recording images are already selling like crazy within the sect!"

"Heard she possesses a top-tier Water Spirit Root, but I didn't expect the person herself to be even more top-tier! Seems this Venerable One must also take up permanent residence on Spirit Sword Peak now..."
"There are already writers working overnight creating content about her—her 'book' will probably be released within a few days..."
Just as everyone was discussing animatedly, a figure appeared, approaching from the distance, stepping through the air gracefully.
Li Fuxi wore the same silver-patterned white robe, holding a gleaming longsword cold with light in her hand. She landed elegantly on the central high platform of the training grounds.
The entire venue fell silent instantly.
"Today's lecture covers the Yunmiao Sword Scripture, twenty-third stance: Returning Wind Brushes Willow." Her voice carried not the slightest trace of emotion.
Yet the disciples below the platform stared intently at her every movement, eyes shining brightly, hardly daring to blink.
What a bunch of diligent students indeed! Li Fuxi felt quite satisfied inwardly seeing this devotion.

Her wrist turned over lightly—the longsword traced an elegant arc through the air like a swimming dragon. Sword light flowed like water while her figure moved gracefully between each stance, revealing the profound principles of the Sword Dao fully displayed therein.
However, the old perverts below the platform were focusing completely on something else entirely, their eyes glowing brilliantly.
"Supervisor Fuxi's waist is so slender!"
"This turning arc is absolutely perfect!"
"Supervisor truly possesses great 'reason' indeed!"
"That moment when the sword tip passes by, causing her robe hem to flutter slightly upward—I died right there watching it happen!"

Zhang Xian glanced forward, seeing Chen Tiexin and Senior Brother Zhenhai both wearing serious expressions as they used recording stones to capture every single movement Li Fuxi made with meticulous care.
Zhang Xian: "..."
I think I came to the wrong place.

sentences.text: As the crushing weight of Li Fuxi’s divine sense finally dissipated, the stagnant air in the courtyard began to flow freely once more.
Chen Tiexin retracted her soundproofing array, her brow furrowed in thought.
"Strange.
Usually, at this hour, Master would be nurturing her lifebound flying sword.
Why did her divine sense descend so suddenly today?"
Her gaze swept over Lin Yinyin, and a wide grin broke across her face.
"It seems Junior Sister Yinyin is truly receiving special attention."
Lin Yinyin walked toward the exit, looking back every few steps with wide, anxious eyes.
"Brother...
I'm a little scared."
Zhang Xian remained calm.
He reached into his robes, pulled out the Boundary Crossing Shuttle given to him by Yun Wanqing, and stuffed it into Lin Yinyin's arms.
"It's fine.
Master isn't some man-eating monster.
If she really intends you harm, just use this Boundary Crossing Shuttle to escape immediately."
Scared by Zhang Xian's grave preparations, Lin Yinyin looked on the verge of tears.
Brother, aren't you being a bit too dramatic?
It's just a meeting with the Master.
Handing me a supreme escape treasure makes me even more nervous!
[Ding!
Successfully gifted Lin Yinyin the Boundary Crossing Shuttle.
Triggered return.
Returned: Void Breaking Shuttle x10.]
[Void Breaking Shuttle: Earth-grade consumable artifact.
One-time use.
No refinement required.
Activated with essence blood.
Ignores restrictions to penetrate all phenomena.
Can tear through space to teleport tens of thousands of miles away.
Using the Void Breaking Shuttle in advance allows setting a specific teleportation destination.
Destination cannot be changed after being set.]
Huh?
The quality actually improved?
What a pleasant surprise.
Lin Yinyin departed with a heavy heart.
Zhang Xian then turned his attention to Chen Tiexin.
"Senior Sister, aside from missions and perfect attendance, are there faster ways to earn contribution points?"
Chen Tiexin's eyes lit up.
"Junior Brother wants to take a shortcut?"
"Mn.
After all, we're new here, and contribution points are tight.
I also want to have the means to visit the other peaks more often."
"Hehe, of course there is!
The black market."
"Black market?"
"Yes.
There are always people short on spirit stones, and always people too lazy to grind missions." She rubbed her fingers together in the universal sign for money.
"One point is worth about one hundred low-grade spirit stones."
Zhang Xian nodded thoughtfully.
"What if I want to exchange for a large amount of points at once?"
"A large amount?" Chen Tiexin raised an eyebrow.
"Junior Brother, the points circulating on the black market are limited.
Usually, exchanging a few hundred points at once is the maximum.
Any more than that, and the exchange rate becomes unfavorable."
"Let's start with twenty thousand points to wet my whistle." Zhang Xian casually pulled a heavy brocade pouch from his storage ring and tossed it to Chen Tiexin.
"There are over twenty thousand mid-grade spirit stones in there.
Can twenty thousand points be delivered within one month?"
Her eyes went wide, her voice cracking as it jumped an octave.
"H-how many?!"
"Twenty thousand points," Zhang Xian repeated calmly.
"Is the rate insufficient?
If it is, I can add more.
Consider any extra as compensation for Senior Sister's trouble."
Chen Tiexin: "..."
Her fingers trembled slightly as she clutched the pouch.
Over twenty thousand mid-grade spirit stones... just casually thrown at me by this Junior Brother?
She did a rough mental calculation.

Even after deducting the black market transaction fees, she'd have about four thousand mid-grade spirit stones left as profit—enough for her to work herself to death for the Yunmiao Sect for fifty years to earn the same amount.
She knew Zhang Xian was wealthy, but she hadn't expected it to be this outrageous.
If not for her noble character, she'd be tempted to drag him into the hut and consummate their relationship right then and there.
"J-Junior Brother," she swallowed hard, her voice still trembling.
"You... you aren't by any chance the illegitimate child of the Cloud Raiment Pavilion's head family, are you?"
Zhang Xian smiled faintly.
"Nothing that dramatic.
My family just owns some mines."
Chen Tiexin took a deep breath, forcing herself to calm down.
"Alright!
Since Junior Brother is so generous, this Senior Sister will go all out!" She slapped her storage bag and produced a communication jade talisman.
"I'll contact the old-timer at the black market right now and have him arrange the point exchange as soon as possible."
"But..." she hesitated slightly, "...twenty thousand points is no small sum.
The black market side might need to deliver them in batches to avoid drawing the sect's attention."
Zhang Xian nodded.
"That's fine."
They chatted for a while longer, allowing Zhang Xian to gain a clearer understanding of the Yunmiao Sect's inner workings.
Before leaving, Chen Tiexin very thoughtfully left him several popular novels to pass the time.
Night deepened.
Zhang Xian waited in the thatched hut for a long time, but Lin Yinyin still hadn't returned.
"It seems Master has detained her..."
Feeling somewhat bored, he wandered out to the spirit spring in the courtyard.
Mist curled above the spirit spring's surface.
Zhang Xian casually inserted five mid-grade spirit stones into the crevices in the stone wall surrounding it.
Instantly, the spring water's temperature rose, and its spiritual energy concentration skyrocketed.
He soaked his entire body in it; every pore relaxed and opened wide with pleasure.
He couldn't help but let out a long sigh of contentment.
This spiritual energy density was several times better than simply using a Spirit Gathering Array alone.
It seemed Spirit Sword Peak did have some substance after all.
After soaking for a while, he felt the intensity wasn't quite hitting the spot and thought: Since mid-grade spirit stones have such good effects, wouldn't top-grade spirit stones feel even better?
Thus, he grandly took out five top-grade spirit stones and slotted them in.
Boom!
The spirit spring instantly boiled over!
Spiritual energy churned violently; the water temperature soared to dangerous levels!
Zhang Xian had just dipped a toe in when he yelped, "Ow!" and jumped right back out, fleeing the scalding heat.
Flustered, he fished out the top-grade spirit stones and quickly replaced them with mid-grade ones again.
He waited for what felt like an eternity before the spring water gradually calmed down.
Wiping cold sweat from his brow, he felt a lingering fear in his heart.
So this is what they mean by 'the body being too weak to receive excessive nourishment'...
Utterly bored now, Zhang Xian dried off and picked up one of the novels Chen Tiexin had given him: Help!
The Yandere Master Has Fallen For Me.

[Fuxi's beautiful eyes brimmed with tears; her jade-like hand gently caressed the sword blade as her voice trembled: "Disciple... if you dare betray our sect... this Master will use this sword to kill you first... then end my own life!"]
Zhang Xian: "Oh?"
[Her red lips curved slightly; she lifted her disciple's chin with a fingertip: "Today's Sword Scripture lesson... this Master will personally teach you... hand in hand."]
Zhang Xian: "?"
["Master!
Don't!" The young man's face flushed crimson—yet Fuxi's sword tip was already pressed against his throat...]
Zhang Xian: "!!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 38 I Need to Build a Good Relationship with My Brother-in-Law
paragraphs: Zhang Xian was also staring at Li Fuxi. He was indeed learning the sword.
As a martial arts grandmaster, he could tell at a glance that Li Fuxi's swordsmanship was extraordinary, and he committed her every move and stance to memory.

Finally, it came to the practice session. Li Fuxi stood with her hands behind her back at the highest point of the mountain, looking down at the disciples practicing swordsmanship below, shaking her head repeatedly.
Each generation is worse than the last.
She remembered they had watched so attentively, so why was their practice so lackluster, one worse than the other?

The only consolation was Lin Yinyin. Although she looked utterly unwilling, her sword practice was quite proper. Truly worthy of being a top-grade Water Spirit Root. Li Fuxi suddenly felt there was someone to carry on the legacy.

However, to her surprise, Zhang Xian in the corner also seemed to be performing quite well, his moves and stances showing proper form. It was just that he had a low-grade Wood Spirit Root, inherently unsuited for learning sword techniques.
Coupled with his False Core technique, his path of cultivation was destined to be short-lived.
What a pity.
"Brother, this won't do. You can't even generate sword energy. No matter how hard you try, it's useless," said a kind-hearted cultivator next to Zhang Xian.
Zhang Xian smiled. "No helping it. I just arrived yesterday. This is my first morning class; I'm just giving it a try."
"Oh? You're the one who came with that junior sister in front, right? What's your relationship?"
"She's my younger sister."

Upon hearing this, the kind-hearted cultivator became even more enthusiastic. "Here's what you should do. I recommend you come to our Green Wood Peak. It's full of wood-element techniques; maybe there's something suitable for you."
"It's just that my contribution points aren't enough."
"Tsk, you don't understand. New disciples get one free borrowing opportunity. We're all wood-attribute Spirit Roots; let's look out for each other in the future. Let's add each other as friends."
"Thank you, Senior Brother!"
My name is Lu Renbing, a disciple of Green Wood Peak.
That day, I went to Spirit Sword Peak for morning class as usual to study the 'truths' taught by Supervisor Li Fuxi.
I also saw a beauty like water named Lin Yinyin. I thought my love had arrived.
There was a man next to me who looked honest and good-natured. My big mouth made me strike up a conversation with him. This was one of the most regrettable decisions I've ever made.
He claimed to be Lin Yinyin's older brother. I kindly treated him as my future brother-in-law, but in the end, he destroyed us.
Green Wood Peak fell. I swear eternal enmity with the Old Demon Zhang Xian!!
— "Declaration of the Alliance to Denounce Old Demon Zhang" by Lu Renbing
After morning class ended, before Lin Yinyin could even speak to Zhang Xian, she was tied up and taken away by Li Fuxi.
Zhang Xian had no choice but to return to his room alone to catch up on sleep until evening when Spirit Sword Peak's evening class began.

Unlike the grand spectacle of the morning class, the evening class taught the essential principles of the Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra, emphasizing purity of heart, detachment from desires, and focusing the spirit in tranquility.
The vast lecture hall was sparsely populated with less than ten disciples, including Lin Yinyin seated front and center in the first row.
Lu Renbing was also there. Seeing his "brother-in-law" arrive, he excitedly waved Zhang Xian over to sit. Zhang Xian smiled and sat down beside him.
Li Fuxi was still in her long robe, her entire person cold as frost.

"The third chapter of the Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra discusses focusing the spirit and guarding the One, keeping the jade heart unstained. Those who cultivate this sutra must sever emotions and desires to achieve a transparent jade heart."
As she said this, her gaze suddenly fell upon Lin Yinyin. "Lin Yinyin," she said coldly.
Lin Yinyin jumped. "Disciple is here!"
"From today onward, you will sever your relationship with Zhang Xian," Li Fuxi's tone brooked no argument. "Otherwise, you will not succeed in cultivating this sutra."
The hall fell silent.
Lu Renbing widened his eyes and looked at Zhang Xian.
"Oh, we siblings are just very close."

Lu Renbing patted Zhang Xian's shoulder and whispered, "Brother, this Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra isn't very humane either. I thought it only required sealing off love and cutting off romance. I didn't expect it demands severing familial bonds too."
Lin Yinyin said aggrievedly, "Master, I remember Article 37 of the sect rules clearly states that masters are not allowed to interfere in their disciples' private lives!"
Li Fuxi gave a cold laugh. "Rules? Fine, then this Master will change her approach."
The corner of her lips lifted slightly. "Starting tonight, this Master will personally help you activate your meridians to aid your cultivation. This will happen daily; no leave is permitted."
Lin Yinyin: "..."
She looked pleadingly at Zhang Xian. Li Fuxi's gaze had already swept over: "Zhang Xian, what about you?"

Zhang Xian wore an earnest expression. "Master, to be honest, in my minor world I still have ten beautiful concubines. The elders of my family urge me daily to continue the family line. It's truly impossible for me to purify my heart and suppress my desires."
What a joke! There are still so many Daughters of Destiny waiting for me to give them gifts. If I purify my heart and suppress desires, what will happen to them?
Li Fuxi clenched her small fist tightly. "This Master doesn't expect you to learn the Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra. She wants you to keep your distance from Lin Yinyin!
Lu Renbing's mouth hung open wide enough to fit an egg. "Junior Brother, you..."
"Oh, they're just some worldly entanglements. Senior Brother Lu need not mind."
Li Fuxi snorted coldly and ignored him further, turning instead to look at Lin Yinyin. "Starting tonight, come with me to the meditation room."
Lin Yinyin felt like crying but had no tears. She could only give Zhang Xian a pitiful glance filled with "Brother, save me!"
Seeing Lin Yinyin's look, the nearby disciples couldn't take it.
"Wow! Junior Sister Yinyin is so adorable! I really want to protect her!"
"Although Spirit Sword Peak is dirt poor, with Supervisor Fuxi and Junior Sister Yinyin here, I estimate its popularity won't be bad in the future."
"What should I do? I like both of them. Am I a scumbag?"
In the evening, Zhang Xian was still soaking alone in the spirit pool bathhouse while catching up on reading Deadly Love: My Obsessive Master Falls for Me.
During this time, Lu Renbing occasionally sent messages inviting Zhang Xian enthusiastically to attend tomorrow's evening class.
As for why not morning class? Well... Lu Renbing had no choice; he needed to watch Supervisor Fuxi's sword techniques every morning.
On the second night, Zhang Xian arrived as promised. Lu Renbing had kindly saved him a seat.

The lecture hall at Green Wood Peak was completely different from Spirit Sword Peak's. The entire hall was filled with flower pots, spirit soil pools, and spirit springs. The air carried a faint fragrance of plants and trees that calmed the mind.
[Ding! Discovered Daughter of Destiny with 30 points: Liu Qingxuan]
[Ding! Liu Qingxuan's Favorability towards you is 5; binding successful.]
Oh? An unexpected gain! Zhang Xian felt pleasantly surprised.

Liu Qingxuan was today's supervising instructor—a gentle and refined female cultivator, like jade. She wore a light green long dress with only a single green wood hairpin in her hair. Her smile was soft, and she spoke in a whisper, forming a sharp contrast with Li Fuxi's icy demeanor.
"Today we will teach 'Basics of Spirit Plant Cultivation'," she said gently. "The way of spirit plants emphasizes sensing spirits with your heart and nurturing wood with spirit."
"Only through perseverance and diligent cultivation can spirit plants be cultivated well, even if one’s Spirit Root quality isn’t high." As she said this part, she gave Zhang Xian an amicable smile.

A low-grade Wood Spirit Root, yet able to enter the Dao through the False Core technique—his cultivation path must have been full of hardships indeed! And she—Liu Qingxuan—admired students like him who possessed perseverance!

chapters.title: Chapter 39 I’m Just Part Of Their Play
paragraphs: Liu Qingxuan’s lecture left Zhang Xian utterly captivated and he benefited greatly.

After evening class ended, Zhang Xian—unusually for him—went up to ask questions. Liu Qingxuan didn’t show the slightest impatience, despite him not being from her peak; instead, she patiently helped him resolve some cultivation confusions.
Liu Qingxuan took out a tender green seedling from her sleeve and handed it over. "This Green Spirit Vine has tenacious vitality and is most suitable for beginners to cultivate."

"Cultivators nourish the inner core within the Purple Mansion—the principle is actually the same as cultivating seeds. The 'Azure Emperor’s Rejuvenation Art' you study is a profound technique. If you use the heart-method to warm-nourish it daily, it will slowly grow. Cultivate it until it blooms and bears fruit, and it will give you many insights into your cultivation."
Zhang Xian solemnly expressed his thanks. "Thank you for your guidance, Supervisor."
Liu Qingxuan lightly shook her head. "No need to thank me. The cultivation path is long. If you have doubts, you can come find me anytime."
The next few days passed quite comfortably for Zhang Xian.

During the daytime, he punctually attended morning classes at Spirit Sword Peak, following Li Fuxi to study the 'Yunmiao Sword Scripture'. Although limited by his low-grade Spiritual Root, he was unable to unleash the technique's true power, he had the foundation of a grandmaster martial arts expert. Plus, since few disciples there were truly serious about learning swordsmanship, purely judging by his sword moves and stances, he was firmly within the top ten.
In the evenings, he went to Green Wood Peak to attend classes, following Liu Qingxuan.

Green Wood Peak's cultivation was completely different from Spirit Sword Peak's, emphasizing a quiet mind, nurturing nature, and using spirit plants as a medium to comprehend the vitality of heaven and earth. Zhang Xian diligently cared for the Green Spirit Vine daily, warm-nourishing it with spiritual power, and actually felt his internal spiritual power circulation become somewhat smoother than before.
Liu Qingxuan occasionally personally instructed him, speaking softly and with extreme patience.
Half a month later, at the Spirit Sword Peak training grounds during morning class.

"Your sword posture is good, but your spiritual power circulation is too sluggish. This Master doesn’t want to discourage you, but given your Wood Spirit Root background, it will be hard to achieve success on the sword path. You'd better go find a path that truly suits you." Li Fuxi stood beside Zhang Xian, instructing him.
"Is Master trying to drive me away?" Zhang Xian replied.

Li Fuxi lightly snorted, thinking, This is just a kind reminder. I don’t want to waste time here, that's all. Thinking of this, she looked toward Lin Yinyin in the first row, feeling somewhat satisfied.

Truly a worthy disciple. Bearing a top-grade Water Spirit Root, coupled with Lin Yinyin's innate intelligence, she had already cultivated the Yunmiao Sword Scripture to the first level of completion in just half a month. Such speed, looking across the Yunmiao Sect's generations of disciples, ranked among the very top.
Watching Lin Yinyin's exquisite figure as she performed the sword dance, the surrounding disciples exclaimed that it was a great deal just to watch.
The training grounds, which originally held seventy to eighty people, now exceeded a hundred.
"Wow! Double happiness!"
"Junior Sister's move 'Returning Wind Brushes Willow'—her waist flexibility is simply defies heaven!"
"Even slimmer than Supervisor!"
"Although Master has the 'truth,' Junior Sister has long legs!"

"Brother!" Morning class ended, and this time, unprecedentedly, Lin Yinyin wasn’t tied away by Li Fuxi. She immediately ran over to Zhang Xian and, disregarding the surrounding disciples' gazes, gave him a big bear hug.
"Brother, I missed you so much!" She hadn't really chatted with her brother in half a month.
"Good girl, I missed you too."
Their behavior was natural, and their words carried an indescribable intimacy, which dumbfounded the surrounding disciples.
"Are they really siblings?" one disciple hesitated.
"It doesn't seem like it? What siblings are this 'sticky'? Look, Junior Sister Lin's gaze at him is almost pulling threads!"
"Could they be Dao companions?!" Someone gasped sharply, sucking in a cold breath.

Lu Renbing, who was always helping to save a seat, looked utterly dumbfounded. Seeing the two pressed chest-to-chest—with Lin Yinyin still pushing forward, seemingly wanting to squeeze right into Zhang Xian's body—he couldn't help but ask, "Brother-in-law... oh no... Junior Brother Zhang, aren't you siblings?"
Before Zhang Xian could answer, Lin Yinyin immediately chimed in, "I'm his little wife! It's just that I call him 'Brother'!" Saying this, she again looked tenderly toward Zhang Xian.
Crack.
Lu Renbing felt something break.
All the disciples were struck by lightning and instantly erupted!
"Still a 'little wife'?!"
"Innocent Junior Sister is Zhang Xian's concubine?!"
"Aaaaah! My Dao heart has collapsed!"
"They still address each other as siblings?! I'm just part of their play?!"
"I even treated Junior Brother Zhang as my brother-in-law?! Am I actually the clown?" Someone beat their chest and stamped their feet.
Not far away, Zhenhai Senior Brother sighed. He had privately paid Lin Yinyin courtesies these days without getting a proper glance and had already given up.
I've lost love—I must make the whole world accompany me in this sorrow!

"They are indeed Dao Companions. Master these days has been continuously taking Lin Yinyin Junior Sister away to prevent them from continuing their dual cultivation, which would affect her Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra cultivation." Zhenhai timely supplemented the information.
"What?! Meaning they've already had skin intimacy?!"
"Beast!!!" Lu Renbing was the first to vomit blood!
"Supervisor's righteousness!
The brief collapse was over. The already excellent disciples quickly adjusted their mindset and started self-comforting.
"It's okay, it's okay! Which goddess won't encounter a few scumbags in her youth?!"

Exactly! That guy Zhang Xian, doesn't he just have a bit of stinking money? He looks average, and his Spirit Root is poor. Lin Yinyin has just been temporarily deceived by him!" Another disciple clenched his fist, the fire of hope igniting in his eyes. "When Junior Sister wakes up, she will realize that I am her true destiny!"
"Right, right, right! We still have a chance!"
"I don't mind being the rebound."
"Me neither."
Zhenhai looked at this group of frenzied fellow disciples and shook his head silently, thinking: A bunch of fools. Apart from Zhang Xian, Junior Sister Lin's eyes cannot hold anyone else.
However, he didn't intend to remind them.
After all, watching others crash and burn in love was also a form of entertainment.
I, Zhenhai, the third-generation Eldest Senior Brother of Spirit Sword Peak.
Have blackened.
By evening, Zhang Xian went to Green Wood Peak for the evening class as usual.
Unfortunately, Lu Renbing wasn't there, so Zhang Xian didn't get a good seat and huddled in a corner.

It wasn't until the evening class ended that Zhang Xian went to find Liu Qingxuan to ask for guidance again. After his questions were answered, Zhang Xian took out a jade-green spirit fruit from his robes and handed it to Liu Qingxuan. "Supervisor, the Green Spirit Vine you gave me has already bloomed and borne fruit. Please take a look at its quality."
Liu Qingxuan accepted it with a strange expression, lifting her eyes to look at Zhang Xian, seemingly hesitant to speak.

A disciple slammed the table and rose. "What a joke! It takes at least a year for a Green Spirit Vine to go from seedling to fruit! It's only been half a month; how could it possibly result in fruit?!"
"Exactly! Zhang Xian, did you buy a spirit fruit from somewhere just to fool Supervisor Liu?"
"What is your motive? Trying to make Supervisor Liu think highly of you? Your methods are too despicable."
Everyone chimed in with agreement. They had no choice; yesterday they treated Zhang Xian as their "Brother-in-law," but now he was a love rival!
Poor Senior Brother Lu Renbing, who was so loyal and righteous, had been angered to the point of vomiting blood and taking sick leave!
Today, they were going to expose Zhang Xian's ugly face!

chapters.title: Chapter 40 Eyeing the Pot While Eating from the Bowl
paragraphs: Facing the crowd's doubts, Zhang Xian replied, "You don't believe me? That Green Spirit Vine is currently planted behind my house. You can all go and see for yourselves."
"Absolutely impossible! You probably just transplanted a mature vine!"
Another white-robed cultivator from Green Wood Peak also shook his head repeatedly. "Junior Brother Zhang, don't say anymore. This will only make the Supervisor more disappointed in you."

His name was Lu Rendin. Now at the third level of the Golden Core stage, he was the personal disciple of the Green Wood Peak's Chief Seat and also the Senior Brother of Green Wood Peak. He didn't have any particular thoughts about Lin Yinyin; he just felt somewhat annoyed that Zhang Xian consulted Liu Qingxuan with questions every day. Coupled with today's united front of Green Wood Peak disciples, as the Senior Brother, he naturally had to step forward.

Beside him, Liu Qingxuan felt somewhat disappointed in Zhang Xian. Having low Spirit Root talent wasn't a big deal, but deceiving oneself indicated a problem with character. She was thinking about how to smooth things over and guide Zhang Xian back onto the right path.

Zhang Xian just smiled, took out a Memory Stone from his robe, and handed it to Liu Qingxuan, saying, "This contains the daily cultivation process of the Green Spirit Vine. Supervisor Liu can take a look."
"Hah! Still stubbornly insisting," someone sneered.
"I want to see what evidence this is. Could it be that Junior Brother Zhang is truly a once-in-ten-thousand-years genius?"
"Hahahaha!"
Liu Qingxuan sighed softly. With a delicate touch of her finger, the images from the Memory Stone slowly appeared.
On the first night, Zhang Xian buried the Green Spirit Vine seed in the soil of his backyard and watered it a little.
On the second night, sensing no change in the seed, Zhang Xian watered it with some Spirit Spring Water. He took out a book titled Basics of Spiritual Plant Care.
On the third night, sensing no change in the seed, Zhang Xian took out a bottle of Jade Condensation Liquid and poured the entire bottle onto it.
"Damn! Isn't that Jade Condensation Liquid like two hundred points per bottle? And he just gave it to this Green Spirit Vine?"
"What a waste of precious resources!!"
Seeing this, Lu Rendin suddenly had an ominous premonition.

On the fourth night, sensing that the seed had already taken root and sprouted, Zhang Xian took out twelve mid-grade spirit stones and set up a Star Dipper Spirit Gathering Array to supply spiritual energy.

On the fifth night, the seed had already broken through the soil. Zhang Xian took out another bottle of Jade Condensation Liquid and carefully fertilized it. The fertilizer was Penglai Resting Soil, which Zhang Xian bought for one thousand mid-grade spirit stones.
Thud.
Someone had already fallen to their knees.
"My eyes are f*cking blind."

Up until the fourteenth day, the Green Spirit Vine bloomed and bore fruit. Zhang Xian checked against Basics of Spiritual Plant Care, confirmed it was correct, and took a bite—it was juicy and delicious.
"So? I wasn't lying," Zhang Xian said with a smile.
The entire hall fell silent. Even Liu Qingxuan was speechless.
"My heart is bleeding. I counted—a full ten bottles of Jade Condensation Liquid!"
"And Penglai Resting Soil! Holy shit, even the Chief Seat wouldn't dare be so extravagant when planting spiritual plants. He poured out an entire bag!"
"This bastard is an idiot! Forcing a Green Spirit Vine to mature like this! Just these materials alone could buy a mountain of Green Spirit Vines!"
Lu Rendin's eyelids twitched violently. He never imagined Zhang Xian would use such an explosively extravagant method to forcibly mature a Green Spirit Vine in fifteen days.
"Oh! I enjoy the process of nurturing spiritual plants. As for this little cost, it's not worth considering," Zhang Xian explained.

Pfft—someone spat out blood. Others had already quietly slipped away, planning to sneak into Zhang Xian's residence to see if there were any leftover Jade Condensation Liquid or Penglai Resting Soil near that Green Spirit Vine.

Liu Qingxuan took the spirit fruit; it was no different from other one-year matured fruits. Seeing the gloomy atmosphere below, she cleared her throat lightly. "Zhang Xian's method is indeed unconventional. It's just... a bit wasteful."

Zhang Xian said softly, "Supervisor, you must have noticed too. My Spirit Root quality isn't high, so I can only rely on piling up resources, just like with this Green Spirit Vine. Maturing a year earlier might seem wasteful to you all, but to me, it saves a huge amount of time cost. It's worth it."
Liu Qingxuan's beautiful eyes flickered. Yes, she couldn't measure others by her own standards. For cultivators, time was the most precious thing.
"By the way," Zhang Xian took out a spiritual herb with an overall dark blue hue from his robe. "Supervisor Liu, is there a way to cultivate this immortal herb and improve its quality?"
Liu Qingxuan's pupils contracted sharply. She exclaimed involuntarily, "This is Immortal Ascension Grass! Where did you get this?!"

Hearing the name Immortal Ascension Grass, people immediately stopped spitting blood, wiped their stains, and cried out in shock, "Immortal Ascension Grass? The one some sucker bought for 1.76 million mid-grade spirit stones at the last auction?"
"Spirit stones are merely external possessions; not worth mentioning."
Liu Qingxuan took the Immortal Ascension Grass; her slender jade-like fingers trembled slightly. An Earth-grade treasure that could improve Spirit Root quality—she had never seen one before.
"So? Is there a way?"

"Difficult. Very difficult. This kind of immortal herb has rarely appeared in history; ancient texts are blank regarding its cultivation methods. We can only rely on trial and error. With good luck, cultivation might succeed; with bad luck... this one might wither and die too."

"Oh? So there is hope." Zhang Xian cupped his hands respectfully. "Then I'll give this Immortal Ascension Grass to Supervisor Liu. My ability is insufficient to cultivate it; I can only trouble Supervisor Liu to help research it."

"Give it... to me?" Liu Qingxuan's breathing became somewhat rapid. Such a heaven-defying treasure given away just like that? Even if one of Yunmiao Sect's seventy-two Peak Chief Seats saw such a treasure, they would fight over it!

Her chest rose and fell repeatedly as she struggled internally. Finally, she closed her eyes and said painfully, "No... this is too valuable. I cannot accept it. If I fail... I wouldn't be able to sleep for life." She didn't dare look at the Immortal Ascension Grass again, afraid she couldn't resist.
"Oh, it's fine. If it fails, it's on me," Zhang Xian said as he took out another one and placed it in Liu Qingxuan's hand. "I have more here; we can afford trial and error."
Liu Qingxuan's autumn-water-like eyes widened into circles; her red lips parted slightly. Her usually gentle and composed demeanor vanished completely at this moment.
"T-two... two plants?" Her voice changed pitch. "Th-this... keeping them for yourself to consume would be better; they can improve your Spirit Root quality.
"I know. I ate them until they had no more effect on me later on. Before this, I wasn't even at the Low-grade Spirit Root level."
Liu Qingxuan: "..."
"Then... then I'll accept them... I'll try to find ways to cultivate them," Liu Qingxuan spoke somewhat guiltily.
[Ding! Successfully gifted Ascension Immortal Grass x2. Returned: Immortal Ascension Grass x200.]
[Immortal Ascension Grass: Earth-grade material, Epic-level rarity treasure. Direct consumption has a probability of improving Spirit Root quality. Effect decreases with repeated consumption.]
[Ding! Current Favorability: 25.]
Excellent! Zhang Xian secretly rejoiced.

"By the way, Supervisor Liu, do you have cultivation materials here? I have plenty here too; I'll give you some as well. It shouldn't be that you help me cultivate immortal herbs yet still have to provide materials yourself; that would be too much," Zhang Xian continued.
"No, no need!" Liu Qingxuan shook her head repeatedly. "I have materials here. Being able to cultivate treasures like Immortal Ascension Grass already satisfies me greatly."
"Supervisor Liu is too polite. You must accept this reward." Zhang Xian took out an exquisite jade box from his sleeve again and handed it over.
The moment the jade box opened, a refreshing, heart-soothing fragrance wafted out. Knowledgeable disciples exclaimed on the spot, "Beauty Preservation Pill?!"
Liu Qingxuan was completely stunned.

She mechanically accepted the jade box; her whole person seemed as if in a dream. Two priceless Immortal Ascension Grasses, plus this Beauty Preservation Pill that female cultivators in the cultivation world couldn't refuse... she felt her legs go somewhat weak.
"Zhang Xian..." Her voice was almost inaudible. "This is too..."

Zhang Xian smiled breezily. "Supervisor Liu need not decline. You helping me cultivate immortal herbs must be very laborious. If you don’t even accept such a small reward, I would feel uneasy eating or sleeping. Fear might breed inner demons. Supervisor, you wouldn’t want see me go berserk due to qi deviation, would you?"
Disciples at the side had long been dumbfounded. Lu Rendin’s face turned from green to pale; he cursed angrily, "This bastard has designs on Supervisor Liu too!"
"Holy shit! No wonder he’s so generous!"
"Two Immortal Ascension Grasses, and a Beauty Preservation Pill... this pursuit method is too brutal!"
"Aaaaaah! Simply impossible to refuse! If someone gave me one Immortal Ascension Grass, I could be a bottom!"
"Wait... doesn’t he already have Junior Sister Lin?"
"Beast! Eyeing the pot while eating from the bowl!"
