Even if one of Yunmiao Sect's seventy-two Peak Chief Seats saw such a treasure, they would fight over it!
Her chest rose and fell repeatedly as she struggled internally.
Finally, she closed her eyes and said painfully, "No... this is too valuable.
I cannot accept it.
If I fail...
I wouldn't be able to sleep for life." She didn't dare look at the Immortal Ascension Grass again, afraid she couldn't resist.
"Oh, it's fine.
If it fails, it's on me," Zhang Xian said as he took out another one and placed it in Liu Qingxuan's hand.
"I have more here; we can afford trial and error."
Liu Qingxuan's autumn-water-like eyes widened into circles; her red lips parted slightly.
Her usually gentle and composed demeanor vanished completely at this moment.
"T-two... two plants?" Her voice changed pitch.
"Th-this... keeping them for yourself to consume would be better; they can improve your Spirit Root quality.
"I know.
I ate them until they had no more effect on me later on.
Before this, I wasn't even at the Low-grade Spirit Root level."
Liu Qingxuan: "..."
"Then... then I'll accept them...
I'll try to find ways to cultivate them," Liu Qingxuan spoke somewhat guiltily.
[Ding!
Successfully gifted Ascension Immortal Grass x2.
Returned: Immortal Ascension Grass x200.]
[Immortal Ascension Grass: Earth-grade material, Epic-level rarity treasure.
Direct consumption has a probability of improving Spirit Root quality.
Effect decreases with repeated consumption.]
[Ding!
Current Favorability: 25.]
Excellent!
Zhang Xian secretly rejoiced.
"By the way, Supervisor Liu, do you have cultivation materials here?
I have plenty here too; I'll give you some as well.
It shouldn't be that you help me cultivate immortal herbs yet still have to provide materials yourself; that would be too much," Zhang Xian continued.
"No, no need!" Liu Qingxuan shook her head repeatedly.
"I have materials here.
Being able to cultivate treasures like Immortal Ascension Grass already satisfies me greatly."
"Supervisor Liu is too polite.
You must accept this reward." Zhang Xian took out an exquisite jade box from his sleeve again and handed it over.
The moment the jade box opened, a refreshing, heart-soothing fragrance wafted out.
Knowledgeable disciples exclaimed on the spot, "Beauty Preservation Pill?!"
Liu Qingxuan was completely stunned.
She mechanically accepted the jade box; her whole person seemed as if in a dream.
Two priceless Immortal Ascension Grasses, plus this Beauty Preservation Pill that female cultivators in the cultivation world couldn't refuse... she felt her legs go somewhat weak.
"Zhang Xian..." Her voice was almost inaudible.
"This is too..."
Zhang Xian smiled breezily.
"Supervisor Liu need not decline.
You helping me cultivate immortal herbs must be very laborious.
If you don’t even accept such a small reward, I would feel uneasy eating or sleeping.
Fear might breed inner demons.
Supervisor, you wouldn’t want see me go berserk due to qi deviation, would you?"
Disciples at the side had long been dumbfounded.
Lu Rendin’s face turned from green to pale; he cursed angrily, "This bastard has designs on Supervisor Liu too!"
"Holy shit!
No wonder he’s so generous!"
"Two Immortal Ascension Grasses, and a Beauty Preservation Pill... this pursuit method is too brutal!"
"Aaaaaah!
Simply impossible to refuse!
If someone gave me one Immortal Ascension Grass, I could be a bottom!"
"Wait... doesn’t he already have Junior Sister Lin?"
"Beast!
Eyeing the pot while eating from the bowl!"

chapters.title: Chapter 41 Even Fantasizing Is Kind Of Sacrilege
paragraphs: It wasn't until she noticed the strange looks from the disciples below that Liu Qingxuan realized something was amiss. Her pretty face flushed red instantly, the color spreading all the way to her ears. Flustered, she tried to return the gifts, but Zhang Xian gently stopped her.
"Supervisor Liu, don’t overthink this. It’s purely an academic exchange," Zhang Xian said.
These items were indeed precious—especially the Ascension Immortal Grass. To be able to research and cultivate such immortal plants had been her lifelong dream.

But accepting Zhang Xian’s gifts in front of so many students—what kind of behavior was that? How could she face people afterwards? Especially the Beauty Preservation Pill; it was universally recognized in the cultivation world as the ultimate love token a male cultivator gave when pursuing a female cultivator.
Zhang Xian was an old hand at this; how could he possibly take back items he had already gifted? He engaged in a back-and-forth tug-of-war with Liu Qingxuan.
"This Ascension Immortal Grass isn’t a free gift; it's just for research and cultivation. Didn't Supervisor also give me the Green Spirit Vine?"
"Supervisor Liu misunderstands me; I truly have no other intentions."
"If Supervisor still insists, I would have no face to come to Green Wood Peak again."
"I treat everyone the same. I've given away more expensive things before; this really isn't much. Supervisor must not feel any psychological pressure."

Liu Qingxuan, devoted entirely to researching spiritual plant cultivation and pure of mind, how could she possibly win an argument against the thick-skinned Zhang Xian? In a daze, she accepted them. During her attempts to decline, her small hand was constantly pressed by Zhang Xian, causing her face to turn thoroughly red.
[Ding! Successfully gifted Liu Qingxuan Beauty Preservation Pill. Triggered return: Beauty Preservation Pill x100.]
[Beauty Preservation Pill: No grade. Preserves youthful appearance forever; jade-like bones naturally formed.]
[Ding! Current Favorability: 28.]

Liu Qingxuan was so anxious she almost cried. She couldn't win the argument against Zhang Xian, and receiving such treasures made her both happy and panicked. She quickly pulled her hand away from his and fled the classroom as if escaping, completely ignoring the mess left below.
Pity the poor disciples who had just caught their breath; they started vomiting blood all over again.
Their respected, pure Supervisor Liu had been taken advantage of by Zhang Xian just like that!
Green Wood Peak's Senior Disciple Lu Rendin’s face had already turned the color of a purple liver. To him, Supervisor Liu was so sacred that even fantasizing about her felt like a kind of sacrilege.
Yet, her small hand had been held by Zhang Xian for so long! If not for the strict sect rules, he would have beaten the shit out of Zhang Xian right then and there!
At dawn the next morning, Zhang Xian went to clock in as usual.
Lu Renbing, who persisted in attending class despite his illness, didn’t save a seat for him this time, so Zhang Xian had to stand in the last row.
The surrounding junior brothers glared angrily at him, but Zhang Xian turned a blind eye.

As the saying goes: these were all small scenes. Back when he married the Great Liang Kingdom's princess and the Demon Sect enchantress, the scale was a hundred times larger than this; he acted as if he saw nothing.
"Zhang Xian! After the morning lecture, follow me," Li Fuxi said from the high platform, her voice tinged with a trace of anger. "Lin Yinyin, you too!"
Zhang Xian didn't quite understand why, only seeing Chen Tiexin not far away giving him a big thumbs-up.
Lin Yinyin shrank her neck in fright. She thought their intimate behavior yesterday had caused Master’s repulsion. She was going to get scolded again; how miserable!
Wu... I don’t want to learn the "Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra" at all; I just want to happily play with Brother.

This was the first time Zhang Xian had entered Li Fuxi’s thatched hut. It was no different from his own—if one had to make a distinction, Master’s hut was built at the very top of the mountain peak, so the wind was a bit stronger.

What caught his attention was a piece of calligraphy hanging on the wall, written with a large character: "Xi". The brushstrokes were powerful and majestic. The signature in the lower right corner read: Wangchuan.
Zhang Xian had read the history of Spirit Sword Peak; Wangchuan was the previous Spirit Sword Peak Chief Seat and also Li Fuxi’s master, having passed away two hundred years ago.
Li Fuxi sat cross-legged on the wooden bed and pointed near her. "Lin Yinyin, you sit beside me."
"Okay." Lin Yinyin obediently sat cross-legged by Li Fuxi's side.
Then, Li Fuxi stared fixedly at Zhang Xian. Gradually, the atmosphere in the room became so heavy it seemed ready to drip water.
Lin Yinyin's forehead sweated; Master seemed very angry.
Zhang Xian stood for a while, felt somewhat tired, and simply sat down on a small stool, meeting Li Fuxi's gaze.
Hmm, two great beauties pleasing to the eye. Oh, no wait, Master only counts as a small beauty, but her "truth" is indeed big.
Seeing Zhang Xian's mind already wandering, Li Fuxi coldly snorted. "Zhang Xian, do you know what kind of supreme treasure the Ascension Immortal Grass is?"
Zhang Xian nodded. "I know. An Earth-grade spirit medicine. It can improve Spirit Root quality and even help cultivators break through bottlenecks."

"You know, yet you casually give it away? Two stalks of Ascension Immortal Grass are enough to make late-stage Golden Core cultivators fight until their heads break to seize them! And you actually use them to curry favor with Liu Qingxuan?"
Her chest heaved violently. "Do you think possessing a small world lets you do whatever you want? Leaving such treasures in your hands is simply a waste of natural resources!"
"If Master likes it, this disciple can also give you a few."
"Shut up! This Seat does not need it! If you have extras, give them to Junior Sister Yinyin or consume them yourself—that is still much better than giving them away."

Zhang Xian's heart froze. Master refusing the Ascension Immortal Grass was somewhat unexpected. By all rights, no cultivator would refuse such a heaven-defying treasure. Had Master already consumed some, or were there other hidden reasons?
Zhang Xian didn’t think too much about it and just replied, "Yinyin and I have both consumed several already. They have no effect on us now.

"Several..." Li Fuxi was somewhat dazed. At the Jade Capital auction a few months ago, she was present; just one stalk fetched a sky-high price of 1.76 million mid-grade spirit stones. That was more than her entire net worth; back then, even bidding for one Beauty Preservation Pill had been difficult for her.
It seemed she had still underestimated Zhang Xian's financial power. No wonder Yun Wanqing personally received him and spent favors to recommend him to the inner sect.
It seemed the forces behind Zhang Xian were truly immeasurable. Lin Yinyin following him couldn't be considered being mistreated.
"Master, I didn't lie. I still have plenty of Ascension Immortal Grass here—"
"No need! It is useless to me." Li Fuxi’s voice carried a trace of weariness.

Zhang Xian suddenly remembered the previous auction where Master had bid against him. So, he took out an exquisite jade box, opened it to reveal precisely one Beauty Preservation Pill, and smiled. "Then what about this? During this time, Master has worked hard taking care of Yinyin. This is disciple's filial piety; please accept it."
Since Lin Yinyin entered the sect, Li Fuxi had taught her with great care, helping her clear her meridians daily. Zhang Xian saw all of this; reasonably and emotionally, he had to thank her.
"This..." Li Fuxi's beautiful eyes stared at the Beauty Preservation Pill. She indeed needed this pill!
It was just that she felt too embarrassed to take it; how could a master accept a disciple's things?

Lin Yinyin saw Li Fuxi's hesitant expression and felt joy in her heart. She quickly hugged her master's arm and acted coquettishly. "Master, just accept it! This is much cheaper than the Ascension Immortal Grass. It's just a token of appreciation for your hard work transferring true energy daily."
Li Fuxi hesitated for a while but still accepted the Beauty Preservation Pill, saying, "You are thoughtful. This Seat will not stand on ceremony then."
[Ding! Successfully gifted Li Fuxi Beauty Preservation Pill. Triggered return: Beauty Preservation Pill x100.]
[Beauty Preservation Pill: No grade. Preserves youthful appearance forever; jade-like bones naturally formed.]
[Ding! Current Favorability: -3.]
Zhang Xian's suspicion grew even greater. Is Master all bust and no brains? The Beauty Preservation Pill, though precious, couldn't compare to the Ascension Immortal Grass at all.
As if possessed, Zhang Xian used the system to check Li Fuxi.
[Li Fuxi: 6-point Daughter of Destiny. Current Favorability: -3.]
Back at the auction, her Destiny Points were clearly 20. How were there only 6 points left now?
Zhang Xian checked Lin Yinyin again.
[Lin Yinyin: 66-point Daughter of Destiny. Current Favorability: 72.]
Zhang Xian fell into deep thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 42 Master, Stop Peeking
paragraphs: "I will be away for a period of time, ranging from two months to half a year," Li Fuxi continued.
Upon hearing that her master was leaving, Lin Yinyin's eyes lit up. Great! It had been so long since she had been intimate with her brother.

As if reading her thoughts, Li Fuxi glanced at Lin Yinyin. "Yinyin, your talent far surpasses mine. Your future achievements are limitless. You must diligently cultivate the Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra and must no longer engage in Yin-Yang harmony with Zhang Xian."
"Your disciple understands," Lin Yinyin replied obediently.
After saying this, Li Fuxi shot a fierce glare at Zhang Xian and said, "Alright, you may go."
After the two left, Li Fuxi let out a soft sigh. Her eyes fixed on the calligraphy on the wall as she murmured, "Master, your disciple will not bring disgrace to Spirit Sword Peak."
With that, she tightened her grip on the jade box in her hand.
Dusk deepened, and stars and the moon hung high in the sky.
Zhang Xian was still soaking in the spirit spring. Tonight's evening lesson with Li Fuxi was canceled, and Liu Qingxuan over at Green Wood Peak had also announced a temporary suspension of classes.
He was checking the sect's jade slips to see if any classes from other peaks interested him.
A figure crept over from the darkness and suddenly covered his eyes. "Guess who I am?"
Sensing the unique fragrance of a young maiden, Zhang Xian laughed. "Yinyin, stop fooling around."
"Wrong guess! I'm Li Fuxi!" Lin Yinyin said in a forced voice before jumping into the spirit spring with a splash. "Come quickly and scrub your master's back."
The young maiden in her undergarments was instantly soaked by the spirit spring, outlining her graceful figure as the wet fabric clung to her body. She swam towards Zhang Xian like a little fish.
Zhang Xian's Adam's apple bobbed slightly. "Master hasn't even left yet, and you dare to come here. Aren't you afraid of being caught and confined?"

Lin Yinyin whispered, "Master should have left already. I saw her summon Senior Sister Zhenhai and Senior Sister Tiexin separately this afternoon and then leave. She hasn't returned since. I've been keeping an eye out!"
As she spoke, she splashed around in the spring water a few times and sighed. "Such rich spiritual energy! Brother, you're so selfish. You have such a spirit spring and didn't even call me."
Zhang Xian pointed to the mid-grade spirit stones embedded in the stone wall. "You're taken away by Master every day. When would I have had the chance to call you?"

"Actually, Master might seem strict, but she's really quite kind. She spends spiritual energy every day to smooth my meridians for me, each session lasting an entire night. I'm almost at Foundation Establishment sixth level now. And she often gives me extra tutoring; I've become quite proficient in both the Yunmiao Sword Scripture and the Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra now."
"I know."

Lin Yinyin stuck out her tongue. "It's a pity that I'm destined not to master the Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra to its peak; I can only use it for strengthening my body." As she said this, she pounced towards Zhang Xian.
"Yinyin, your cultivation is not easy—"
Lin Yinyin made a shushing gesture with one hand while placing her other jade-like hand on Zhang Xian's chest, breathing softly like an orchid: "Brother, your heart is beating so fast."
"Nonsense!
Lin Yinyin raised her head, her eyes glistening with moisture as she tried to undo her thin garment.
Huh?
After watching her struggle for a minute, Zhang Xian asked, "What's wrong?"
Lin Yinyin immediately made a pained face. "Master... Master placed a restriction on me! I can't undo my clothes!"
Zhang Xian: "..."
Lin Yinyin said pitifully, "Brother, help me."
Zhang Xian shrugged helplessly, thinking to himself that he was even weaker than her; if she couldn't undo it, what could he possibly do?
Lin Yinyin was almost on the verge of tears as she looked at Zhang Xian, who also seemed somewhat disappointed.
Suddenly, her eyes lit up, and then a faint blush spread across her cheeks.

Zhang Xian saw her raise her hands to gather her long hair. She took out a plain white hair ribbon from her sleeve and deftly wrapped it around her hair a few times with her fingertips, tying it up high.
Hmm?
[Li Fuxi's Favorability towards you -2. Current Favorability: -5.]
Oh no, we've been discovered.
Zhang Xian lamented that the hard-earned Favorability points had just dropped back down again.
[Li Fuxi's Favorability towards you -2. Current Favorability: -7.]
Yinyin has doomed me!

In the following days, Zhang Xian lived a carefree life. After Li Fuxi left the mountain, Spirit Sword Peak's morning and evening lessons were merged into Poyun Peak's schedule, causing Spirit Sword Peak to gradually become deserted. The contribution points Chen Tiexin bought for him also started arriving one after another.
[Subdued demons in Western Mountains; slew over 100 Foundation Establishment minor demons along with their inner cores; obtained 500 contribution points.]
[Explored secret realm in southern minor kingdom; obtained 3 mid-grade magic swords and one unknown fragmentary map; donated to sect; obtained 1200 contribution points.]
[Submitted one patented technique to Heavenly Puppet Peak; donated to Sister Zhiyin; obtained 300 contribution points.]
One day, Zhang Xian received a message. To his surprise, it was from Yun Wanqing: "Fellow Daoist Zhang Xian! Long Zhi from Lingxu Sect sent over 2 Immortal Ascension Pills! Are they yours!?"

Zhang Xian immediately perked up; he had almost forgotten about this matter! Back then, he was only focused on sending off the Immortal Ascension Grass for returns; he never expected her disciple to be so amazing—actually managing to refine them and even sending over 2 pills!
What a good person!

"Yes, they are. Please trouble Pavilion Master Yun to have someone deliver them to me. Also... I have an additional presumptuous request: I hope your pavilion can help me prepare some materials and heavenly treasures for repairing damage; I will send you a list shortly."
"Alright, I will have Yunqi contact you.

"You can also keep an eye out for other Earth-grade heavenly treasures for me; the price is negotiable. As thanks for your trouble... Pavilion Master may keep one of the Immortal Ascension Pills for yourself... Pleasant cooperation."
A long silence followed from the other side.
[Successfully gifted Yun Wanqing an Immortal Ascension Pill; triggered return; returned Immortal Ascension Pill x100.]

Oh? So returns can be triggered without gifting in person either... Zhang Xian noted this mentally. In the future, when giving things to Li Miaozhen and others... I could just use delivery services...
Thinking of Li Miaozhen... Zhang Xian suddenly realized something... No wonder he always felt Li Fuxi looked somewhat familiar... Her eyebrows and eyes resembled Li Miaozhen's quite closely...
Plus, they both shared the surname Li... Perhaps they were even relatives...

"Fellow Daoist... please list out what you need for me... This Palace Mistress will personally prepare them for you... To receive such treatment from Fellow Daoist truly brings Wanqing great fortune..." Yun Wanqing finally replied.
"Thank you," Zhang Xian replied succinctly.
"Come here, Yinyin... open your mouth."
"Ah!" Lin Yinyin by the spring didn't even think before waiting expectantly for feeding.
Zhang Xian tossed three pills consecutively into her mouth.
"Mmmph, wha' are these?" Lin Yinyin mumbled with puffed cheeks.
"Nothing much... one Longevity Pill... one Qi-Blood Pill... one Immortal Ascension Pill..."
[Ding! Successfully gifted Lin Yinyin Longevity Pill; triggered return; returned Longevity Pill x100.]
[Longevity Pill: Yellow-grade pill; consuming it can extend lifespan; mortals can extend lifespan by 100 years; effect reduced for cultivators; ineffective for cultivators above Golden Core stage.]
[Ding! Successfully gifted Lin Yinyin Qi-Blood Pill; triggered return; returned Tiger Bone Pill x10.]
[Tiger Bone Pill: Mysterious-grade pill; consuming it can enhance qi-blood vitality; no restriction on cultivation realm; effect diminishes with repeated consumption.]
[Ding! Successfully gifted Lin Yinyin Immortal Ascension Pill; triggered return; returned Immortal Ascension Pill x100.]
[Immortal Ascension Pill: Earth-grade pill; epic-level pill; after consumption can greatly improve cultivator's Spirit Root quality; effect diminishes with repeated consumption.]
Another profit made!
"The Immortal Ascension Pill is—" Lin Yinyin started asking but suddenly widened her eyes—"Mmph!"

She felt the medicinal potency spread through her body—a surge of energy coursing through every part—all her pores opening up comfortably—strands of ice-blue spiritual mist rising from the top of her head—spiritual patterns gradually condensing between her eyebrows—
This is—her Spirit Root quality improving again?

You must diligently cultivate the Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra and must no longer engage in Yin-Yang harmony with Zhang Xian."
"Your disciple understands," Lin Yinyin replied obediently.
After saying this, Li Fuxi shot a fierce glare at Zhang Xian and said, "Alright, you may go."
After the two left, Li Fuxi let out a soft sigh.
Her eyes fixed on the calligraphy on the wall as she murmured, "Master, your disciple will not bring disgrace to Spirit Sword Peak."
With that, she tightened her grip on the jade box in her hand.
Dusk deepened, and stars and the moon hung high in the sky.
Zhang Xian was still soaking in the spirit spring.
Tonight's evening lesson with Li Fuxi was canceled, and Liu Qingxuan over at Green Wood Peak had also announced a temporary suspension of classes.
He was checking the sect's jade slips to see if any classes from other peaks interested him.
A figure crept over from the darkness and suddenly covered his eyes.
"Guess who I am?"
Sensing the unique fragrance of a young maiden, Zhang Xian laughed.
"Yinyin, stop fooling around."
"Wrong guess!
I'm Li Fuxi!" Lin Yinyin said in a forced voice before jumping into the spirit spring with a splash.
"Come quickly and scrub your master's back."
The young maiden in her undergarments was instantly soaked by the spirit spring, outlining her graceful figure as the wet fabric clung to her body.
She swam towards Zhang Xian like a little fish.
Zhang Xian's Adam's apple bobbed slightly.
"Master hasn't even left yet, and you dare to come here.
Aren't you afraid of being caught and confined?"
Lin Yinyin whispered, "Master should have left already.
I saw her summon Senior Sister Zhenhai and Senior Sister Tiexin separately this afternoon and then leave.
She hasn't returned since.
I've been keeping an eye out!"
As she spoke, she splashed around in the spring water a few times and sighed.
"Such rich spiritual energy!
Brother, you're so selfish.
You have such a spirit spring and didn't even call me."
Zhang Xian pointed to the mid-grade spirit stones embedded in the stone wall.
"You're taken away by Master every day.
When would I have had the chance to call you?"
"Actually, Master might seem strict, but she's really quite kind.
She spends spiritual energy every day to smooth my meridians for me, each session lasting an entire night.
I'm almost at Foundation Establishment sixth level now.
And she often gives me extra tutoring; I've become quite proficient in both the Yunmiao Sword Scripture and the Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra now."
"I know."
Lin Yinyin stuck out her tongue.
"It's a pity that I'm destined not to master the Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra to its peak; I can only use it for strengthening my body." As she said this, she pounced towards Zhang Xian.
"Yinyin, your cultivation is not easy—"
Lin Yinyin made a shushing gesture with one hand while placing her other jade-like hand on Zhang Xian's chest, breathing softly like an orchid: "Brother, your heart is beating so fast."
"Nonsense!
Lin Yinyin raised her head, her eyes glistening with moisture as she tried to undo her thin garment.
Huh?
After watching her struggle for a minute, Zhang Xian asked, "What's wrong?"
Lin Yinyin immediately made a pained face.
"Master...
Master placed a restriction on me!
I can't undo my clothes!"
Zhang Xian: "..."
Lin Yinyin said pitifully, "Brother, help me."
Zhang Xian shrugged helplessly, thinking to himself that he was even weaker than her; if she couldn't undo it, what could he possibly do?
Lin Yinyin was almost on the verge of tears as she looked at Zhang Xian, who also seemed somewhat disappointed.
Suddenly, her eyes lit up, and then a faint blush spread across her cheeks.
Zhang Xian saw her raise her hands to gather her long hair.
She took out a plain white hair ribbon from her sleeve and deftly wrapped it around her hair a few times with her fingertips, tying it up high.
Hmm?
[Li Fuxi's Favorability towards you -2.
Current Favorability: -5.]
Oh no, we've been discovered.
Zhang Xian lamented that the hard-earned Favorability points had just dropped back down again.
[Li Fuxi's Favorability towards you -2.
Current Favorability: -7.]
Yinyin has doomed me!
In the following days, Zhang Xian lived a carefree life.
After Li Fuxi left the mountain, Spirit Sword Peak's morning and evening lessons were merged into Poyun Peak's schedule, causing Spirit Sword Peak to gradually become deserted.
The contribution points Chen Tiexin bought for him also started arriving one after another.
[Subdued demons in Western Mountains; slew over 100 Foundation Establishment minor demons along with their inner cores; obtained 500 contribution points.]
[Explored secret realm in southern minor kingdom; obtained 3 mid-grade magic swords and one unknown fragmentary map; donated to sect; obtained 1200 contribution points.]
[Submitted one patented technique to Heavenly Puppet Peak; donated to Sister Zhiyin; obtained 300 contribution points.]
One day, Zhang Xian received a message.
To his surprise, it was from Yun Wanqing: "Fellow Daoist Zhang Xian!
Long Zhi from Lingxu Sect sent over 2 Immortal Ascension Pills!
Are they yours!?"
Zhang Xian immediately perked up; he had almost forgotten about this matter!
Back then, he was only focused on sending off the Immortal Ascension Grass for returns; he never expected her disciple to be so amazing—actually managing to refine them and even sending over 2 pills!
What a good person!
"Yes, they are.
Please trouble Pavilion Master Yun to have someone deliver them to me.
Also...
I have an additional presumptuous request: I hope your pavilion can help me prepare some materials and heavenly treasures for repairing damage; I will send you a list shortly."
"Alright, I will have Yunqi contact you.
"You can also keep an eye out for other Earth-grade heavenly treasures for me; the price is negotiable.
As thanks for your trouble...
Pavilion Master may keep one of the Immortal Ascension Pills for yourself...
Pleasant cooperation."
A long silence followed from the other side.
[Successfully gifted Yun Wanqing an Immortal Ascension Pill; triggered return; returned Immortal Ascension Pill x100.]
Oh?
So returns can be triggered without gifting in person either...
Zhang Xian noted this mentally.
In the future, when giving things to Li Miaozhen and others...
I could just use delivery services...
Thinking of Li Miaozhen...
Zhang Xian suddenly realized something...
No wonder he always felt Li Fuxi looked somewhat familiar...
Her eyebrows and eyes resembled Li Miaozhen's quite closely...
Plus, they both shared the surname Li...
Perhaps they were even relatives...
"Fellow Daoist... please list out what you need for me...
This Palace Mistress will personally prepare them for you...
To receive such treatment from Fellow Daoist truly brings Wanqing great fortune..." Yun Wanqing finally replied.
"Thank you," Zhang Xian replied succinctly.
"Come here, Yinyin... open your mouth."
"Ah!" Lin Yinyin by the spring didn't even think before waiting expectantly for feeding.
Zhang Xian tossed three pills consecutively into her mouth.
"Mmmph, wha' are these?" Lin Yinyin mumbled with puffed cheeks.
"Nothing much... one Longevity Pill... one Qi-Blood Pill... one Immortal Ascension Pill..."
[Ding!
Successfully gifted Lin Yinyin Longevity Pill; triggered return; returned Longevity Pill x100.]
[Longevity Pill: Yellow-grade pill; consuming it can extend lifespan; mortals can extend lifespan by 100 years; effect reduced for cultivators; ineffective for cultivators above Golden Core stage.]
[Ding!
Successfully gifted Lin Yinyin Qi-Blood Pill; triggered return; returned Tiger Bone Pill x10.]
[Tiger Bone Pill: Mysterious-grade pill; consuming it can enhance qi-blood vitality; no restriction on cultivation realm; effect diminishes with repeated consumption.]
[Ding!
Successfully gifted Lin Yinyin Immortal Ascension Pill; triggered return; returned Immortal Ascension Pill x100.]
[Immortal Ascension Pill: Earth-grade pill; epic-level pill; after consumption can greatly improve cultivator's Spirit Root quality; effect diminishes with repeated consumption.]
Another profit made!
"The Immortal Ascension Pill is—" Lin Yinyin started asking but suddenly widened her eyes—"Mmph!"

She felt the medicinal potency spread through her body—a surge of energy coursing through every part—all her pores opening up comfortably—strands of ice-blue spiritual mist rising from the top of her head—spiritual patterns gradually condensing between her eyebrows—
This is—her Spirit Root quality improving again?

chapters.title: Chapter 43 Auntie Has Something on Zhang Xian
paragraphs: Ten thousand miles away—within the Cloud Raiment Pavilion's blessed realm.
Yun Wanqing's emotions took a long time to settle down—she owed an enormous favor this time!

When she received the two Immortal Ascension Pills initially, she was already shocked enough. Then, hearing that Zhang Xian wanted to give one more directly to her, she felt utterly overwhelmed mentally!
Immortal Ascension Pills were too precious! Their value couldn't even be measured properly using spirit stones!
Did Zhang Xian perhaps like her?

But this price was too high too. Regardless of the reason, though, she couldn't refuse an Immortal Ascension Pill—something capable of greatly improving Spirit Root quality, something even Nascent Soul ancestors would fight desperately over. The temptation was simply too great!

With this single Immortal Ascension Pill, Yun Wanqing felt confident in raising her own Spirit Root quality up to the Supreme Spirit Root level, reaching the peak of the Golden Core stage within the foreseeable future. Then, aiming for Nascent Soul would not be impossible either!
If she could achieve Nascent Soul cultivation, the Cloud Raiment Pavilion would leap directly into top-tier sect status alongside the Six Great Powers!
Regardless, though, she would accept the pill first and consider favor repayment later.
Thinking thusly, she immediately contacted Yun Qi via message transmission. "Yun Qi... previously, did Zhang Xian seek your help customizing a flying vessel?"
"Yes, indeed... barely over a month ago. We just finalized the details and are about to start production soon. Why, Auntie?"

"Help expedite the process while simultaneously upgrading the vessel's grade tier... The extra cost will be covered by me. Add another budget of three million mid-grade spirit stones atop the original price. I want the finished product within six months."
Yun Qi: "..."

"Also, I will send a list later. Prepare the materials accordingly listed there. Also, keep a lookout for any Earth-grade heavenly treasures around the two-million range. Don't hesitate to directly purchase them."
Yun Qi was stunned. "This is also what Zhang Xian wants? Auntie, are you serious? Two million?"
"Yes," Yun Wanqing’s tone brooked no argument, emphasizing again. "You heard correctly... Once the flying vessel is ready, deliver it immediately to the Yunmiao Sect and give it to Zhang Xian."
"Forget it, don't need to deliver. Inform me once it is ready. I will personally deliver it instead," added Yun Wanqing before cutting the transmission short.
Beside Yun Qi, several loyal subordinates, seeing his dumbfounded expression, asked, "Great Commander, what happened?"
"I suspect the Pavilion Mistress has leverage held against her by someone else..."
Could something untoward have happened between them within that Jade Capital tower’s secret chamber? Yun Qi was completely baffled now.
Meanwhile, after Lin Yinyin consumed three consecutive Immortal Ascension Pills, a system prompt sounded again.
[Ding! Current Destiny Points: 84.]
"Test using the Spirit Measuring Pearl," said Zhang Xian.
Having prior experience, Lin Yinyin was steadier this time. She took out the pearl and slowly infused spiritual power.
The golden orb erupted with dazzling golden light, the scale directly maxing out, surrounded by swirling threads of ice-blue spiritual energy.
"This..." Lin Yinyin was stunned speechless.

"Your body’s Water Spirit Root affinity for water elements has already reached perfection... Such a Spirit Root is considered Heaven’s favored, commonly called a Heavenly Spirit Root. Now, you are no longer merely 'using water' but rather 'commanding water'."
Lin Yinyin’s eyes immediately misted over, tears welling up. Brother treats me too well; I don't know how to repay him anymore.
[Ding! Current Favorability: 77.]
What Heavenly Spirit Root? She didn't care right now; she only wanted to pull her brother down into the water right now.

"Yinyin, I need to enter seclusion for a few days. You go play first." Zhang Xian hurriedly stopped her. After all, strength-wise, he was still two minor realms lower than her. These past days of accompanying her frolicking had already left him somewhat overwhelmed.
"Then I'll come back tomorrow..." She bit her lower lip, her silver teeth gleaming, her eyes shimmering like silk threads.
Zhang Xian sat upright solemnly. "Three days... this seclusion requires three days. Help close the door behind you."
Finished speaking, he sat cross-legged on the meditation mat like an old monk entering a samadhi state.
No choice. Yinyin is too strong. Back when he had a dozen-plus beautiful concubines, he never felt such strain. It seems I am still lacking strength; I must hurry and improve indeed.
"Hmph!" Lin Yinyin stamped her foot a little angrily.

Seeing Lin Yinyin walk far away, Zhang Xian finally breathed a sigh of relief. He first swallowed several Longevity Pills and Tiger Bone Pills to moisten his throat. There was a slight improvement, though not much.
Then, he started swallowing Immortal Ascension Pills.
After a series of phenomena, he consumed four consecutive pills, making further consumption ineffective. He tested using the measuring pearl again.
Whoa, halfway point. Slightly past. Roughly fifty-two points—a mid-grade Wood Spirit Root, almost approaching the average level among Yunmiao Sect disciples.
Quite satisfied indeed.
Green Wood Peak, Liu Qingxuan resumed classes today.

When Zhang Xian stepped into the lecture hall, the entire Spiritual Plant Hall atmosphere instantly froze. All disciples simultaneously turned their heads, their gazes sharp like knives stabbing directly towards the seated far back corner position occupied by none other than...
"Well, well! I said why he suddenly appeared today; turns out Supervisor Liu returned!"
"Smelled the scent and came running, what a beast! Err, perhaps an inappropriate metaphor, apologies Supervisor Liu!
"Spirit Sword Peak Senior Brother has news saying Junior Sister Lin didn't return to the dormitory these past few nights. Damn, Supervisor Li is gone, and this dog bastard directly took off flying!"
"Now, with daily and nightly revelries at Spirit Sword Peak, Junior Sister Lin still covets our Supervisor Liu too!"
Low murmurs spread throughout the hall while Liu Qingxuan lowered her head, her fingertips unconsciously twisting her clothes' hem, her ear tips faintly blushing red.
She didn’t dare look toward his direction.
He gave me Immortal Ascension Grass, gave me a Beauty Preservation Pill, and even held my hand...
Does he perhaps like me?
She wanted to return the items, but it had already been many days, and she didn't know how to face him anymore.

She secretly hated herself; she shouldn't have accepted it all. Yet recalling the past days secluded researching the Immortal Ascension Grass, those joyful times, she felt reluctant to part with them.
As for the Beauty Preservation Pill... it had already been consumed long ago. Ask which woman doesn't love beauty, after all?
Thinking thus, her heartbeat lost its rhythm. She simply couldn't return anymore; she could only take a step and see the step ahead.
Forcing composure, she opened her teaching notes, her voice softer than usual by three degrees. "Today, we explain..."
Zhang Xian sat steady as an old dog, merely attentively listening to the class.

Beside him, Lu Renbing, after many days of recuperation, had mostly recovered. Learning that Zhang Xian had resumed coveting their respected Supervisor Liu, he nearly relapsed into his old injury, pounding his chest and stamping his feet. It's all my fault for misjudging the person and inviting a wolf into the house, ah!
Lu Rendin, as Green Wood Peak's Senior Brother, was steadier. He merely glanced at Zhang Xian's figure, sneering repeatedly.
Old lecher, enjoy your arrogance while you can...
Tomorrow, when the Peak Lord returns to the mountain, marks your death date indeed!
I wonder what his reaction will be upon learning a trash low-grade Spirit Root dares harbor designs upon his daughter?
Huh? Looks like he's not low-grade anymore. Forget it, unimportant anyway...
As the Peak Lord’s personal disciple, he had already compiled a list of crimes and sent it along, including signatures and seals from other Green Wood Peak disciples attached.
A joint petition indeed!
Sure enough, upon hearing this, the Peak Lord Master was furious and was already speeding back on his journey...

chapters.title: Chapter 44 I’ve Never Had Much Interest in Matters of Romance
paragraphs: After class, Zhang Xian remained behind as usual, walking slowly toward Liu Qingxuan, who was organizing her teaching materials.
"Supervisor Liu," he slightly cupped his hands, his voice gentle. "Regarding the Azure Emperor's Rejuvenation Art, this disciple has some questions I'd like to ask for guidance."
Liu Qingxuan was slightly taken aback but then began explaining carefully to Zhang Xian. As she spoke, her emotions gradually stabilized, returning to her normal role as a Supervisor.

Other disciples glared angrily. This shameless Zhang Xian had such thick skin, always finding excuses to approach Supervisor Liu after every class. Supervisor Liu, being a teacher and somewhat naive, was completely deceived!
After the explanation ended, Zhang Xian continued asking, "Supervisor Liu, has there been any progress in the research on the Immortal Ascension Grass?"
Liu Qingxuan shook her head. "Not yet. I secluded myself for a period to study it and only have a preliminary idea. I haven't had the chance to implement it yet."
"It's fine. Supervisor Liu, feel free to experiment boldly. If both plants fail, I have more here. Don't feel any psychological burden."
Her breath hitched slightly, and she instinctively shrank back. "N-no need for now."
Not far away, several disciples pretending to tidy spiritual plants pricked up their ears, their expressions twisted.
"This bastard still wants to give more? Isn't that too shameless?"
"Beast! Does he think Immortal Ascension Grass is common cabbage?!"
"His advances are too fierce. Even I might not be able to withstand them."

Lu Rendong finally couldn't take it anymore. He stood up with a swish and righteously shouted, "Zhang Xian! Mind your words and actions! Supervisor Liu is busy with affairs; how can you keep disturbing her?! The Supervisor already said she doesn't want it, yet you still insist on giving it. What are your true intentions?"

Zhang Xian turned his head, looking confused. "Senior Brother Lu, why do you say that? I merely wish for Supervisor Liu to help me research and cultivate spiritual plants. What other intentions could I possibly have?"
"This is clearly persistent pestering!"

Zhang Xian sighed lightly, his face full of righteous indignation. "Senior Brother Lu, if you choose to think of me that way, there's nothing I can do. My heart is devoted to the Dao; I've never had much interest in matters of romance. Bothering Supervisor Liu to help me research spiritual plants is solely to aid the minor world behind me. There is absolutely no personal motive."
The disciples: "..."
Damn his 'no interest in romance'! Junior Sister Lin Yinyin has already been thoroughly corrupted by him!
"I believe Supervisor Liu also trusts my character, right?" Zhang Xian turned to look at Liu Qingxuan.
Liu Qingxuan's face flushed bright red instantly. "Y-yes!"
"I have matters to attend to!" She abruptly stood up, turned, and ran outside, disappearing from the classroom in the blink of an eye.
Zhang Xian withdrew his gaze, leisurely straightened his sleeves, and smiled slightly at everyone. "It seems Supervisor Liu is indeed very busy." He then cupped his hands in farewell.
Lu Rendong clutched his chest. This guy's skin was thicker than imaginable. It seemed only the Peak Master could suppress him.
This fellow was simply too loaded with resources. Lu Rendong worried Supervisor Liu wouldn't be able to hold out much longer.
The next day.
A green streak shot through the sky from the horizon at such speed that it tore a long-lasting rift through the clouds.
The mountain-guarding disciples had just looked up when that figure crashed down before the mountain gate with the force of wind and thunder, causing the entire peak to tremble slightly.
"P-Peak Master?!"
"Master!" Lu Rendong was overjoyed.
Great! Master rushed back early! Finally, someone would uphold justice for them!
The arrival was none other than Green Wood Peak's Peak Master, Liu Huaigu, who was also Liu Qingxuan's biological father.

Liu Huaigu appeared to be an elder in his fifties with a naturally somewhat fierce countenance. Having received his disciple's message, he rushed back without rest or sleep; his hair bun was now somewhat disheveled.
"Lu Rendong! Come see me at my cave abode!" Liu Huaigu shouted lightly. "And summon Qingxuan for me!"
With a flick of his sleeve, he entered the cave abode. Lu Rendong secretly rejoiced inside.
Master is very angry!
Inside the Peak Master's cave abode.

Liu Qingxuan stood obediently to the side. Lu Rendong and several other disciples recounted Zhang Xian's actions over these past days. While appearing neutral in their descriptions, they secretly added inflammatory details.
"At that time, I saw Supervisor Liu had already said she didn't want it, but that dog—that junior Zhang Xian insisted on giving it."

"Indeed. Zhang Xian isn't even a disciple of our Green Wood Peak. These days he pretended to study diligently while openly and covertly getting close to Supervisor Liu. Initially, this student didn't want to interfere, but later I simply couldn't stand by any longer."
"Yes, he even reached out to touch Supervisor Liu. It was completely improper."
Liu Huaigu turned to look at Liu Qingxuan. "Is this true?"
Liu Qingxuan pursed her lips and replied, "Zhang Xian did give me two Immortal Ascension Grass plants for research and also a Beauty Preservation Pill. However, there were no other transgressions."
Liu Huaigu snorted and said to the disciples present, "Tell me then, what is this Zhang Xian's background?"

Some enthusiastic disciples had already prepared their statements. "This Zhang Xian has a low-grade Wood Spirit Root. He looks around forty-something years old but cultivates the False Core technique; his bone age is already over a hundred years old and he's barely at Foundation Establishment Stage Four. He also has a Dao Companion named Lin Yinyin. Both are registered as nominal disciples under Spirit Sword Peak."
"I heard they were recommended here holding a token letter; Elder Wangya was the one who received them at the time."
"Hmph! Reaching his hand into my Green Wood Peak? I'll summon Wangya here for a confrontation!" Liu Huaigu waved his sleeve dismissively and had all the disciples leave except for Liu Qingxuan.
Lu Rendong led the disciples out of the cave abode but didn't go far; they hid nearby waiting for the show.
"Excellent! Senior Brother Lu! This matter has escalated now!"

Lu Rendong wore a pleased expression. Elder Wangya held a lofty position; among the seventy-two peak masters of the Yunmiao Sect, he ranked within the top three—a true heavyweight of the sect. However, he had been brought into the sect by Liu Huaigu back in the day and always addressed him as 'Teacher,' showing great respect and affection.
"You old lecher Zhang Xian! You think Wangya is your backer? Today we've directly summoned your backer's teacher! Let's see if you dare act arrogantly now!"
Inside the cave abode.
Liu Huaigu sat upright on a rosewood chair, lightly tapping his fingertips on the armrest while staring intently at his daughter.
"Take them out," he said calmly.

Liu Qingxuan pursed her lips again and retrieved two jade boxes from her storage ring, gently placing them on the table. Lifting the lids revealed two Immortal Ascension Grass plants lying quietly inside.
Liu Huaigu glanced at them; his expression remained unchanged. "Just these?"
Liu Qingxuan curled her fingers slightly and whispered, "There's also one Beauty Preservation Pill."
"The pill?"
"I... ate it..."
"Ate it?!" Liu Huaigu's beard twitched violently.
"Mhm." The tips of Liu Qingxuan's ears turned bright red.
Liu Huaigu let out a long sigh and fell silent.
Just then, hurried footsteps sounded outside the cave abode. Wangya entered hurriedly, clearly having rushed over swiftly.

"Teacher!" He cupped his hands respectfully, his tone earnest. "Although Zhang Xian is merely a nominal disciple, his identity is somewhat special... I hope Teacher will show leniency and not expel him from the mountain sect."
Liu Huaigu glanced sideways at Wangya. "How is he special?"

"He is likely the young master of some unknown minor world; his status isn't ordinary—quite wealthy indeed... The female disciple who entered alongside him named Lin Yinyin possesses extremely high innate talent—a top-grade Water Spirit Root."
"Oh? This Lin Yinyin is his Dao Companion then?"

"Well..." Seeing Liu Huaigu's displeased expression, Wangya could only sigh lightly. "After all... those two were personally recommended by Cloud Raiment Pavilion's Pavilion Master Yun... If we expel Zhang Xian from our mountain sect... this student will find it difficult to explain things properly to Pavilion Master Yun..."
"Moreover... if Zhang Xian leaves... Lin Yinyin won't stay either... Our Yunmiao Sect cannot afford losing such talented disciples..."

sentences.text: After class, Zhang Xian remained behind as usual, walking slowly toward Liu Qingxuan, who was organizing her teaching materials.
"Supervisor Liu," he slightly cupped his hands, his voice gentle.
"Regarding the Azure Emperor's Rejuvenation Art, this disciple has some questions I'd like to ask for guidance."
Liu Qingxuan was slightly taken aback but then began explaining carefully to Zhang Xian.
As she spoke, her emotions gradually stabilized, returning to her normal role as a Supervisor.
Other disciples glared angrily.
This shameless Zhang Xian had such thick skin, always finding excuses to approach Supervisor Liu after every class.
Supervisor Liu, being a teacher and somewhat naive, was completely deceived!
After the explanation ended, Zhang Xian continued asking, "Supervisor Liu, has there been any progress in the research on the Immortal Ascension Grass?"
Liu Qingxuan shook her head.
"Not yet.
I secluded myself for a period to study it and only have a preliminary idea.
I haven't had the chance to implement it yet."
"It's fine.
Supervisor Liu, feel free to experiment boldly.
If both plants fail, I have more here.
Don't feel any psychological burden."
Her breath hitched slightly, and she instinctively shrank back.
"N-no need for now."
Not far away, several disciples pretending to tidy spiritual plants pricked up their ears, their expressions twisted.
"This bastard still wants to give more?
Isn't that too shameless?"
"Beast!
Does he think Immortal Ascension Grass is common cabbage?!"
"His advances are too fierce.
Even I might not be able to withstand them."
Lu Rendong finally couldn't take it anymore.
He stood up with a swish and righteously shouted, "Zhang Xian!
Mind your words and actions!
Supervisor Liu is busy with affairs; how can you keep disturbing her?!
The Supervisor already said she doesn't want it, yet you still insist on giving it.
What are your true intentions?"
Zhang Xian turned his head, looking confused.
"Senior Brother Lu, why do you say that?
I merely wish for Supervisor Liu to help me research and cultivate spiritual plants.
What other intentions could I possibly have?"
"This is clearly persistent pestering!"
Zhang Xian sighed lightly, his face full of righteous indignation.
"Senior Brother Lu, if you choose to think of me that way, there's nothing I can do.
My heart is devoted to the Dao; I've never had much interest in matters of romance.
Bothering Supervisor Liu to help me research spiritual plants is solely to aid the minor world behind me.
There is absolutely no personal motive."
The disciples: "..."
Damn his 'no interest in romance'!
Junior Sister Lin Yinyin has already been thoroughly corrupted by him!
"I believe Supervisor Liu also trusts my character, right?" Zhang Xian turned to look at Liu Qingxuan.
Liu Qingxuan's face flushed bright red instantly.
"Y-yes!"
"I have matters to attend to!" She abruptly stood up, turned, and ran outside, disappearing from the classroom in the blink of an eye.
Zhang Xian withdrew his gaze, leisurely straightened his sleeves, and smiled slightly at everyone.
"It seems Supervisor Liu is indeed very busy." He then cupped his hands in farewell.
Lu Rendong clutched his chest.
This guy's skin was thicker than imaginable.
It seemed only the Peak Master could suppress him.
This fellow was simply too loaded with resources.
Lu Rendong worried Supervisor Liu wouldn't be able to hold out much longer.
The next day.
A green streak shot through the sky from the horizon at such speed that it tore a long-lasting rift through the clouds.
The mountain-guarding disciples had just looked up when that figure crashed down before the mountain gate with the force of wind and thunder, causing the entire peak to tremble slightly.
"P-Peak Master?!"
"Master!" Lu Rendong was overjoyed.
Great!
Master rushed back early!
Finally, someone would uphold justice for them!
The arrival was none other than Green Wood Peak's Peak Master, Liu Huaigu, who was also Liu Qingxuan's biological father.
Liu Huaigu appeared to be an elder in his fifties with a naturally somewhat fierce countenance.
Having received his disciple's message, he rushed back without rest or sleep; his hair bun was now somewhat disheveled.
"Lu Rendong!
Come see me at my cave abode!" Liu Huaigu shouted lightly.
"And summon Qingxuan for me!"
With a flick of his sleeve, he entered the cave abode.
Lu Rendong secretly rejoiced inside.
Master is very angry!
Inside the Peak Master's cave abode.
Liu Qingxuan stood obediently to the side.
Lu Rendong and several other disciples recounted Zhang Xian's actions over these past days.
While appearing neutral in their descriptions, they secretly added inflammatory details.
"At that time, I saw Supervisor Liu had already said she didn't want it, but that dog—that junior Zhang Xian insisted on giving it."
"Indeed.
Zhang Xian isn't even a disciple of our Green Wood Peak.
These days he pretended to study diligently while openly and covertly getting close to Supervisor Liu.
Initially, this student didn't want to interfere, but later I simply couldn't stand by any longer."
"Yes, he even reached out to touch Supervisor Liu.
It was completely improper."
Liu Huaigu turned to look at Liu Qingxuan.
"Is this true?"
Liu Qingxuan pursed her lips and replied, "Zhang Xian did give me two Immortal Ascension Grass plants for research and also a Beauty Preservation Pill.
However, there were no other transgressions."
Liu Huaigu snorted and said to the disciples present, "Tell me then, what is this Zhang Xian's background?"
Some enthusiastic disciples had already prepared their statements.
"This Zhang Xian has a low-grade Wood Spirit Root.
He looks around forty-something years old but cultivates the False Core technique; his bone age is already over a hundred years old and he's barely at Foundation Establishment Stage Four.
He also has a Dao Companion named Lin Yinyin.
Both are registered as nominal disciples under Spirit Sword Peak."
"I heard they were recommended here holding a token letter; Elder Wangya was the one who received them at the time."

Reaching his hand into my Green Wood Peak?
I'll summon Wangya here for a confrontation!" Liu Huaigu waved his sleeve dismissively and had all the disciples leave except for Liu Qingxuan.

Senior Brother Lu!
This matter has escalated now!"
Lu Rendong wore a pleased expression.

However, he had been brought into the sect by Liu Huaigu back in the day and always addressed him as 'Teacher,' showing great respect and affection.
"You old lecher Zhang Xian!
You think Wangya is your backer?
Today we've directly summoned your backer's teacher!
Let's see if you dare act arrogantly now!"

Liu Huaigu sat upright on a rosewood chair, lightly tapping his fingertips on the armrest while staring intently at his daughter.

chapters.title: Chapter 45 Clearly A Lecherous Little Pervert Fond Of Beauty
paragraphs: Upon hearing Wangya mention the Cloud Raiment Pavilion, Liu Huaigu glared at him irritably. "Wangya ah... you have potential succession prospects for becoming Sect Leader someday... don't end up breaking your cultivation progress in the Nine Revolutions Jade Condensation Art right before achieving it..."
Wangya felt greatly embarrassed. "Teacher... what nonsense are you talking about? How come I don't understand..."

"Alright, alright... now you've grown up too... both your cultivation level and status far surpass mine nowadays... it's not fitting anymore for an old fellow like me to be lecturing you. Just keep things measured within your heart then..."

Wangya hastily bowed again, saying, "By the way, Teacher... within a few months, the Lingxu Sect will host an Appreciating Pills Grand Assembly... Would Teacher accompany me, representing our Yunmiao Sect together?"

Liu Huaigu flicked his sleeve dismissively. "This old man won't go! Their sect produced some Earth-grade pill among junior disciples, yet they still want to hold a grand assembly—pah! Should I go watch a bunch of old fogies flaunt their prestige there?"
Wangya gave an awkward smile—such troublesome duties only fell upon him to handle personally.

Liu Huaigu sighed emotionally. "Among the second-generation disciples, the Lingxu Sect produced Long Zhi, who originally already suppressed the other five sects somewhat... Now, unexpectedly, another pill refining grandmaster has emerged, heard also Long Zhi's apprentice, possessing a top-grade Fire Spirit Root—damn, the Lingxu Sect is really lucky..."
Wangya kept sighing repeatedly—he always prided himself on his genius reputation, which had once resonated throughout the Southern Region.

A few years ago, upon meeting Long Zhi, he realized there was always someone beyond a person, a sky beyond the sky indeed... Now, a newcomer named Yang Poxiao had emerged. He heard the person's bone age was less than a hundred years, yet they were already at the late Golden Core stage and simultaneously a pill refining grandmaster—simply awesome beyond belief.
"Don't just stand there blocking the way anymore—aren't there many affairs needing your attention on your busy schedule? Go attend to yours then..."
"What about the Zhang Xian matter..."
"Alright, alright—this old man won't beat him to death anyway. Even if expelling him from the sect is required, it needs your order and approval, so why worry so much?" Liu Huaigu spoke irritably.
"This student takes his leave then..."

Wangya exited the mountain cave, inwardly cursing Zhang Xian—the little fellow is lust-blinded and truly troublesome. Already possessing a peerless beauty Dao Companion like Lin Yinyin, yet still coveting others, moreover targeting the teacher's precious daughter right to her head...
I, a dignified Peak Master concurrently Deputy Sect Leader, yet a junior chasing girls needs me to wipe his butt afterwards. What a headache!
Better later give a hint or reminder perhaps—no, my position is not suitable. I'll directly tell Pavilion Master Yun Wanqing, let her directly educate her juniors instead...
Watching Wangya exit the mountain cave wearing a worried expression and stepping onto his sword to fly away, the nearby disciples were all greatly delighted.
"Peak Master erupted, ha ha ha! Elder Wangya cannot protect him either!"
"Heaven has eyes indeed! Peak Master, crush the dog thief Zhang Xian! Expel him from the mountain sect!"
"Zhang Xian can be driven away, but Junior Sister Yinyin must stay!"
"Yes, yes, still want to take over afterwards..."
After Wangya departed...
Liu Qingxuan lowered her head, her voice muffled. "Father, I will try to gather money to buy a Beauty Preservation Pill to return to him..."
Liu Huaigu stared at his daughter for quite a while, remaining silent.

"Actually, besides gifting these presents, Zhang Xian hasn't committed other excessive actions, nor has he expressed pursuing me either. All those were just speculations among the disciples..." she added further.
Liu Huaigu stroked his beard and suddenly asked, "What if he truly intends to pursue you then?"
Startled, she instinctively looked up. "What?"
"This father is asking whether any interest toward Zhang Xian exists perhaps?"
Her face suddenly flushed crimson, her voice completely trembling. "Fa-father! What nonsense are you speaking?! Didn't you intend to punish him earlier?"
"When did I say I would punish him?"

He continued at a leisurely pace. "This father merely inquired about his origins, discovering he is not only generous with his spending but his background is quite profound too. If you could become Dao Companions together..."
Furious shame mixed together, she retorted, "Impossible! He already possesses a Dao Companion!"
"What does that matter? This father's own Dao Companions exceed just your mother alone, after all..."
"We barely acquainted for less than two months. We're not familiar yet!"
"He gifted you two Ascension Immortal Grasses. Do you know what that signifies perhaps?"
"He-he has mediocre spiritual roots and an ordinary appearance..."
"He gifted you two Ascension Immortal Grasses..."
"He-he is over a hundred years old and barely at Foundation Establishment Stage Three..."
"He gifted you two Ascension Immortal Grasses..."
She was blushing and furious, tears welling in her eyes.
Seeing his daughter truly angered, he finally dropped his joking demeanor and sighed leisurely. "Qingxuan, this father merely hopes you live well..."

"The cultivation world is cruel. It emphasizes wealth, companionship, methods, and land. Many cultivators are trapped lacking resources, lifelong unable to advance an inch. Even among the seventy-two peak masters and supervisors of our Yunmiao Sect, half are traveling outside, risking their lives exploring secret realms, contending for slim immortal fate opportunities...
"Now, a wealthy cultivator is willing to pave the path forward for you. Isn't that fortunate indeed perhaps?"

He turned, looking at his daughter, his eyes showing rare gentleness. "If he treats you sincerely, it might be a decent destination. If he is fickle or shallow, severing the feelings later is still timely enough..."
Liu Qingxuan lowered her head, her voice a fine mosquito hum. "But daughter is unsure how to respond appropriately..."

Liu Huaigu laughed heartily, stroking his beard and saying, "You need do nothing. Simply attempt to accept enough. The fellow keeps giving; eventually, he will express his affection. Then you can decide whether to accept later."
"Just next time he gifts you something, for example, the Ascension Immortal Grass yesterday, don't refuse so thoroughly. Give others a bit more opportunity perhaps..."
"But—daughter is unsure whether he truly likes me perhaps..."

"Silly girl!" He slapped his thigh, exclaiming, "He spends so lavishly! He specifically enrolled under Li Fuxi, a woman who, though fiery-tempered, has top-notch appearance and figure. He is clearly a lecherous little pervert fond of beauty!"
Hearing her father speak thus, Liu Qingxuan recalled Zhang Xian's righteous and solemn expression and couldn't help giggling involuntarily.

Liu Huaigu proudly pointed at his daughter, saying, "My child's features are elegant, clear, and possess a transcendent aura. Which aspect is inferior to others? If he dislikes you, why gift you the Ascension Immortal Grass and the Beauty Preservation Pill? He knows those two Ascension Immortal Grasses are enough to cause the seventy-two peak masters to fight until their heads are bloody and broken indeed!"
Speaking thus, he stood up, saying, "No good! I must meet this Zhang Xian. He said yesterday he would gift another Ascension Immortal Grass; since you refused, I will go help retrieve it instead!"

Liu Qingxuan was greatly embarrassed and quickly pulled Liu Huaigu's arm. "Father, calm down! Running to demand the Ascension Immortal Grass will make it impossible for your daughter to face people afterward!"
"Oh, right." He slapped his forehead, saying, "Indeed, facing the Ascension Immortal Grass, nobody can maintain calmness indeed..."

Thus, the words spoken earlier—that she merely felt accepting the spiritual grass and pills was somewhat improper—had transformed. Upon careful reflection, her heart stirred with a faint ripple, a strange feeling.
Meanwhile, Zhang Xian, who was meditating: "?"
The disciples lurking outside the cave entrance for a long time finally awaited the emergence of the father-daughter pair.
They only saw Liu Huaigu burst into hearty laughter and transform into a green light, soaring skywards and departing!
The disciples: "?"
"What is the Peak Master happy about?"

Before they could ponder thoroughly, Liu Qingxuan emerged, walking slowly with lowered eyelashes. Her fingertips unconsciously twirled her waist ribbon, a thoughtful expression on her face, heading directly toward the medicinal garden.
"What expression is Supervisor wearing? She was supposed to interrogate and expel Zhang Xian; why is she heading to the medicinal garden instead?"
"Perhaps Elder Wangya already expelled him from the mountain sect?"
"Is that so? That doesn't seem likely. Her expression seems preoccupied, but she doesn't appear sad either, perhaps..."

chapters.title: Chapter 46 Junior Brother’s Mental Fortitude Is a Bit Lacking
paragraphs: Night fell, and it was time for the evening lecture at Green Wood Peak.
A familiar figure stepped through the doorway as light and shadow flickered at the entrance. It was Zhang Xian, arriving right on time for class.
"Damn! How is he fine?"
"That doesn't make sense!"
"Did Peak Master Wangya protect him?"
The disciples whispered among themselves.
Zhang Xian walked in with a calm and unhurried pace, completely unaware of what had transpired during the day. As he entered, he even nodded in greeting to his former good friend, Lu Renbing.
Lu Renbing felt his vision darken, sensing his condition worsening.
Zhang Xian sighed inwardly. Senior Brother Lu Renbing was a good person. He felt somewhat responsible for Lu's current state and decided he should send some spirit medicine later to help him recover.
The evening lecture began. Zhang Xian listened attentively as usual. What struck the other disciples as odd was that Supervisor Liu seemed particularly unnatural tonight.
She stood on the lecture platform, her gaze drifting towards Zhang Xian's direction from time to time before quickly looking away. Her voice was also softer than usual.
"Something's off! This is way too off!" The disciples' sense of foreboding grew stronger and stronger.
The evening lecture ended. The disciples expected Zhang Xian to stay behind and ask questions as he usually did, but today, he simply stood up and turned to leave right away.
"Huh? Not asking questions today?"
Just as everyone was puzzled, Liu Qingxuan suddenly spoke up: "Zhang Xian, wait a moment."
The disciples: "!"
Supervisor Liu was actively asking someone to stay?
Zhang Xian was also taken aback for a moment before turning around with a smile. "What guidance does Supervisor Liu have for me?"
Liu Qingxuan took a light breath, trying hard to keep her voice sounding calm. "I've noticed you seem to have made significant progress recently?"
Zhang Xian nodded. "After listening to Supervisor Liu's lectures, I gained profound insights. I accidentally had an epiphany, and my spiritual root quality even improved a bit."
"What? His spiritual root quality can still improve?"
"Damn! How did such a good thing like an epiphany happen to this bastard?"
"Heaven has no eyes!"

In the cultivation world, it was indeed possible for one's innate talent to improve or for someone to suddenly gain enlightenment, but the probability was extremely low. Usually, such fortune only occurred when overcoming a full-level heavenly tribulation. As for opportunities for sudden enlightenment, they were even rarer. No wonder these disciples were jealous to the point of madness.
"I actually must thank Supervisor Liu," Zhang Xian said, cupping his hands towards Liu Qingxuan. "If not for the Supervisor's careful guidance, this student would not have had such an opportunity."
"How shameless!"
"He's still trying to get close.
"He's not going to take something out to give Supervisor Liu again, is he? That sounds exactly like his style."
Fortunately, the scene everyone imagined did not occur. Just as everyone breathed a sigh of relief...

Liu Qingxuan's eyes flickered slightly. She took out a jade vial from her sleeve and handed it to Zhang Xian. "This is Green Spirit Jade Liquid. Use it with the spirit spring water from your Spirit Sword Peak. Just add one drop daily; it can help increase your cultivation speed by thirty percent."
The disciples: "???"
Supervisor Liu was actually giving him something?
And it was Green Spirit Jade Liquid? That single vial cost a full 3,000 contribution points—equivalent to her entire year's salary for teaching evening lectures!
"This is bad!" Lu Renbing, who also worked part-time as a fiction writer and had an extremely active imagination, began his analysis.
"It must be that the Peak Master pressured Supervisor Liu, trying to forbid their interactions. That triggered Supervisor Liu's rebellious streak."
"Ah?" The other disciples listened and felt this made some sense.
Zhang Xian accepted the jade vial. "Thank you, Supervisor Liu!"

He pondered briefly, then retrieved a magical artifact from his storage ring—a crystal-clear jade pendant engraved with calming runes. Spiritual light flowed across its surface; it was clearly a top-grade artifact at first glance.

"This item is called the Clear Heart Pendant. It helps calm and clarify the mind, effective for both alchemy and cultivation. Supervisor Liu works hard researching spirit plants; please accept this as a token of my gratitude."
The disciples: "..."
He's really starting again.
"A top-grade artifact?"
"Just giving it away casually?"
"There's no resisting this."
Liu Qingxuan quickly waved her hands in refusal. "This is too valuable; I cannot accept it."
However, before her words even finished echoing...
A flash of cyan light suddenly appeared!

"Thin? Supervisor Liu clearly has a rosy complexion; where is she thin?"
"And what's with calling him 'worthy nephew'?"
"Also, Peak Master, weren't you supposed to come here to crush Zhang Xian? Why are you smiling so much your wrinkles are showing?

Zhang Xian put on an earnest expression and cupped his hands respectfully. "So it is Peak Master Teacher! This student has been troubling Supervisor Liu with help researching the Immortal Ascension Grass; I am truly ashamed."
"You are too polite, worthy nephew," Liu Huaigu said amiably. "Although Qingxuan works hard, being able to research an Earth-grade immortal grass is also her own wish."

Zhang Xian quickly shook his head. "Peak Master Teacher speaks too kindly. Regardless of success or failure, I hope Peak Master Teacher will accept this compensation on her behalf."
As he spoke, he directly retrieved a sandalwood box from his system space and lifted the lid.
It was filled entirely with top-grade spirit stones!
Brilliant spiritual light erupted instantly, filling the entire lecture hall with dense spiritual energy.
Liu Huaigu's eyes lit up briefly, but his expression remained unchanged otherwise. He gave a light cough. "Worthy nephew, you are being too formal."

Zhang Xian maintained his earnest attitude. "I sincerely hope Supervisor Liu will accept it. Otherwise, this student will be unable to rest or eat peacefully and will feel too embarrassed to trouble the Supervisor for further research assistance in the future. Even people from my family back home would criticize me, saying I don't know how to conduct myself properly."
"You are putting me in a difficult position," Liu Huaigu sighed dramatically, helping Zhang Xian up. "Fine, I shall help you out this once and accept this on Qingxuan's behalf."

Liu Qingxuan couldn't help but facepalm. Her father was so embarrassing.

"That scoundrel Zhang Xian speaks so shamelessly! Calling giving gifts 'asking for help'!"
"The Peak Master's skin is just as thick! He accepted it so smoothly!"
Lu Rendong's face was ashen as he muttered to himself, "It's over. Supervisor Liu resisted Zhang Xian's advances, but instead, Master fell first."

"Oh no, Junior Brother Lu Renbing has fainted!"
"Ah! He's coughing up blood again! Must be his old illness flaring up."
"The junior brother's mental fortitude is still a bit lacking."

Several people hurried forward to check on him. Peak Master Liu Huaigu helped soothe his qi flow. Zhang Xian very thoughtfully left behind several pills that replenished spiritual energy, wearing an earnest expression.
"Senior Brother Lu was once my close friend. Although he has some misunderstandings about me recently, it won't affect our friendship."

A familiar figure stepped through the doorway as light and shadow flickered at the entrance.
It was Zhang Xian, arriving right on time for class.

The disciples whispered among themselves.
Zhang Xian walked in with a calm and unhurried pace, completely unaware of what had transpired during the day.
As he entered, he even nodded in greeting to his former good friend, Lu Renbing.
Lu Renbing felt his vision darken, sensing his condition worsening.
Zhang Xian sighed inwardly.
Senior Brother Lu Renbing was a good person.
He felt somewhat responsible for Lu's current state and decided he should send some spirit medicine later to help him recover.
The evening lecture began.
Zhang Xian listened attentively as usual.
What struck the other disciples as odd was that Supervisor Liu seemed particularly unnatural tonight.
She stood on the lecture platform, her gaze drifting towards Zhang Xian's direction from time to time before quickly looking away.
Her voice was also softer than usual.

The evening lecture ended.

Not asking questions today?"
