chapters.title: Chapter 47 Come, Let Me Show You Something Good
paragraphs: Lu Renbing was carried away by the combined efforts of several fellow disciples.
Peak Master Liu Huaigu watched them disappear into the distance before finally withdrawing his gaze. He turned to look at Zhang Xian, a meaningful glint of amusement flashing in his eyes.

"Worthy nephew," he said, stroking his beard. "The night scenery is lovely. How about accompanying this old man for a stroll? The night view of Green Wood Peak is widely considered one of the Yunmiao Sect's finest sights."
"That sounds good," Zhang Xian agreed.
"Qingxuan, you come too."
Liu Qingxuan's fingers trembled slightly. "I... I haven't sorted out my lecture materials yet."
"No hurry. Accompany your father for a walk."
Liu Qingxuan opened her mouth to protest but ultimately only let out a soft "Mmm" and silently followed behind the two men.

The three strolled along the mountain path. Liu Huaigu walked ahead with his hands clasped behind his back, occasionally pointing out spirit plants by the roadside and introducing them briefly. Zhang Xian responded with smiles and polite nods, while Liu Qingxuan kept her head down, her footsteps so light they were almost inaudible.
When they reached a secluded pavilion, Liu Huaigu suddenly exclaimed, "Oh dear!" and patted his forehead. "Look at my memory. Wangya just sent word saying there's important business to discuss."
He turned to look at Zhang Xian and Liu Qingxuan, smiling warmly. "You two chat first. I'll be right back."
Without waiting for their reaction, his figure whooshed away, disappearing in an instant.
Liu Qingxuan: "..."
Zhang Xian: "..."
Liu Qingxuan clenched her fingers tightly around her sleeve cuffs. The surroundings were so quiet she could hear the frantic pounding of her own heart.
Father, don't run away!!
I've never been alone like this with a male cultivator before!
After an awkward silence stretched on, Zhang Xian gave a light cough, attempting to ease the tension. "Supervisor Liu, this night plum blossom is blooming quite nicely."
Liu Qingxuan followed his gaze, her voice barely audible. "That... that isn't night plum. It's called Night Wail Orchid."

Zhang Xian nodded earnestly. "Then this student lacks academic knowledge, mistaking it for night plum. No wonder following the book's instructions always led them to wither whenever I tried cultivating them."

Liu Qingxuan instinctively continued, falling into lecture mode. "Night plum and Night Wail Orchid do look somewhat similar; beginners often mistake them. The Night Wail Orchid prefers shade. If its leaves wither, just water them daily with spirit dew, and they can recover within half a month."
As soon as she finished speaking, she realized she had been earnestly explaining. She immediately lowered her head in embarrassment, her voice growing softer until it became inaudible.
Zhang Xian smiled slightly. "Supervisor Liu is truly knowledgeable. This disciple has learned much."
"N-no, not really..."
Liu Qingxuan kept her head down, not daring to look at him. Zhang Xian could see her small face flushed bright red from the heat, and she was unconsciously fidgeting with her fingers.

Zhang Xian worried that if things continued like this, she might literally cook herself alive. He changed the subject, saying, "The weather here is getting colder. Let's head back. I also need to return and cultivate the Yunmiao Sword Scripture, so I won't disturb Supervisor Liu further."
"Yes! Then I shall take my leave too!" Liu Qingxuan said, relieved, quickly standing up. Her steps were so flustered she almost tripped over her own skirt hem.
Zhang Xian watched her hurried retreating figure, shaking his head helplessly.
This father-daughter pair... each is more interesting than the last.
Elsewhere.
Lu Renbing slowly regained consciousness. Opening his eyes, he saw several fellow disciples gathered around his bed, their faces full of concern.
"Junior Brother Lu! You're finally awake!"
Lu Renbing rubbed his temples, memories gradually returning—Zhang Xian, Supervisor Liu, and his beloved junior sister Yinyin.
No, mustn't think about it. It hurts too much.
"What happened after I fainted?"

The disciples remained silent. After a long while, one finally spoke through gritted teeth. "The Peak Master has already started matchmaking them. He called Zhang Xian and Supervisor Liu to view the night scenery, probably creating dating opportunities for them."
"Dammit, that beast! That scoundrel Zhang Xian is only at Foundation Establishment, yet he dares lay hands on Supervisor Liu!"
"Sigh. The Peak Master is getting old, blinded by money!"
Hearing this, Lu Renbing closed his eyes. Two clear trails of tears flowed down from the corners of his eyes.
"It's all my fault. I let the wolf into the house. If I hadn't recommended that scoundrel Zhang Xian to our Green Wood Peak, things wouldn't have come to this."
"It's not your fault. That Zhang Xian looks honest and upright; we were all deceived by him. It hurts remembering how I initially saw him as my future brother-in-law, even lending him my notes."
"Don't say anymore... same here." Everyone comforted him one after another.
"Oh right, what about Senior Brother?" Lu Renbing asked again. Everyone knew about Senior Brother Lu Rending's secret crush on Peak Master Liu, though no one dared say it openly.
"Sigh, don't mention it. Senior Brother's mentality has already collapsed. He went to Heavenly Puppet Peak seeking psychological counseling from Sister Zhiyin."
Lu Renbing let out a long sigh. "Since we can't rely on either the Peak Master or Senior Brother, then it falls upon me alone to seek revenge!"
His fellow disciples exchanged glances. "Senior Brother Lu, what do you plan to do?"
Lu Renbing gave a cold laugh. "I'll write him dead! Portray him as a despicable, shameless, greedy, lustful villain despised by the entire cultivation world!
Everyone: "..."
One person timidly spoke up. "But Junior Brother, didn't you already write him drowning in a manure pit in your latest novel?"

Lu Renbing slapped the bed board, his eyes burning with raging fury. "Then I'll write him dead, resurrect him, then desecrate his corpse! Resurrect him once, desecrate once more! Help me up; I'm writing ten chapters today!"
Everyone: "..."
Junior Brother Lu, isn't your obsession getting a bit deep?
Spirit Sword Peak.
As soon as Zhang Xian pushed open his door, he saw a slender figure sitting by his bedside. Moonlight streamed through the window lattice, spilling over her waterfall-like long hair.
"Yinyin."

She sat with her arms crossed, beautiful eyes gazing at him with an amused yet pointed look. "Oh, Big Brother remembers coming back? As far as I recall, Green Wood Peak evening lectures ended an hour ago. Couldn't bear to leave, could you?"
Zhang Xian wasn't surprised, casually closing the door behind him. "What, waited long?"

Lin Yinyin glanced at the book by his bedside titled Deadly Love: My Yandere Master Falls For Me, humming softly twice. "I thought you were only interested in your little sister. Never expected you wouldn't spare even senior female cultivators either. Heard there's some well-educated, elegant, graceful, utterly charming Supervisor Liu at Green Wood Peak. Quite captivating, isn't she?"
As she spoke, she tugged irritably at her own blue-white disciple robe, grumbling slightly. "If not for this young lady being under restrictions, no other woman would get such an opportunity."
Zhang Xian chuckled, sitting down beside her.
Lin Yinyin habitually leaned against him, pulling out a book from within her robes. "If Big Brother has books to read, I have some too."

Zhang Xian glanced over. The cover prominently featured Lin Yinyin's figure practicing swordplay. The book title read: Starting Off By Beating Up An Immortal Second Generation But The Junior Sister Clings To Me.
Zhang Xian asked, "What's this?"
"A new bestseller within the sect lately. Tsk tsk tsk. Chapter one features some rich young master named Zhang Renshan who gets beaten up. Then in chapter two, he drowns in a manure pit. So pitiful."
Zhang Xian: "..."
"Oh right, come over here, let me show you something good," Zhang Xian said, reaching out to pull Lin Yinyin along.
Lin Yinyin's ear tips flushed slightly red. A sweet, barely concealed smile tugged at her lips. "Oh, you just got back and you're already so impatient. Big Brother is so lecherous."
Thump.
Zhang Xian lightly flicked Lin Yinyin's forehead. "What are you thinking about all day long? It's serious business. Come here quickly."

chapters.title: Chapter 48 Still Saying You Have No Thoughts About Master
paragraphs: Moonlight flowed like water as the two arrived by the spirit spring.
Zhang Xian took a bottle of spirit liquid from his robe and handed it to Lin Yinyin, saying, "Here, this is for you."
"What is this?"
"Green Spirit Jade Liquid. Just one drop into the spirit spring can enhance its effects by thirty percent."
Lin Yinyin's eyes lit up as she reached out to take it. "This looks like a product from Green Wood Peak, doesn't it? Oh, so Liu Qingxuan gave you something. I didn't realize you were so popular."
"You're giving me something she gave you without a second thought. Aren't you afraid she'll be hurt?" Lin Yinyin said in a coquettish tone.
"Who told you to be my little sister?"
[Ding! Successfully gifted Lin Yinyin with Xuan-grade Green Spirit Jade Liquid. Triggered return: obtained Dragon Saliva Jade Liquid x10 bottles.]
[Dragon Saliva Jade Liquid: Di-grade jade liquid. When poured into a spirit pool, it can greatly enhance the quality of the spirit spring and the speed of spiritual energy absorption.]
Another pleasant surprise.
"Hmph." Lin Yinyin was inwardly delighted. She leaned over the spirit spring and dripped in a drop of the liquid. The spiritual energy within the spring water visibly became more abundant.
"Wow! It really is a treasure." With both mid-grade spirit stones and the spirit liquid enhancing it, the spirit spring's effect was even stronger.
"Wait." Zhang Xian took out a bottle of Dragon Saliva Jade Liquid from his robe and dripped a drop into the spring.
Instantly, ripples of glowing light spread across the water's surface, and the spring water became crystal clear.

Lin Yinyin covered her mouth in surprise. This bottle seemed even more potent. She reached out to touch the water; it felt as warm and soft as being wrapped in gentle clouds. She removed her outer garment and stepped into the pool. The warm water flowed against her skin, and every pore seemed to breathe, absorbing spiritual energy several times faster than before.
This feeling was even more comfortable than when Master helped her unblock her meridians daily, and the absorption speed was even quicker!

"Wow, this one is even better. No wonder you weren't impressed with Liu Qingxuan's bottle." Lin Yinyin splashed in the water and suddenly hooked her arms around Zhang Xian's neck, pulling him into the water.
"Here, this bottle is for you." Zhang Xian generously handed her the spirit liquid. However, since this was an item returned because of Lin Yinyin, it did not trigger another return.
Their foreheads pressed together. Lin Yinyin murmured, "Brother, you're so good to me. Meeting you is really Yinyin's good fortune."
Zhang Xian tapped her delicate nose. "Yinyin is very good too."
He thought to himself that most of his treasures came from returns triggered by Lin Yinyin; she was his true blessing.
"Oh right, Brother. Next time we see Master, can you help her too? She might seem fierce, but she's actually very good to me. She helps unblock my meridians every day; it's very tiring for her.
"Mm, I was planning to do just that."
"Ha! And you still say you have no thoughts about Master!" Lin Yinyin pretended to be angry. "Your true colors are showing now!"
"I don't."
"I can feel it! You still... you still..."
"It's all because you keep making a fuss."
"Hmph, Brother, you have so many treasures. You must have been very powerful in your little world."
Zhang Xian replied, "Second only to one person, above ten thousand others." He thought to himself that the current emperor still addressed him as grand-uncle-in-law.
"So you were a young master! No wonder you have endless treasures and spirit stones."
Zhang Xian did not deny it.
"Then what you told Master before about having ten beautiful concubines and your family elders constantly urging you to continue the lineage... was that also true?"

Zhang Xian shook his head. "That was all nonsense to fool Master. You believed it too?" As he spoke, he suddenly paused and said calmly, "As for ten beautiful concubines... I did have them in the past. They are all gone now."

Lin Yinyin caught a fleeting shadow of sorrow in his eyes and knew he was recalling some old memories. She didn't ask further, just smiled at him. Her slender fingers deftly gathered her loose black hair and tied it into a ponytail.
Mmm.

That night, with the help of the Dragon Saliva Jade Liquid, Zhang Xian replaced mid-grade spirit stones a full ten times, consuming ten times the usual amount. Both he and Lin Yinyin broke through their cultivation levels.
Time flew like a white steed passing a crack. In the blink of an eye, over three months passed.

Zhang Xian had already reached the fifth layer of Foundation Establishment, while Lin Yinyin was progressing towards the late Foundation Establishment stage. Late Foundation Establishment was a threshold for cultivators, but for someone with Lin Yinyin's Heavenly Spirit Root aptitude, breaking through was only a matter of time.
One day, Zhang Xian sat cross-legged on a bluestone slab in front of the thatched hut, spiritual power circulating around him, his aura steady.
"Brother! Look at me!"

A clear voice came from above. Zhang Xian looked up to see Lin Yinyin standing on a flying sword, gracefully turning a circle in mid-air. Her sleeves fluttered like an immortal descending to the mortal world.
"How about that? I can fly even higher now!" she shouted proudly, controlling the flying sword to descend slowly and hover steadily about three zhang above the ground.
Zhang Xian smiled slightly. "Not bad. You're improving quickly."
Outwardly calm as an old dog, Zhang Xian inwardly envied her greatly.

Sword flight! This had been his dream since youth. Lin Yinyin was already one step ahead. Generally, sword flight could only be mastered at the late Foundation Establishment stage. For Lin Yinyin to have such control at the sixth layer... Heavenly Spirit Roots truly defied reason.
Suddenly, the communication jade talisman at his waist vibrated slightly.
"Junior Brother Zhang, Fellow Daoist Yun Qi from Cloud Raiment Pavilion has come for a visit and is waiting at Guest Reception Peak."
It was a message from Senior Brother Zhenhai.
Zhang Xian raised an eyebrow slightly. Yun Qi had previously messaged saying he would come but hadn't given details in the message. Could it be news about the flying boat?
As he pondered this, a streak of sword light approached from afar. Zhenhai arrived on his sword and landed steadily before him.

After Li Fuxi left, Zhenhai took charge of managing Spirit Sword Peak's affairs. Over time, he had let go of his former infatuation with Lin Yinyin—after all, for a sword cultivator, his sword was his true wife.
"Let's go. We shouldn't keep our guest waiting."
"I'm coming too! I'm coming too!" Lin Yinyin chirped excitedly.
Zhang Xian nodded, and they all stepped onto Zhenhai's flying sword.
Although Lin Yinyin could fly now, having her fly across multiple peaks on her sword was still too demanding for her.
Guest Reception Peak was where the Yunmiao Sect received external guests.
When Zhang Xian's group arrived, Yun Qi was chatting happily with a young man dressed in white golden-patterned Daoist robes—the Peak Master of Wuwang Peak: Real Person Wangya.
Seeing Zhang Xian arrive, Yun Qi stood up and cupped his hands in greeting with a smile. "Fellow Daoist Zhang, long time no see."
Real Person Wangya saw this and tactfully stood up to take his leave. "Since my junior nephew has arrived, I won't disturb your reunion."
Yun Qi smiled and returned the courtesy. "Thank you for your hospitality."
After Wangya left, Zhenhai also cleared his throat. "Junior Brother Zhang, I'll let you chat. I'll wait over there."
With that said, he retreated outside the pavilion, standing with hands behind his back, assuming the dignified posture befitting Spirit Sword Peak's Senior Brother.
Inside the pavilion.
Yun Qi looked Zhang Xian up and down, his eyes flashing with surprise. "Kid, how do I feel like you’ve improved quite a bit again?"

The last time they met, Zhang Xian was at the third layer of Foundation Establishment; now he’s already at the fifth layer. Moreover, his aura was steady and his foundation solid. What surprised him more was that he could sense Zhang Xian’s Spirit Root aptitude had improved again. Simply unbelievable.
Zhang Xian smiled. "Just a slight enlightenment, nothing much."

chapters.title: Chapter 49 I Just Want To Do My Filial Duty
paragraphs: Yun Qi’s gaze fell upon Lin Yinyin, his pupils contracting slightly.
The last time they met, he sensed her Spirit Root had broken through to a top-grade Water Spirit Root. Now, seeing her again felt completely different.

She stood there seemingly surrounded by intangible water mist. With each breath, spiritual energy converged into her meridians like fine streams, as if her whole person had merged with the world’s water spiritual energy.
Is this still a top-grade Water Spirit Root?
Yun Qi was inwardly shocked.
"Fellow Daoist Lin’s cultivation progress is truly divine," Yun Qi probed, his gaze lingering on her for a few extra seconds.
"Fellow Daoist Yun flatters me; it's just good luck," Lin Yinyin smiled faintly.
Yun Qi’s eyelid twitched.
Good luck?
You call this good luck?
He turned to look at Zhang Xian and couldn't help but ask, "Zhang Xian, Fellow Daoist Lin’s Spirit Root seems stronger than the last time we met?"
Zhang Xian smiled slightly, his tone calm. "Slight enlightenment, slight enlightenment."
Yun Qi: "..."
Enlightenment my ass!
Zhang Xian clicked his tongue. "I say, Commander Yun, you old lecher, why do you keep staring at my sister first thing?"
Pfft! Yun Qi almost had a heart attack and blurted out, "Kid, you dare call me a lecher? On the flying boat, you made such a racket the whole night I couldn’t sleep properly, you—"
He suddenly remembered the party involved was right beside them and quickly shut his mouth tactfully.
Lin Yinyin blushed crimson. Later, Brother Zhang Xian had mentioned that incident to her. Remembering it made her embarrassed.
"Alright, what brings you here making a special trip?"

Yun Qi took out three brocade boxes from his robe and handed them to Zhang Xian. "This is what Aunt ordered me to personally deliver: the Immortal Ascension Pill. Kid, you're really something. I didn't expect you to auction off the Immortal Ascension Grass and get an Immortal Ascension Pill back. Now you've struck gold."

"Do you know the current value of this pill? The Lingxu Sect specially held a pill appreciation conference for it. That Yang Poxiao is truly a heaven-sent genius, actually able to refine a long-lost Earth-grade pill."

"Later, the Lingxu Sect sent people to inquire about your origins. All of it was suppressed by Aunt. Besides us two, probably nobody knows your identity. Speaking of which, you've got guts daring to give the Immortal Ascension Grass to him to refine the pill. Aren't you afraid you'd end up empty-handed?"
Zhang Xian smiled and didn’t reply. Switch places; if you had a system, you’d have guts too.
Pill appreciation conference? I've still got over ninety Immortal Ascension Pills on me. I could also hold a conference and slap that pill-refining grandmaster in the face.
But Zhang Xian thought, Forget it. That person has no grudge against me, so why show off? Besides, I owe these many pills thanks to Yang Poxiao.
"Then what are the other two boxes?"

Yun Qi chuckled. "These are what the Cloud Raiment Pavilion bought for you. This box contains a Heart-Mending Lotus. It can repair Spirit Root damage. This Heart-Mending Lotus's quality is infinitely close to Earth-grade. It's probably hard to find better quality in the Southern Region."

"The other box is a Marrow-Cleansing Remnant Fruit. Remember I told you before we auctioned a Marrow-Cleansing Remnant Fruit? Later, we contacted the seller. He had another one, so we directly bought it."
"How reliable, right? Everything you asked for was handled properly."
Zhang Xian's face lit up with joy, and he suddenly gave Yun Qi a big hug. "From now on, you are my brother from a different father and different mother!"
Yun Qi, with a face of disgust, pushed him away. "Don’t hug me! Hugging men is disgusting."
Lin Yinyin snorted. Brother Zhang never hugged me that tightly. Jealous!
"How much did this cost?" Zhang Xian took the brocade boxes.
"Tsk. This is free. Aunt specially instructed it."
Zhang Xian was startled, then understood Yun Wanqing was repaying a favor.
"Please thank the Pavilion Master for me," Zhang Xian said solemnly.

Yun Qi nodded and lowered his voice. "By the way, the flying boat matter is already arranged. Aunt specially instructed us to give it the best configuration. She even paid an extra two million spirit stones herself."
Zhang Xian raised an eyebrow. "So generous?"
Yun Qi gave him a meaningful look. "Aunt said she owes you." After finishing, he winked suggestively.
Lin Yinyin listened, confused, but her intuition told her these two definitely had a secret. She secretly pinched Zhang Xian but got an innocent look back.

The two chatted for a long time until, upon leaving, Yun Qi said, "After the flying boat is ready, Aunt will personally deliver it. Also, Zhen'er has entered the Profound Ice Array and fallen asleep."
Lin Yinyin listened, her expression dimming. She quite liked that cute little girl.
Yun Qi took a breath and continued, "For the past hundred years, Aunt has rarely personally handled business matters anymore. I can feel she sees a glimmer of hope in you."
"Zhang Xian, I know your background is profound. If it's possible to help Zhen'er, I, Yun Qi, am willing to sell my life to you."
Zhang Xian punched him in the chest. "Don’t talk so disgustingly. What do I want your life for? Rest assured. If there's a chance, I'll definitely do my utmost to help the Zhen girl.
After seeing Yun Qi off, Lin Yinyin immediately leaned in. "Brother, what riddles were you talking about just now? Why did the Cloud Pavilion Master say she owes you?"
Zhang Xian gave a mysterious smile. "This... I'm not telling."
"Hah! Brother is really a big lecher. Seeing a beautiful woman, you can’t walk straight. You gave her some rare treasure again, right?"

Zhang Xian smiled and shook his head, his gaze falling on the brocade boxes in his hand. Heart-Mending Lotus, Marrow-Cleansing Remnant Fruit. Perhaps... the day I solve my Spirit Root problem truly is not far off.
Afterward, the toolman Zhenhai carried Zhang Xian and Lin Yinyin back to Spirit Sword Peak.
After dropping the two at the thatched hut, Zhenhai was about to leave.
"Senior Brother," Zhang Xian suddenly spoke.

"What is the matter?" Zhenhai's face was indifferent. Although he had accepted the reality of Zhang Xian and Lin Yinyin, it didn’t mean he had a good face for Zhang Xian. Now his heart held only the Sword Dao!
"Senior Brother has been on the peak the longest. Can you tell me about Master's matters?"

Hah. Old lecher, your reputation is well-deserved. You have Lin Yinyin, hooked Green Wood Peak's Supervisor Liu, and now you dare extend your claws towards Master. Zhenhai shook his head. "I need to practice the sword; no time."

Zhang Xian unhurriedly took out a top-grade magic sword from his system space. The sword body flowed with a golden light halo. "Senior Brother has used that sword for many years, right? I happen to have a Geng Gold Sword here; it seems more fitting for Senior Brother's status."

Zhenhai caught a glimpse of the magic sword from the corner of his eye, and his Adam's apple unconsciously bobbed. Top-grade among top-grade magic swords! His own magic sword was also top-grade, but differences between top-grades existed too.
Zhang Xian's one was clearly master-crafted, belonging to the pinnacle of top-grade. That rich Geng Gold aura... Ah, sorry wife, I might have a change of heart.
"Master's cultivation seems to have hit a bottleneck. Senior Brother saw I am quite wealthy, so I just want to do my filial duty."
Zhenhai forcibly endured, moving his gaze away. The top-grade magic sword temptation was great, but his Dao heart was firmer!
These past few months, Junior Sister Chen Tiexin, relying on the big tree Zhang Xian, ate contribution points till full and got kickbacks till her hands were soft. I remained unmoved!
Moreover, how could he bow before a former love rival? I, the dignified Spirit Sword Peak Senior Brother, how can I abandon my dignity!
Thinking this, Zhenhai straightened his back, his tone even colder and harder. "Junior Brother is overthinking. I cannot help Master."

"Oh right, there's also this," Zhang Xian continued as if he hadn't heard. "Just now, the Cloud Raiment Pavilion Commander gave me a few magic sword maintenance packages. He said it includes ten years of free maintenance and enchantment upgrade service. Also attached is a set of Cloud Raiment Pavilion-produced scabbard cases, an eight-piece set."
Zhenhai's eyes instantly went straight.
The next instant, Zhenhai was already sitting on the stone stool in front of the thatched hut, taking out a tea set from his robe, his face full of smiles.
"Junior Brother, Junior Sister, what are you waiting for? Hurry over and drink tea."

Senior Brother saw I am quite wealthy, so I just want to do my filial duty."
Zhenhai forcibly endured, moving his gaze away.
The top-grade magic sword temptation was great, but his Dao heart was firmer!
These past few months, Junior Sister Chen Tiexin, relying on the big tree Zhang Xian, ate contribution points till full and got kickbacks till her hands were soft.
I remained unmoved!
Moreover, how could he bow before a former love rival?
I, the dignified Spirit Sword Peak Senior Brother, how can I abandon my dignity!
Thinking this, Zhenhai straightened his back, his tone even colder and harder.
"Junior Brother is overthinking.
I cannot help Master."
"Oh right, there's also this," Zhang Xian continued as if he hadn't heard.
"Just now, the Cloud Raiment Pavilion Commander gave me a few magic sword maintenance packages.
He said it includes ten years of free maintenance and enchantment upgrade service.
Also attached is a set of Cloud Raiment Pavilion-produced scabbard cases, an eight-piece set."
Zhenhai's eyes instantly went straight.
The next instant, Zhenhai was already sitting on the stone stool in front of the thatched hut, taking out a tea set from his robe, his face full of smiles.
"Junior Brother, Junior Sister, what are you waiting for?
Hurry over and drink tea."

chapters.title: Chapter 50 Do You Want to Know Master’s Bust Size or Hobbies
paragraphs: After calmly accepting the magic sword and the maintenance package voucher, Zhenhai's eyes became clear.
The three of them sat down and brewed tea.
"Boss—oh no, Junior Brother, what do you want to know about Master? Her bust size or her hobbies?"
"Senior Brother, you've misunderstood. I want to know about Master's past experiences, to see if there's anything I can help with."
Zhenhai clasped his hands in apology. "I was being petty!"
"Then let's start from the beginning."
"Speaking of which, Master was originally the Third Senior Sister back then, and I was just an ordinary registered disciple."
Lin Yinyin rested her chin in her hands. "What was Master like before?"
"Much gentler than she is now. At that time, the Peak Master of Spirit Sword Peak was still the True Person Wangchuan. The True Person had three personal disciples, and Master was the youngest."

"True Person Wangchuan was humble and possessed profound cultivation. The Eldest Senior Brother, as the Supervisor, treated all the junior disciples well, including me. Back then, Spirit Sword Peak consistently ranked within the top ten among all peaks and was the leader in swordsmanship within the Yunmiao Sect."
Zhang Xian nodded slightly; he had heard some of this history.

"Until one day, Master took the Eldest Senior Brother to explore a secret realm, and both perished. With Spirit Sword Peak's two main pillars falling simultaneously, it faced a crisis of being delisted."

Among the Yunmiao Sect's seventy-two peaks, it wasn't uncommon for legacies to disappear. If a peak went for years without a Peak Master or Supervisor presiding over it, it would gradually fade into obscurity. Surrounded by mountains, who knew how many desolate peaks within the Yunmiao Sect had turned into the dust of history?

"Speaking of which, I remember you two entered the sect with tokens from Elder Nangong Yao. Elder Nangong and True Person Xuanzhou from the Cloud Raiment Pavilion also explored that secret realm back then. That's why Master doesn't like them."

True Person Xuanzhou was precisely Yun Wanqing's husband. Zhang Xian was startled, a scene flashing through his mind: Nangong Yao falling amidst heavenly fire. He quickly asked, "How long ago did they explore that secret realm?"
Zhenhai counted on his fingers. "Nearly two hundred years."
Zhang Xian's fingers trembled slightly. Over two hundred years... the timeline didn't match up. The little dark-skinned girl was brought up the mountain a hundred years ago.

Zhenhai continued, "To prevent Spirit Sword Peak's legacy from being severed, the Second Senior Sister trained like her life depended on it. But she suffered a qi deviation, her Golden Core shattered, and she also passed away."
Lin Yinyin gasped softly, covering her mouth with her small hands.

Zhenhai's voice grew even lower. "With the Second Senior Sister gone too, Spirit Sword Peak's situation became even more dire. Many disciples switched to other peaks. That was when Master stepped forward."

"Master possesses dual Metal and Water Spirit Roots. Her cultivation speed is inherently half that of others. Yet in just a hundred years, she advanced from Foundation Establishment to the sixth level of Golden Core, becoming Supervisor and taking over Spirit Sword Peak."

"Master's only wish is to break through to the seventh level, reclaim the title of Peak Master, and revitalize Spirit Sword Peak." A flicker of respect passed through Zhenhai's eyes. "All these years, she has devoted herself to cultivation. But progressing from the sixth to seventh level is extremely difficult.

"To obtain resources, Master has represented our sect in the Southern Region Grand Competitions several times. However, her results were never ideal each time. Resources are scarce, and burdened with dual Spirit Roots... this has kept Master stuck for a hundred years until now."
"Has Master suffered any injuries? Or does she have any enemies?" Zhang Xian asked again.
Zhenhai shook his head. "Master has no enemies. The Southern Region has always been peaceful. As a Peak Master herself, she has never held grudges against anyone."

"She didn't like Nangong Yao and those from the Cloud Raiment Pavilion back then. But she also knew that exploring secret realms depends on fate; one can't blame others for misfortune. If she truly hated them, she wouldn't have accepted you two as disciples."
"As for injuries... probably not either. However, Master lost very badly in the last Southern Region Grand Competition decades ago; her magic sword nearly shattered."
Zhang Xian gently rubbed his teacup, thinking about how Master had refused his Immortal Ascension Grass.
The Immortal Ascension Grass wouldn't help her, yet she accepted the Beauty Preservation Pill instead. Zhang Xian began to form a rough guess.

Coupled with Master's Destiny Points continuously dropping... Zhang Xian recalled when he first saw Li Miaoyin; she only had 5 points. He suspected that if Destiny Points fell to zero, a Daughter of Destiny would likely die.

There were probably hidden circumstances even Zhenhai wasn't aware of. Zhang Xian didn't press further and changed the subject instead. "By the way, I have a friend at the Cloud Raiment Pavilion who asked me to inquire about something."
"Please go ahead, Junior Brother."
"It's about Elder Nangong Yao. Did she bring any disciples up the mountain a hundred years ago? Or rather, in recent centuries... has there been any exceptionally talented female disciple?"

Zhenhai thought for a moment. "I haven't heard of such a thing. By 'exceptionally talented,' Junior Brother likely means a Supreme Spirit Root? To my knowledge, only four Supreme Spirit Root disciples have entered the mountain in recent centuries."

"Besides Junior Sister Lin Yinyin here," he gestured toward Lin Yinyin beside him, who perked up at being mentioned so casually. "The other two are male cultivators," Zhenhai continued, "and the remaining one is Senior Sister Zhou Yun, who joined with prior skills. She enrolled under Breaking Cloud Peak; presumably Junior Sister Yinyin has met her too?"
Lin Yinyin nodded vigorously. She'd recently been attending morning swordsmanship classes on Breaking Cloud Peak and had already become good sisters with Senior Sister Zhou Yun!

Zhang Xian frowned slightly; what Zhenhai knew aligned roughly with his own understanding! Judging by Nangong Yao's attitude back then, though... the little dark-skinned girl must have possessed at least a Supreme Spirit Root!
With such innate talent... how could she suddenly vanish without a trace?! Was someone deliberately covering it up?! Or were there other hidden circumstances?!
They chatted about some more trivial details before Zhenhai stood up to take his leave. He vowed earnestly that Zhang Xian could come find him anytime if needed.
"Hee hee~ Big Bro easily won over Eldest Senior Brother just like that~ From now on, you can strut around Spirit Sword Peak without worry~!" Lin Yinyin giggled.
Zhang Xian shook his head. "Problems solvable with spirit stones aren't real problems! I'm not foolish enough to make enemies everywhere!"
"So what do we do next?! It's still early; evening class isn't for a while yet~ Wanna soak in the spirit spring together?!"
Zhang Xian booped her nose playfully. "I'm going to Green Wood Peak! You go play by yourself!"
With that said, he got up and headed toward Green Wood Peak.
Halfway there, he received a transmission from Eldest Senior Brother Zhenhai:
"Master's bust size is Wu (E)! Hobby: hot spring bathing!"
Jia, Yi, Bing, Ding, Wu correspond respectively to A, B, C, D, E!
Zhang Xian: "..."
Lin Yinyin watched Zhang Xian's figure recede into the distance, stamping her foot angrily—Big Bro is going to find Liu Qingxuan again!!

Ahh!! She tugged her waist ribbon frustratedly, complaining aloud, "Master, when are you coming back?! If you don't help me undo the Locking Garment Curse soon, Big Bro's body and mind are both gonna be stolen away by that white lotus!!"
Green Wood Peak, Spiritual Plant Garden.
Liu Qingxuan bent over, tending a spiritual herb. She sensed someone approaching, looked up, and saw Zhang Xian, her eyes softening slightly.
"Zhang Xian!" She called softly, her voice as gentle as a clear spring water.
"Supervisor Liu!" Zhang Xian smiled slightly, clasping his hands in greeting.
These past days, Liu Qingxuan's heart had gradually calmed down.
Initially, she was still somewhat apprehensive, afraid Zhang Xian, after giving gifts, would impatiently declare feelings or even pester her incessantly.
But Zhang Xian didn't.
He still came to attend evening classes normally, occasionally asked questions, but never overstepped boundaries and certainly didn't deliberately create ambiguity.
He just existed quietly, letting her feel a rare sense of comfort.
She didn't know exactly what feelings she held toward Zhang Xian, but at least she didn't dislike this way of interacting.
The only thing that made her somewhat guilty was the slow progress in researching the Immortal Ascension Grass.

Her father, Liu Huaigu, however, completely shamelessly swindled two more Immortal Ascension Grass plants from Zhang Xian and urged her to swallow one, causing her Wood Spirit Root quality to upgrade to Supreme Wood and her cultivation to break through to the sixth level of Golden Core!!
Thus, she felt even more indebted to Zhang Xian!!
"Zhang Xian..." She hesitated but finally spoke up. "Research on the Immortal Ascension Grass... temporarily still has no leads!"
Zhang Xian waved his hand, smiling. "No matter. It was originally a difficult task; no hurry!"
Saying this, he took out one Heart-Mending Lotus seed and one Marrow-Cleansing Remnant Fruit from his system space and handed them over.
